lemma vandermondeMat_eq_transpose {r : ℕ} (x : Fin r → R) :
    vandermondeMat x = (Matrix.vandermonde x).transpose

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.lemma_4_11
statement:
theorem lemma_4_11 {r : ℕ} (x : Fin r → R) :
    vandermondeDet x = ∏ i : Fin r, ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ioi i, (x j - x i)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.proposition_4_10
statement:
theorem proposition_4_10 {n m : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin m) R)
    (B : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) R) :
    (A * B).det =
      ∑ I ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m)).powersetCard n,
        if h : I.card = n then
          (A.submatrix id (I.orderEmbOfFin h)).det *
          (B.submatrix (I.orderEmbOfFin h) id).det
        else 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.count_diag_map
statement:
lemma count_diag_map {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (s : Multiset α) (a : α) :
    (s.map (fun y => ((y, y) : α × α))).count (a, a) = s.count a

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.count_product_eq
statement:
lemma count_product_eq {α β : Type*} [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
    (s : Multiset α) (t : Multiset β) (a : α) (b : β) :
    (s ×ˢ t).count (a, b) = s.count a * t.count b

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.disc_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem disc_eq_zero_iff (P : K[X]) (hP : P.Monic) :
    (disc P : C) = 0 ↔ 0 < (EuclideanDomain.gcd P P.derivative).natDegree

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.offdiag_prod_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem offdiag_prod_eq_zero_iff (P : K[X]) :
    (((P.aroots C ×ˢ P.aroots C - (P.aroots C).map (fun a => (a, a))).map
        (fun ab : C × C => ab.1 - ab.2)).prod = 0)
      ↔ ¬(P.aroots C).Nodup

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.discR_aux_eq_sq
statement:
lemma discR_aux_eq_sq (s : Multiset R) (hs : s.Nodup) :
    (-1 : R) ^ (s.card * (s.card - 1) / 2) *
      ((s ×ˢ s - s.map (fun a => (a, a))).map (fun ab => ab.1 - ab.2)).prod =
    ((((s ×ˢ s).filter (fun ab : R × R => ab.1 > ab.2)).map
      (fun ab => ab.1 - ab.2)).prod) ^ 2

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.discR_pos_of_distinct_roots
statement:
theorem discR_pos_of_distinct_roots (P : R[X]) (_hP : P.Monic)
    (hnodup : P.roots.Nodup) :
    0 < discR P

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.disc_eq_algebraMap_discR
statement:
theorem disc_eq_algebraMap_discR (P : R[X]) (hsplits : P.Splits) :
    (disc P : C) = (algebraMap R C) (discR P)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.disc_pos_of_real_distinct_roots
statement:
theorem disc_pos_of_real_distinct_roots (P : R[X]) (hP : P.Monic)
    (hsplits : P.Splits) (hnodup : P.roots.Nodup) :
    ∃ d : R, 0 < d ∧ (algebraMap R C) d = (disc P : C)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.filter_gt_prod_ne_zero
statement:
lemma filter_gt_prod_ne_zero (s : Multiset R) (_hs : s.Nodup) :
    (((s ×ˢ s).filter (fun ab : R × R => ab.1 > ab.2)).map
      (fun ab => ab.1 - ab.2)).prod ≠ 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.multiset_map_sub_of_injective
statement:
lemma multiset_map_sub_of_injective {α β : Type*}
    [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] {f : α → β} (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (m n : Multiset α) :
    (m - n).map f = m.map f - n.map f

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.multiset_product_map
Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.algebraMap_discReal_eq_disc
statement:
theorem algebraMap_discReal_eq_disc (P : R[X]) :
    algebraMap R (Ri R) (discReal P) = (disc P : Ri R)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.disc_conj_invariant
statement:
theorem disc_conj_invariant (P : R[X]) :
    (Ri.conj R) (disc P : Ri R) = (disc P : Ri R)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.disc_mem_range_algebraMap
statement:
theorem disc_mem_range_algebraMap (P : R[X]) :
    ∃ d : R, algebraMap R (Ri R) d = (disc P : Ri R)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.exists_vandermonde_of_factorization
statement:
theorem exists_vandermonde_of_factorization (P : R[X]) (hP : P.Monic)
    (linears : Multiset R) (quadratics : Multiset (R × R))
    (hq_ne : ∀ pq ∈ quadratics, pq.2 ≠ 0)
    (hfact : P = (linears.map (Factorization.linearFactor (R := R))).prod *
                  (quadratics.map (Factorization.quadraticFactor (R := R))).prod)
    (hnodup : (P.aroots (Ri R)).Nodup) :
    ∃ V : Ri R,
      V ^ 2 = (disc P : Ri R) ∧
      (Ri.conj R) V = (-1) ^ quadratics.card * V ∧
      V ≠ 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.natDegree_eq_of_factorization
statement:
lemma natDegree_eq_of_factorization
    (linears : Multiset R) (quadratics : Multiset (R × R))
    (P : R[X])
    (hfact : P = (linears.map (Factorization.linearFactor (R := R))).prod *
                  (quadratics.map (Factorization.quadraticFactor (R := R))).prod) :
    P.natDegree = linears.card + 2 * quadratics.card

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.offdiag_prod_eq_omega_sq
statement:
theorem offdiag_prod_eq_omega_sq (P : R[X])
    (linears : Multiset R) (quadratics : Multiset (R × R))
    (hq_ne : ∀ pq ∈ quadratics, pq.2 ≠ 0)
    (hfact : P = (linears.map (Factorization.linearFactor (R := R))).prod *
                  (quadratics.map (Factorization.quadraticFactor (R := R))).prod)
    (hnodup : (P.aroots (Ri R)).Nodup) :
    ((((P.aroots (Ri R)) ×ˢ (P.aroots (Ri R)) -
        (P.aroots (Ri R)).map (fun a => (a, a))).map
        (fun ab : Ri R × Ri R => ab.1 - ab.2))).prod =
      algebraMap R (Ri R)
        ((-1) ^ (linears.card * (linears.card - 1) / 2) *
          (vandermondeOmega linears quadratics) ^ 2)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.proposition_4_5
statement:
theorem proposition_4_5 (P : R[X]) (hP : P.Monic)
    (hnodup : (P.aroots (Ri R)).Nodup) :
    (0 < discReal P ↔ P.roots.card ≡ P.natDegree [MOD 4]) ∧
    (discReal P < 0 ↔ P.roots.card + 2 ≡ P.natDegree [MOD 4])

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.proposition_4_5_of_factorization
statement:
theorem proposition_4_5_of_factorization (P : R[X]) (hP : P.Monic)
    (linears : Multiset R) (quadratics : Multiset (R × R))
    (hq_ne : ∀ pq ∈ quadratics, pq.2 ≠ 0)
    (hfact : P = (linears.map (Factorization.linearFactor (R := R))).prod *
                  (quadratics.map (Factorization.quadraticFactor (R := R))).prod)
    (hnodup : (P.aroots (Ri R)).Nodup) :
    (0 < discReal P ↔ linears.card ≡ P.natDegree [MOD 4]) ∧
    (discReal P < 0 ↔ linears.card + 2 ≡ P.natDegree [MOD 4])

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sign_discReal_of_factorization
statement:
theorem sign_discReal_of_factorization (P : R[X]) (hP : P.Monic)
    (linears : Multiset R) (quadratics : Multiset (R × R))
    (hq_ne : ∀ pq ∈ quadratics, pq.2 ≠ 0)
    (hfact : P = (linears.map (Factorization.linearFactor (R := R))).prod *
                  (quadratics.map (Factorization.quadraticFactor (R := R))).prod)
    (hnodup : (P.aroots (Ri R)).Nodup) :
    (0 < discReal P ↔ Even quadratics.card) ∧
    (discReal P < 0 ↔ Odd quadratics.card)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.vandermondeOmega_ne_zero
statement:
theorem vandermondeOmega_ne_zero (P : R[X]) (_hP : P.Monic)
    (linears : Multiset R) (quadratics : Multiset (R × R))
    (hq_ne : ∀ pq ∈ quadratics, pq.2 ≠ 0)
    (hfact : P = (linears.map (Factorization.linearFactor (R := R))).prod *
                  (quadratics.map (Factorization.quadraticFactor (R := R))).prod)
    (hnodup : (P.aroots (Ri R)).Nodup) :
    vandermondeOmega linears quadratics ≠ 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.vandermondeOmega_sq_eq
statement:
theorem vandermondeOmega_sq_eq (P : R[X]) (_hP : P.Monic)
    (linears : Multiset R) (quadratics : Multiset (R × R))
    (hq_ne : ∀ pq ∈ quadratics, pq.2 ≠ 0)
    (hfact : P = (linears.map (Factorization.linearFactor (R := R))).prod *
                  (quadratics.map (Factorization.quadraticFactor (R := R))).prod)
    (hnodup : (P.aroots (Ri R)).Nodup) :
    algebraMap R (Ri R) ((vandermondeOmega linears quadratics) ^ 2) =
      (-1) ^ quadratics.card * (disc P : Ri R)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.newtonSum_zero
statement:
lemma newtonSum_zero (P : K[X]) :
    (newtonSum P 0 : C) = ((P.aroots C).card : C)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.proposition_4_8_series
statement:
theorem proposition_4_8_series (P : K[X]) (hP : 0 < P.natDegree) (N : ℕ) :
    ((Polynomial.X : C[X])^N * (P.map (algebraMap K C)).derivative -
     (P.map (algebraMap K C)) *
       (Finset.range N).sum (fun i =>
         Polynomial.C (newtonSum P i) * (Polynomial.X : C[X])^(N - 1 - i))
    ).natDegree < P.natDegree

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sDisc_card_pred_eq
statement:
lemma sDisc_card_pred_eq (P : K[X]) (h : 0 < (P.aroots C).card) :
    (sDisc P ((P.aroots C).card - 1) : C) = ((P.aroots C).card : C)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sDisc_zero_eq_disc
statement:
lemma sDisc_zero_eq_disc (P : K[X]) (hMonic : P.Monic) :
    (sDisc P 0 : C) = disc P

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.exists_nodup_mem_powersetCard_iff
statement:
lemma exists_nodup_mem_powersetCard_iff (s : Multiset R) (k : ℕ) :
    (∃ t ∈ s.powersetCard k, t.Nodup) ↔ k ≤ s.toFinset.card

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.offdiag_prod_eq_zero_iff_not_nodup
statement:
lemma offdiag_prod_eq_zero_iff_not_nodup (t : Multiset R) :
    ((t ×ˢ t - t.map (fun a => (a, a))).map (fun ab => ab.1 - ab.2)).prod = 0
      ↔ ¬ t.Nodup

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sDiscR_eq_sum_signed
statement:
lemma sDiscR_eq_sum_signed (P : R[X]) (j : ℕ) :
    sDiscR P j =
      ((P.roots.powersetCard (P.roots.card - j)).map (fun t : Multiset R =>
        (-1 : R) ^ (t.card * (t.card - 1) / 2) *
        ((t ×ˢ t - t.map (fun a => (a, a))).map (fun ab => ab.1 - ab.2)).prod)).sum

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sDiscR_first_nonzero_iff
statement:
theorem sDiscR_first_nonzero_iff (P : R[X]) (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ P.roots.card) :
    ((∀ i < j, sDiscR P i = 0) ∧ sDiscR P j ≠ 0)
      ↔ P.roots.toFinset.card = P.roots.card - j

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sDiscR_ne_zero_iff
statement:
theorem sDiscR_ne_zero_iff (P : R[X]) (j : ℕ) :
    sDiscR P j ≠ 0 ↔ P.roots.card - j ≤ P.roots.toFinset.card

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sign_smul_offdiag_prod_eq_zero_of_not_nodup
statement:
lemma sign_smul_offdiag_prod_eq_zero_of_not_nodup (t : Multiset R) (ht : ¬ t.Nodup) :
    (-1 : R) ^ (t.card * (t.card - 1) / 2) *
      ((t ×ˢ t - t.map (fun a => (a, a))).map (fun ab => ab.1 - ab.2)).prod = 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sign_smul_offdiag_prod_nonneg
statement:
lemma sign_smul_offdiag_prod_nonneg (t : Multiset R) :
    0 ≤ (-1 : R) ^ (t.card * (t.card - 1) / 2) *
      ((t ×ˢ t - t.map (fun a => (a, a))).map (fun ab => ab.1 - ab.2)).prod

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sign_smul_offdiag_prod_pos_of_nodup
statement:
lemma sign_smul_offdiag_prod_pos_of_nodup (t : Multiset R) (ht : t.Nodup) :
    0 < (-1 : R) ^ (t.card * (t.card - 1) / 2) *
      ((t ×ˢ t - t.map (fun a => (a, a))).map (fun ab => ab.1 - ab.2)).prod

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.proposition_4_9
statement:
theorem proposition_4_9 (P : K[X]) (k : ℕ)
    (hk : k ≤ (P.aroots C).card) :
    (sDisc P ((P.aroots C).card - k) : C) =
      algebraMap K C P.leadingCoeff ^ (2 * k - 2) *
        (newtMat P k : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) C).det

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Res_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem Res_eq_zero_iff (P Q : D[X]) (hP : P ≠ 0) (hQ : Q ≠ 0) :
    Res P Q = 0 ↔
      ∃ U V : D[X], U ≠ 0 ∧ V ≠ 0 ∧
        U.natDegree < Q.natDegree ∧ V.natDegree < P.natDegree ∧
        U * P + V * Q = 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Syl.encodeU_natDegree_lt
statement:
theorem Syl.encodeU_natDegree_lt (p q : ℕ) (uv : Fin (p + q) → D) (hq : 0 < q) :
    (Syl.encodeU p q uv).natDegree < q

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Syl.encodeV_natDegree_lt
statement:
theorem Syl.encodeV_natDegree_lt (p q : ℕ) (uv : Fin (p + q) → D) (hp : 0 < p) :
    (Syl.encodeV p q uv).natDegree < p

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Syl.encode_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem Syl.encode_eq_zero_iff (p q : ℕ) (uv : Fin (p + q) → D) :
    (Syl.encodeU p q uv = 0 ∧ Syl.encodeV p q uv = 0) ↔ uv = 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Syl.mulMap_eq_pair
statement:
theorem Syl.mulMap_eq_pair (P Q : D[X])
    (uv : Fin (P.natDegree + Q.natDegree) → D) :
    Syl.mulMap P Q uv =
      Syl.encodeU P.natDegree Q.natDegree uv * P +
      Syl.encodeV P.natDegree Q.natDegree uv * Q

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Syl.mulMap_natDegree_lt
statement:
theorem Syl.mulMap_natDegree_lt (P Q : D[X])
    (uv : Fin (P.natDegree + Q.natDegree) → D)
    (hpq : 0 < P.natDegree + Q.natDegree) :
    (Syl.mulMap P Q uv).natDegree < P.natDegree + Q.natDegree

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Res_eq_resultant
statement:
theorem Res_eq_resultant (P Q : D[X]) :
    Res P Q = Polynomial.resultant P Q P.natDegree Q.natDegree

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Lemma_4_18_Res
statement:
theorem Lemma_4_18_Res (P Q C R : D[X])
    (h_C : C.natDegree + Q.natDegree ≤ P.natDegree)
    (h_R : R.natDegree ≤ P.natDegree)
    (h_decomp : P = C * Q + R) :
    Res P Q =
      (-1) ^ (P.natDegree * Q.natDegree) *
        Q.leadingCoeff ^ (P.natDegree - R.natDegree) * Res Q R

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Lemma_4_18_Theta
statement:
theorem Lemma_4_18_Theta (P Q C R : K[X])
    (h_C : C.natDegree + Q.natDegree ≤ P.natDegree)
    (h_R : R.natDegree ≤ P.natDegree)
    (h_P_splits : P.Splits) (h_Q_splits : Q.Splits)
    (h_decomp : P = C * Q + R) :
    Θ P Q Q.natDegree =
      (-1) ^ (P.natDegree * Q.natDegree) *
        Q.leadingCoeff ^ (P.natDegree - R.natDegree) * Θ Q R R.natDegree

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Θ_eq_resultant
statement:
theorem Θ_eq_resultant (P Q : K[X]) (q : ℕ) (hP : P.Splits)
    (hQ : Q.natDegree ≤ q) :
    Θ P Q q = Polynomial.resultant P Q P.natDegree q

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Lemma_4_24
statement:
theorem Lemma_4_24 (P Q : D[X]) (j : ℕ)
    (hj_q : j ≤ Q.natDegree) (hj_p : j < P.natDegree)
    (hP : P ≠ 0) (hQ : Q ≠ 0) :
    sRes P Q j = 0 ↔
      ∃ U V : D[X], U ≠ 0 ∧ V ≠ 0 ∧
        U.degree < ↑(Q.natDegree - j) ∧
        V.degree < ↑(P.natDegree - j) ∧
        (U * P + V * Q).degree < ↑j

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.SyHa.encodeU_natDegree_lt
statement:
theorem SyHa.encodeU_natDegree_lt (p q j : ℕ) (hj_q : j ≤ q) (hj_p : j ≤ p)
    (uv : Fin (p + q - 2 * j) → D) (hqj : 0 < q - j) :
    (SyHa.encodeU p q j hj_q hj_p uv).natDegree < q - j

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.SyHa.encodeV_natDegree_lt
statement:
theorem SyHa.encodeV_natDegree_lt (p q j : ℕ) (hj_q : j ≤ q) (hj_p : j ≤ p)
    (uv : Fin (p + q - 2 * j) → D) (hpj : 0 < p - j) :
    (SyHa.encodeV p q j hj_q hj_p uv).natDegree < p - j

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.SyHa.encode_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem SyHa.encode_eq_zero_iff (p q j : ℕ) (hj_q : j ≤ q) (hj_p : j ≤ p)
    (uv : Fin (p + q - 2 * j) → D) :
    (SyHa.encodeU p q j hj_q hj_p uv = 0 ∧
      SyHa.encodeV p q j hj_q hj_p uv = 0) ↔ uv = 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.SyHa.mulMap_eq_pair
statement:
theorem SyHa.mulMap_eq_pair (P Q : D[X]) (j : ℕ)
    (hj_q : j ≤ Q.natDegree) (hj_p : j ≤ P.natDegree)
    (uv : Fin (P.natDegree + Q.natDegree - 2 * j) → D) :
    SyHa.mulMap P Q j uv =
      SyHa.encodeU P.natDegree Q.natDegree j hj_q hj_p uv * P +
      SyHa.encodeV P.natDegree Q.natDegree j hj_q hj_p uv * Q

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.SyHa.mulMap_natDegree_lt
statement:
theorem SyHa.mulMap_natDegree_lt (P Q : D[X]) (j : ℕ)
    (hj_q : j ≤ Q.natDegree) (hj_p : j ≤ P.natDegree)
    (uv : Fin (P.natDegree + Q.natDegree - 2 * j) → D)
    (hpq : 0 < P.natDegree + Q.natDegree - 2 * j) :
    (SyHa.mulMap P Q j uv).natDegree <
      P.natDegree + Q.natDegree - j

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.blockReversePerm_apply_val
statement:
theorem blockReversePerm_apply_val (p q : ℕ) (i : Fin (p + q)) :
    (blockReversePerm p q i).val =
      if i.val < q then i.val else p + 2 * q - 1 - i.val

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sRes_zero_eq_eps_mul_Res
statement:
theorem sRes_zero_eq_eps_mul_Res (P Q : D[X]) :
    sRes P Q 0 = ε P.natDegree * Res P Q

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sign_blockReversePerm
statement:
theorem sign_blockReversePerm (p q : ℕ) :
    ((Equiv.Perm.sign (blockReversePerm p q)) : ℤ) = ε p

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sign_revPerm
statement:
theorem sign_revPerm (n : ℕ) :
    ((Equiv.Perm.sign (Fin.revPerm : Equiv.Perm (Fin n))) : ℤ) = ε n

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.ε_add_two
statement: theorem ε_add_two (n : ℕ) : ε (n + 2) = -ε n

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.ε_four_mul
statement: theorem ε_four_mul (i : ℕ) : ε (4 * i) = 1

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.ε_four_mul_sub_one
statement: theorem ε_four_mul_sub_one (i : ℕ) (hi : 1 ≤ i) : ε (4 * i - 1) = -1

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.ε_four_mul_sub_three
statement: theorem ε_four_mul_sub_three (i : ℕ) (hi : 1 ≤ i) : ε (4 * i - 3) = 1

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.ε_four_mul_sub_two
statement: theorem ε_four_mul_sub_two (i : ℕ) (hi : 1 ≤ i) : ε (4 * i - 2) = -1

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.ε_one
statement: @[simp] theorem ε_one : ε 1 = 1

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.ε_sub_two_mul
statement:
theorem ε_sub_two_mul (i j : ℕ) (h : 2 * j ≤ i) :
    ε (i - 2 * j) = (-1) ^ j * ε i

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.ε_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem ε_zero : ε 0 = 1

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.PmV_cons_cons_ne
statement:
theorem PmV_cons_cons_ne (sp sq : K) (tl : List K) (hsq : sq ≠ 0) :
    PmV (sp :: sq :: tl) = PmV (sq :: tl) + (SignType.sign (sp * sq) : ℤ)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.PmV_eq_of_forall_ne_zero
statement:
theorem PmV_eq_of_forall_ne_zero :
    ∀ (s : List K), s ≠ [] → (∀ x ∈ s, x ≠ 0) →
      PmV s + 2 * (Var s : ℤ) = (s.length : ℤ) - 1
  | [], hs, _ => absurd rfl hs
  | [_], _, h0 => by simp [Var_of_forall_ne_zero h0]
  | sp :: sq :: tl, _, h0 => by
    have hsp : sp ≠ 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.PmV_eq_varBetween
statement:
theorem PmV_eq_varBetween (P : List K[X]) (hne : ∀ Q ∈ P, Q ≠ 0)
    (hdeg : P.IsChain (fun Q Q' => Q.natDegree = Q'.natDegree + 1)) :
    (PmV (P.map Polynomial.leadingCoeff) : ℤ)
      = varBetween P ExtendedPoint.negInf ExtendedPoint.posInf

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.PmV_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem PmV_nil : PmV ([] : List K) = 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.PmV_singleton
statement: @[simp] theorem PmV_singleton (a : K) : PmV [a] = 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sResSeq_getElem
statement:
theorem sResSeq_getElem (P Q : D[X]) (k : ℕ) (hk : k < P.natDegree + 1) :
    (sResSeq P Q)[k]'(by simpa using hk) = sRes P Q (P.natDegree - k)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sResSeq_head?
statement:
theorem sResSeq_head? (P Q : D[X]) :
    (sResSeq P Q).head? = some (sRes P Q P.natDegree)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sResSeq_length
statement:
@[simp] theorem sResSeq_length (P Q : D[X]) :
    (sResSeq P Q).length = P.natDegree + 1

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.eps_qj
statement:
theorem eps_qj (p q j : ℕ) (hqp : q ≤ p) (hjq : j ≤ q) :
    (-1 : ℤ) ^ (q - j) * ε (p + q - 2 * j) = ε (p - q)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.proposition_4_37_part1
statement:
theorem proposition_4_37_part1 (P Q : K[X]) (j : ℕ) (hQ : Q ≠ 0)
    (hjr : j ≤ (P % Q).natDegree) (hrq : (P % Q).natDegree < Q.natDegree)
    (hqp : Q.natDegree < P.natDegree) :
    sRes P Q j = ((ε (P.natDegree - Q.natDegree) : ℤ) : K) *
      Q.leadingCoeff ^ (P.natDegree - (P % Q).natDegree) * sRes Q (-(P % Q)) j

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.proposition_4_37_part2
statement:
theorem proposition_4_37_part2 (P Q : K[X]) (j : ℕ) (hQ : Q ≠ 0)
    (hr : (P % Q).natDegree < j) (hjq : j < Q.natDegree)
    (hqp : Q.natDegree < P.natDegree) :
    sRes P Q j = 0 ∧ sRes Q (-(P % Q)) j = 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.ε_mul_self
statement: theorem ε_mul_self (n : ℕ) : ε n * ε n = 1

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.PmV_cons_zeros
statement:
theorem PmV_cons_zeros (a : K) (zeros : List K) (hz : ∀ x ∈ zeros, x = 0)
    (b : K) (hb : b ≠ 0) (rest : List K) :
    PmV (a :: (zeros ++ b :: rest)) = PmV (b :: rest) +
      (if Odd (zeros.length + 1) then
        ε (zeros.length + 1) * (SignType.sign (a * b) : ℤ) else 0)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.PmV_smul
statement:
theorem PmV_smul {c : K} (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    ∀ l : List K, PmV (l.map (fun x => c * x)) = PmV l
  | [] => by simp
  | sp :: rest => by
    have hpred : (fun x : K => decide (c * x = 0)) = (fun x => decide (x = 0))

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.eps_cast_ne
statement: theorem eps_cast_ne (n : ℕ) : ((ε n : ℤ) : K) ≠ 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.lemma_4_36
statement:
theorem lemma_4_36 (P Q : K[X]) (hQ : Q ≠ 0) (hR : P % Q ≠ 0)
    (hrq : (P % Q).natDegree < Q.natDegree) (hqp : Q.natDegree < P.natDegree) :
    PmV (sResSeq P Q) = PmV (sResSeq Q (-(P % Q)))
      + (if Odd (P.natDegree - Q.natDegree)
          then (SignType.sign (P.leadingCoeff * Q.leadingCoeff) : ℤ) else 0)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sRes_eq_zero_of_gap
statement:
theorem sRes_eq_zero_of_gap (P Q : K[X]) {j : ℕ} (hqj : Q.natDegree < j)
    (hjp : j < P.natDegree) : sRes P Q j = 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sRes_q_eq
statement:
theorem sRes_q_eq (P Q : K[X]) (hQ : Q ≠ 0) (hqp : Q.natDegree < P.natDegree) :
    sRes P Q Q.natDegree = ((ε (P.natDegree - Q.natDegree) : ℤ) : K) *
      Q.leadingCoeff ^ (P.natDegree - Q.natDegree)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sign_eps
statement: theorem sign_eps (n : ℕ) : (SignType.sign ((ε n : ℤ) : K) : ℤ) = ε n

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sign_pow_cast
statement:
theorem sign_pow_cast (x : K) (m : ℕ) :
    (SignType.sign (x ^ m) : ℤ) = (SignType.sign x : ℤ) ^ m

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sign_pow_odd
statement:
theorem sign_pow_odd (x : K) (hx : x ≠ 0) {m : ℕ} (hm : Odd m) :
    (SignType.sign (x ^ m) : ℤ) = (SignType.sign x : ℤ)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.ε_eq_one_or_neg_one
statement: theorem ε_eq_one_or_neg_one (n : ℕ) : ε n = 1 ∨ ε n = -1

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Res_eq_zero_iff_not_isCoprime
statement:
theorem Res_eq_zero_iff_not_isCoprime (P Q : D[X]) (hP : P ≠ 0) (hQ : Q ≠ 0) :
    Res P Q = 0 ↔
      ¬ IsCoprime (P.map (algebraMap D K)) (Q.map (algebraMap D K))

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Res_map
statement:
theorem Res_map {E : Type*} [CommRing E] (f : D →+* E)
    (P Q : D[X])
    (hPdeg : (P.map f).natDegree = P.natDegree)
    (hQdeg : (Q.map f).natDegree = Q.natDegree) :
    f (Res P Q) = Res (P.map f) (Q.map f)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.lcm_natDegree_eq
statement:
theorem lcm_natDegree_eq (P Q : K[X]) (hP : P ≠ 0) (hQ : Q ≠ 0) :
    (lcm P Q).natDegree + (gcd P Q).natDegree =
      P.natDegree + Q.natDegree

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Proposition_4_19
statement:
theorem Proposition_4_19 (P Q : D[X])
    (H : P.natDegree ≠ 0 ∨ Q.natDegree ≠ 0) :
    ∃ U V : D[X], U.degree < Q.natDegree ∧ V.degree < P.natDegree ∧
      C (Res P Q) = U * P + V * Q

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Proposition_4_21
statement:
theorem Proposition_4_21 (P Q : D[X]) (f : D →+* D')
    (hPdeg : (P.map f).natDegree = P.natDegree)
    (hQdeg : (Q.map f).natDegree = Q.natDegree) :
    f (Res P Q) = Res (P.map f) (Q.map f)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Proposition_4_25
statement:
theorem Proposition_4_25 (P Q : K[X]) (hP : P ≠ 0) (hQ : Q ≠ 0)
    (j : ℕ) (hj_q : j ≤ Q.natDegree) (hj_p : j < P.natDegree) :
    (∀ i, i < j → sRes P Q i = 0) ↔ (gcd P Q).natDegree ≥ j

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.exists_UV_zero_iff_gcd_natDegree_ge
statement:
theorem exists_UV_zero_iff_gcd_natDegree_ge
    (P Q : K[X]) (hP : P ≠ 0) (hQ : Q ≠ 0)
    (j : ℕ) (hj_q : j ≤ Q.natDegree) (hj_p : j ≤ P.natDegree) :
    (∃ U V : K[X], U ≠ 0 ∧ V ≠ 0 ∧
      U.natDegree ≤ Q.natDegree - j ∧
      V.natDegree ≤ P.natDegree - j ∧
      U * P + V * Q = 0) ↔
        (gcd P Q).natDegree ≥ j

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Proposition_4_26
statement:
theorem Proposition_4_26 (P Q : K[X]) (hP : P ≠ 0) (hQ : Q ≠ 0)
    (j : ℕ) (hj_q : j ≤ Q.natDegree) (hj_p : j < P.natDegree) :
    (gcd P Q).natDegree = j ↔
      (∀ i, i < j → sRes P Q i = 0) ∧ sRes P Q j ≠ 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.proposition_4_28
statement:
theorem proposition_4_28 (P : K[X]) (hP : 0 < P.natDegree) (k : ℕ)
    (hk_pos : 0 < k) (hk_le : k ≤ P.natDegree) :
    (algebraMap K C) P.leadingCoeff *
        sDisc P (P.natDegree - k) =
      (algebraMap K C) (sRes P P.derivative (P.natDegree - k))

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Proposition_4_30
statement:
theorem Proposition_4_30 (P : K[X]) (hP : 0 < P.natDegree)
    (j : ℕ) (hj : j < P.natDegree) :
    (gcd P P.derivative).natDegree = j ↔
      (∀ i, i < j → (sDisc P i : C) = 0) ∧ (sDisc P j : C) ≠ 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.leadingCoeff_pow_mul_Res_eq
statement:
theorem leadingCoeff_pow_mul_Res_eq {D : Type*} [CommRing D] [IsDomain D] (P Q : D[X])
    (hP : P ≠ 0) (hpq : P.natDegree = Q.natDegree) :
    P.leadingCoeff ^ (C P.leadingCoeff * Q - C Q.leadingCoeff * P).natDegree * Res P Q
      = Res P (C P.leadingCoeff * Q - C Q.leadingCoeff * P)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Res_eq_Θ_of_splits
statement:
theorem Res_eq_Θ_of_splits (P Q : K[X]) (hP : P.Splits) :
    Res P Q = Θ P Q Q.natDegree

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Theorem_4_17
statement:
theorem Theorem_4_17 (P Q : K[X]) (hP : P.Splits) (hQ : Q.Splits) :
    Res P Q =
      P.leadingCoeff ^ Q.natDegree * Q.leadingCoeff ^ P.natDegree *
        ((P.roots ×ˢ Q.roots).map fun pr => pr.1 - pr.2).prod

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.corollary_4_40
statement:
theorem corollary_4_40 (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) K) (hM : M.IsSymm) :
    ∃ (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) K) (D : Fin n → K),
      IsUnit B.det ∧ M = B * Matrix.diagonal D * B.transpose ∧
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => 0 < D i)).card = sigPos (quadraticForm M) ∧
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => D i < 0)).card = sigNeg (quadraticForm M)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.quadraticFormRank_eq_sigPos_add_sigNeg
statement:
theorem quadraticFormRank_eq_sigPos_add_sigNeg
    (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) K) (hM : M.IsSymm) :
    quadraticFormRank M = sigPos (quadraticForm M) + sigNeg (quadraticForm M)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.HerMatrix_mem_range
statement:
theorem HerMatrix_mem_range (P Q : D[X]) (hP : P.Monic) (i j : Fin P.natDegree) :
    HerMatrix P Q i j ∈ (algebraMap D C).range

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.HerMatrix_one_eq_newtMat
statement:
theorem HerMatrix_one_eq_newtMat (P : K[X]) :
    (HerMatrix P 1 : Matrix (Fin P.natDegree) (Fin P.natDegree) C) = newtMat P P.natDegree

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Her_apply
statement:
theorem Her_apply (P Q : D[X]) (f : Fin P.natDegree → C) :
    Her P Q f = ∑ i : Fin P.natDegree, ∑ j : Fin P.natDegree, HerMatrix P Q i j * f i * f j

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Her_eq_matrix
statement:
theorem Her_eq_matrix (P Q : D[X]) (f : Fin P.natDegree → C) :
    Her P Q f = f ⬝ᵥ HerMatrix P Q *ᵥ f

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Her_one_apply
statement:
theorem Her_one_apply (P : K[X]) (f : Fin P.natDegree → C) :
    Her P 1 f = ∑ i : Fin P.natDegree, ∑ j : Fin P.natDegree,
      newtonSum P ((i : ℕ) + (j : ℕ)) * f i * f j

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.proposition_4_41
statement:
theorem proposition_4_41 (v : Fin n → (Fin n → R)) (hv : LinearIndependent R v) :
    ∃ w : Fin n → (Fin n → R),
      LinearIndependent R w ∧
      (∀ i j, i ≠ j → IsOrthogonal (w i) (w j)) ∧
      (∀ i, w i - v i ∈ Submodule.span R (v '' {j | j < i})) ∧
      (∀ i, w i - v i ∈ Submodule.span R (w '' {j | j < i}))

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.proposition_4_42
statement:
theorem proposition_4_42 (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) (hM : M.IsSymm)
    (hpos : IsNonNeg M) (f g : Fin n → R) :
    bilinFormM M f g ^ 2 ≤ quadraticForm M f * quadraticForm M g

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Lmul_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem Lmul_apply (P : K[X]) (f g : AdjoinRoot P) : Lmul P f g = f * g

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Lmul_mk
statement:
theorem Lmul_mk (P a b : K[X]) :
    Lmul P (AdjoinRoot.mk P a) (AdjoinRoot.mk P b) = AdjoinRoot.mk P ((a * b) %ₘ P)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Tr_eq_matrix_trace
statement:
theorem Tr_eq_matrix_trace {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] (P : K[X])
    (b : Module.Basis ι K (AdjoinRoot P)) (f : AdjoinRoot P →ₗ[K] AdjoinRoot P) :
    Tr P f = ((LinearMap.toMatrix b b) f).trace

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.adjoinRoot_powerBasis_apply
statement:
theorem adjoinRoot_powerBasis_apply (P : K[X]) (hP : P ≠ 0)
    (i : Fin (AdjoinRoot.powerBasis hP).dim) :
    (AdjoinRoot.powerBasis hP).basis i = AdjoinRoot.root P ^ (i : ℕ)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.finrank_adjoinRoot
statement:
theorem finrank_adjoinRoot (P : K[X]) (hP : P ≠ 0) :
    Module.finrank K (AdjoinRoot P) = P.natDegree

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.mk_eq_mk_iff
statement:
theorem mk_eq_mk_iff (P f g : K[X]) :
    AdjoinRoot.mk P f = AdjoinRoot.mk P g ↔ P ∣ f - g

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.mk_modByMonic
statement:
theorem mk_modByMonic (P f : K[X]) :
    AdjoinRoot.mk P (f %ₘ P) = AdjoinRoot.mk P f

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.aeval_eq_zero_of_mem_idealOfPolys
statement:
theorem aeval_eq_zero_of_mem_idealOfPolys {P : Finset (MvPolynomial (Fin k) K)}
    {f : MvPolynomial (Fin k) K} (hf : f ∈ idealOfPolys P) (x : Fin k → C)
    (hx : ∀ p ∈ P, MvPolynomial.aeval x p = 0) :
    MvPolynomial.aeval x f = 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.mem_idealOfPolys_iff
statement:
theorem mem_idealOfPolys_iff (P : Finset (MvPolynomial (Fin k) K))
    (f : MvPolynomial (Fin k) K) :
    f ∈ idealOfPolys P
      ↔ ∃ A : MvPolynomial (Fin k) K → MvPolynomial (Fin k) K, ∑ p ∈ P, A p * p = f

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Red_of_le
statement:
theorem Red_of_le (m : MonomialOrder (Fin k)) (P : MvPolynomial (Fin k) K)
    {α : Fin k →₀ ℕ} (G : MvPolynomial (Fin k) K) (h : m.degree G ≤ α) :
    Red m P α G = P - monomial (α - m.degree G) (P.coeff α / m.leadingCoeff G) * G

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Red_of_not_le
statement:
theorem Red_of_not_le (m : MonomialOrder (Fin k)) (P : MvPolynomial (Fin k) K)
    {α : Fin k →₀ ℕ} (G : MvPolynomial (Fin k) K) (h : ¬ m.degree G ≤ α) :
    Red m P α G = P

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.reduction_standard_repr
statement:
theorem reduction_standard_repr (m : MonomialOrder (Fin k))
    (𝒢 : Finset (MvPolynomial (Fin k) K)) {P Q : MvPolynomial (Fin k) K}
    (h : ReducibleTo m 𝒢 P Q) :
    m.toSyn (m.degree Q) ≤ m.toSyn (m.degree P) ∧
    ∃ A : MvPolynomial (Fin k) K → MvPolynomial (Fin k) K,
      (P - Q = ∑ G ∈ 𝒢, A G * G) ∧
      (∀ G ∈ 𝒢, m.toSyn (m.degree (A G * G)) ≤ m.toSyn (m.degree P))

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.remark_4_66
statement:
theorem remark_4_66 (m : MonomialOrder (Fin k)) (𝒢 : Finset (MvPolynomial (Fin k) K))
    {P Q : MvPolynomial (Fin k) K} (h : ReducibleTo m 𝒢 P Q) :
    P - Q ∈ Ideal.span (↑𝒢 : Set _)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.remark_4_66_repr
statement:
theorem remark_4_66_repr (m : MonomialOrder (Fin k)) (𝒢 : Finset (MvPolynomial (Fin k) K))
    {P : MvPolynomial (Fin k) K} (h : ReducibleTo m 𝒢 P 0) :
    ∃ A : MvPolynomial (Fin k) K → MvPolynomial (Fin k) K, ∑ G ∈ 𝒢, A G * G = P

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.remark_4_66_repr_degree
statement:
theorem remark_4_66_repr_degree (m : MonomialOrder (Fin k))
    (𝒢 : Finset (MvPolynomial (Fin k) K)) {P : MvPolynomial (Fin k) K}
    (h : ReducibleTo m 𝒢 P 0) :
    ∃ A : MvPolynomial (Fin k) K → MvPolynomial (Fin k) K,
      (∑ G ∈ 𝒢, A G * G = P) ∧
      (∀ G ∈ 𝒢, m.toSyn (m.degree (A G * G)) ≤ m.toSyn (m.degree P))

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sub_mem_span_of_isReduction
Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.proposition_4_68
statement:
theorem proposition_4_68 (m : MonomialOrder (Fin k)) {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin k) K)}
    {𝒢 : Finset (MvPolynomial (Fin k) K)} (hG : IsGrobnerBasisOf m I 𝒢)
    (P : MvPolynomial (Fin k) K) :
    P ∈ I ↔ ReducibleTo m 𝒢 P 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.proposition_4_69
Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.monSnoc_castSucc
statement:
@[simp] theorem monSnoc_castSucc (α : Fin k →₀ ℕ) (n : ℕ) (i : Fin k) :
    monSnoc α n i.castSucc = α i

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.monSnoc_last
statement:
@[simp] theorem monSnoc_last (α : Fin k →₀ ℕ) (n : ℕ) :
    monSnoc α n (Fin.last k) = n

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.monomial_one_dvd_one_iff
statement:
theorem monomial_one_dvd_one_iff (i j : Fin k →₀ ℕ) :
    ((monomial i 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin k) K) ∣ monomial j 1) ↔ i ≤ j

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.lemma_4_62
statement:
theorem lemma_4_62 (B : Set (Fin k →₀ ℕ)) (_hB : ∀ a ∈ B, ∀ b, a ≤ b → b ∈ B) :
    {a | Minimal (· ∈ B) a}.Finite

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.proposition_4_70
statement:
theorem proposition_4_70 (m : MonomialOrder (Fin k)) (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin k) K)) :
    ∃ 𝒢 : Finset (MvPolynomial (Fin k) K), IsGrobnerBasisOf m I 𝒢

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.theorem_4_61
statement:
theorem theorem_4_61 (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin k) K)) :
    ∃ P : Finset (MvPolynomial (Fin k) K), I = idealOfPolys P

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.corollary_4_71
statement:
theorem corollary_4_71 (I : ℕ → Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin k) K)) (hI : Monotone I) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ m : ℕ, m > n → I m = I n

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.IsQuasiMonic.leadingCoeff_const_ne_zero
statement:
theorem IsQuasiMonic.leadingCoeff_const_ne_zero {P : Polynomial (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K)}
    (hP : IsQuasiMonic P) : ∀ c : K, P.leadingCoeff = MvPolynomial.C c → c ≠ 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.IsQuasiMonic.ne_zero
statement:
theorem IsQuasiMonic.ne_zero {P : Polynomial (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K)} (hP : IsQuasiMonic P) :
    P ≠ 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.isFiniteMapping_fiber_finite
Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.IsFiniteMapping.isFiniteMappingChain
Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.isFiniteMappingChain_succ
statement:
theorem isFiniteMappingChain_succ (C : Type*) [Field C] [Algebra K C] {k' d : ℕ}
    (P : Finset (MvPolynomial (Fin (k' + (d + 1))) K))
    (T : Finset (MvPolynomial (Fin k') K)) :
    IsFiniteMappingChain C k' (d + 1) P T ↔
      ∃ Q : Finset (MvPolynomial (Fin (k' + d)) K),
        IsFiniteMapping C P Q ∧ IsFiniteMappingChain C k' d Q T

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.isFiniteMappingChain_zero
Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.lemma_4_75
statement:
theorem lemma_4_75 (B : MvPolynomial (Fin k) K) (hB : B ≠ 0) :
    ∃ z : Fin k → K, (∀ i, ∃ m : ℕ, m ≤ B.totalDegree ∧ z i = (m : K)) ∧
      MvPolynomial.eval z B ≠ 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.eval_topForm
statement:
theorem eval_topForm (a : Fin n → K) (P : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) K) :
    eval a (topForm P) = eval (Fin.cons 1 a) (homogeneousComponent P.totalDegree P)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.isQuasiMonic_finSuccEquiv_shearHom
statement:
theorem isQuasiMonic_finSuccEquiv_shearHom (a : Fin n → K)
    {P : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) K} (hev : eval a (topForm P) ≠ 0) :
    IsQuasiMonic (finSuccEquiv K n (shearHom a P))

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.shearEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem shearEquiv_apply (a : Fin n → K) (P : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) K) :
    shearEquiv a P = shearHom a P

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.shearHom_comp_neg
statement:
theorem shearHom_comp_neg (a : Fin n → K) :
    (shearHom a).comp (shearHom (fun i => -a i)) = AlgHom.id K _

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.shearMap_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem shearMap_succ (a : Fin n → K) (i : Fin n) :
    shearMap a i.succ = X i.succ + C (a i) * X 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.shearMap_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem shearMap_zero (a : Fin n → K) : shearMap a 0 = X 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.totalDegree_shearHom_le
statement:
theorem totalDegree_shearHom_le (a : Fin n → K) (P : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) K) :
    (shearHom a P).totalDegree ≤ P.totalDegree

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.gHom_Rbar
statement:
theorem gHom_Rbar (rest : List (MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) K)) :
    gHom (Rbar rest) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range rest.length, Polynomial.C (rest.getD i 0) * Polynomial.X ^ i

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.gHom_embedX0
statement:
theorem gHom_embedX0 (P : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) K) :

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.proposition_4_76
statement:
theorem proposition_4_76 {C : Type*} [Field C] [IsAlgClosed C] [Algebra K C]
    (P₁ : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) K) (rest : List (MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) K))
    (hqm : IsQuasiMonic (finSuccEquiv K n P₁)) :
    ∃ Proj : Finset (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K),
      (∀ Q ∈ Proj, MvPolynomial.rename Fin.succ Q ∈ idealOfPolys (insert P₁ rest.toFinset)) ∧
      (Fin.tail : (Fin (n + 1) → C) → (Fin n → C)) ''
          zerOfFinset C (insert P₁ rest.toFinset) = zerOfFinset C Proj ∧
      IsFiniteMapping C (insert P₁ rest.toFinset) Proj

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.aeval_comp_algHom
statement:
theorem aeval_comp_algHom {N : ℕ}
    (τ : MvPolynomial (Fin N) K →ₐ[K] MvPolynomial (Fin N) K) (x : Fin N → C)
    (P : MvPolynomial (Fin N) K) :

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.mem_zerOfFinset_image

theorem mem_zerOfFinset_image {N : ℕ} [DecidableEq (MvPolynomial (Fin N) K)]

    (Ps : Finset (MvPolynomial (Fin N) K)) (x : Fin N → C) :
    x ∈ zerOfFinset C (Ps.image τ) ↔ ptMap τ x ∈ zerOfFinset C Ps

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.mem_zerOfFinset_image_equiv
statement:
theorem mem_zerOfFinset_image_equiv {N : ℕ} [DecidableEq (MvPolynomial (Fin N) K)]

    (Ps : Finset (MvPolynomial (Fin N) K)) (x : Fin N → C) :
    x ∈ zerOfFinset C (Ps.image σ) ↔ ptMap σ.toAlgHom x ∈ zerOfFinset C Ps

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.homogeneousComponent_mul_homogeneous
statement:
theorem homogeneousComponent_mul_homogeneous {k : ℕ} {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    {Q : MvPolynomial (Fin k) R} {e : ℕ} (hQ : Q.IsHomogeneous e) (m : ℕ) (hm : e ≤ m)

theorem localization_add (a a' : A) (s s' : S) :

      ∃ t : S, (t : A) * (a * (s' : A) - a' * (s : A)) = 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.localization_mul
statement:
theorem localization_mul (a a' : A) (s s' : S) :

    (hfin : (zerOfFinset (Ri R) Ps).Finite) {x : Fin k → Ri R}
    (hx : x ∈ zerOfFinset (Ri R) Ps) (hxr : conjTuple x ≠ x) :
    Ri.imL (MvPolynomial.aeval x (sepElt Ps hfin)) ≠ 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.MvHermite.mem_mvHerRoots_iff
Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.MvHermite.mvEval_indep
statement:
theorem mvEval_indep (Ps : Finset (MvPolynomial (Fin k) R)) [CharZero R]
    [Module.Finite R (quotPolys Ps)] (Q : MvPolynomial (Fin k) R)
    (hfin : (zerOfFinset (Ri R) Ps).Finite) :
    LinearIndependent (Ri R)
      (fun j : Fin (mvHerRoots Ps Q hfin).card =>
        (fun l : Fin (mvN Ps) =>
          MvPolynomial.aeval ((mvHerRoots Ps Q hfin).equivFin.symm j : Fin k → Ri R)
            (mvRep Ps l)))

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.MvHermite.mvHerDotLM_apply
statement: theorem mvHerDotLM_apply {N : ℕ} (v f : Fin N → R) : mvHerDotLM v f = v ⬝ᵥ f

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.MvHermite.mvHerQuad_equiv
statement:
theorem mvHerQuad_equiv (Ps : Finset (MvPolynomial (Fin k) R))
    [Module.Finite R (quotPolys Ps)] (Q : MvPolynomial (Fin k) R) :
    QuadraticMap.Equivalent (hermiteQuad Ps (Ideal.Quotient.mk (idealOfPolys Ps) Q))
      (mvHerQuad Ps Q)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.MvHermite.mvRep_spec
statement:
theorem mvRep_spec (Ps : Finset (MvPolynomial (Fin k) R))
    [Module.Finite R (quotPolys Ps)] (j : Fin (mvN Ps)) :
    Ideal.Quotient.mk (idealOfPolys Ps) (mvRep Ps j) = mvBasis Ps j

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.MvHermite.posRep_conjTuple_iff
statement:
theorem posRep_conjTuple_iff (Ps : Finset (MvPolynomial (Fin k) R)) [CharZero R]
    (hfin : (zerOfFinset (Ri R) Ps).Finite) {x : Fin k → Ri R}
    (hx : x ∈ zerOfFinset (Ri R) Ps) (hxr : conjTuple x ≠ x) :
    posRep Ps hfin x ↔ ¬ posRep Ps hfin (conjTuple x)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.MvHermite.reL_conj
statement: theorem reL_conj (c : Ri R) : Ri.reL (Ri.conj R c) = Ri.reL c

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.MvHermite.reL_mul
statement:
theorem reL_mul (c d : Ri R) :
    Ri.reL (c * d) = Ri.reL c * Ri.reL d - Ri.imL c * Ri.imL d

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.MvHermite.reL_sq
statement: theorem reL_sq (c : Ri R) : Ri.reL (c ^ 2) = Ri.reL c ^ 2 - Ri.imL c ^ 2

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.MvHermite.sepElt_separating
statement:
theorem sepElt_separating (Ps : Finset (MvPolynomial (Fin k) R)) [CharZero R]
    (hfin : (zerOfFinset (Ri R) Ps).Finite) {x y : Fin k → Ri R}
    (hx : x ∈ zerOfFinset (Ri R) Ps) (hy : y ∈ zerOfFinset (Ri R) Ps)
    (h : MvPolynomial.aeval x (sepElt Ps hfin) = MvPolynomial.aeval y (sepElt Ps hfin)) :
    x = y

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.MvHermite.valueAt_eq_sum
statement:
theorem valueAt_eq_sum (Ps : Finset (MvPolynomial (Fin k) R))
    [Module.Finite R (quotPolys Ps)] {x : Fin k → Ri R} (hx : x ∈ zerOfFinset (Ri R) Ps)
    (g : quotPolys Ps) :
    valueAt (Ri R) Ps g x hx
      = ∑ j, algebraMap R (Ri R) ((mvBasis Ps).repr g j) * MvPolynomial.aeval x (mvRep Ps j)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.MvHermite.valueAt_mvBasis
statement:
theorem valueAt_mvBasis (Ps : Finset (MvPolynomial (Fin k) R))
    [Module.Finite R (quotPolys Ps)] {x : Fin k → Ri R} (hx : x ∈ zerOfFinset (Ri R) Ps)
    (j : Fin (mvN Ps)) :
    valueAt (Ri R) Ps (mvBasis Ps j) x hx = MvPolynomial.aeval x (mvRep Ps j)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.zerOfFinset_finite_of_moduleFinite
statement:
theorem zerOfFinset_finite_of_moduleFinite (Ps : Finset (MvPolynomial (Fin k) R))
    [Module.Finite R (quotPolys Ps)] : (zerOfFinset (Ri R) Ps).Finite

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.mkLine_eq_mkLine_iff
statement:
theorem mkLine_eq_mkLine_iff (x y : Fin (k + 1) → Ri R) (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    mkLine x hx = mkLine y hy ↔ ∃ c : Ri R, c ≠ 0 ∧ x = c • y

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.chartInv_chartMap
statement:
theorem chartInv_chartMap (i : Fin (k + 1)) (x : Fin k → Ri R) :
    chartInv i (chartMap i x) = x

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.chartMap_chartInv
statement:
theorem chartMap_chartInv (i : Fin (k + 1)) (p : complexProjectiveSpace R k) (h : p.rep i ≠ 0) :
    chartMap i (chartInv i p) = p

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.chartSet_eq
statement:
theorem chartSet_eq (i : Fin (k + 1)) :
    chartSet i = {p : complexProjectiveSpace R k | p.rep i ≠ 0}

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.exists_rep_smul
statement:
theorem exists_rep_smul (v : Fin (k + 1) → Ri R) (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    ∃ c : Ri R, c ≠ 0 ∧ (mkLine v hv).rep = c • v

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.iUnion_chartSet
statement:
theorem iUnion_chartSet :
    (⋃ i : Fin (k + 1), chartSet i) = (Set.univ : Set (complexProjectiveSpace R k))

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.insertNth_one_ne_zero
statement:
theorem insertNth_one_ne_zero (i : Fin (k + 1)) (x : Fin k → Ri R) :
    (Fin.insertNth i (1 : Ri R) x : Fin (k + 1) → Ri R) ≠ 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.mkLine_rep
statement:
theorem mkLine_rep (p : complexProjectiveSpace R k) :
    mkLine p.rep p.rep_nonzero = p

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.aeval_aeval_cons_one
statement:
theorem aeval_aeval_cons_one (p : MvPolynomial (Fin (k + 1)) (Ri R)) (x : Fin k → Ri R) :
    aeval x (aeval (Fin.cons (1 : MvPolynomial (Fin k) (Ri R)) X) p)
      = aeval (Fin.cons (1 : Ri R) x) p

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.aeval_smul_isHomogeneous
Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.cons_one_ne_zero
statement:
theorem cons_one_ne_zero (x : Fin k → Ri R) :
    (Fin.cons (1 : Ri R) x : Fin (k + 1) → Ri R) ≠ 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.isNonsingularZero_dehom_iff_isNonsingularProjectiveZero
statement:
theorem isNonsingularZero_dehom_iff_isNonsingularProjectiveZero
    (P : Fin k → MvPolynomial (Fin (k + 1)) (Ri R)) (d : Fin k → ℕ)
    (hP : ∀ i, MvPolynomial.IsHomogeneous (P i) (d i)) (x : Fin k → Ri R) :
    IsNonsingularZero (fun i => aeval (Fin.cons (1 : MvPolynomial (Fin k) (Ri R)) X) (P i)) x ↔
      IsNonsingularProjectiveZero P (mkLine (Fin.cons (1 : Ri R) x) (cons_one_ne_zero x))

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.pderiv_aeval_cons_one
statement:
theorem pderiv_aeval_cons_one
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin (k + 1)) (Ri R)) (a : Fin k) :
    pderiv a (aeval (Fin.cons (1 : MvPolynomial (Fin k) (Ri R)) X) p)
      = aeval (Fin.cons (1 : MvPolynomial (Fin k) (Ri R)) X) (pderiv (Fin.succ a) p)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.rank_eq_iff_det_submatrix_succ_ne_zero
statement:
theorem rank_eq_iff_det_submatrix_succ_ne_zero {F : Type*} [Field F]
    (M : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin (k + 1)) F)
    (hcol : M.col 0 ∈ Submodule.span F (Set.range (M.submatrix id Fin.succ).col)) :
    M.rank = k ↔ (M.submatrix id Fin.succ).det ≠ 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.diagFactor_isHomogeneous
statement:
theorem diagFactor_isHomogeneous (d : ℕ) (i : Fin k) :
    (diagFactor (R := R) d i).IsHomogeneous d

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.diagLinearFactor_isHomogeneous
statement:
theorem diagLinearFactor_isHomogeneous (n : ℕ) (i : Fin k) :
    (X i.succ - C ((n : ℕ) : Ri R) * X 0 : MvPolynomial (Fin (k + 1)) (Ri R)).IsHomogeneous 1

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.homotopyPoly_isHomogeneous
statement:
theorem homotopyPoly_isHomogeneous (P : Fin k → MvPolynomial (Fin (k + 1)) (Ri R)) (d : Fin k → ℕ)
    (hP : ∀ i, (P i).IsHomogeneous (d i)) (lam mu : Ri R) (i : Fin k) :
    (homotopyPoly P d lam mu i).IsHomogeneous (d i)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.aeval_affineFactor
statement:
theorem aeval_affineFactor (d : ℕ) (i : Fin k) (g : Fin k → Ri R) :
    aeval g (affineFactor (R := R) d i) = ∏ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 d, (g i - (n : Ri R))

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.aeval_affineFactor_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem aeval_affineFactor_eq_zero_iff (d : ℕ) (i : Fin k) (g : Fin k → Ri R) :
    aeval g (affineFactor (R := R) d i) = 0 ↔ ∃ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 d, g i = (n : Ri R)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.aeval_cons_one_diagFactor
statement:
theorem aeval_cons_one_diagFactor (d : ℕ) (i : Fin k) :
    aeval (Fin.cons (1 : MvPolynomial (Fin k) (Ri R)) X) (diagFactor (R := R) d i)
      = affineFactor d i

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.aeval_diagFactor
statement:
theorem aeval_diagFactor (d : ℕ) (i : Fin k) (v : Fin (k + 1) → Ri R) :
    aeval v (diagFactor (R := R) d i)
      = ∏ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 d, (v i.succ - (n : Ri R) * v 0)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.aeval_pderiv_affineFactor_ne_zero
statement:
theorem aeval_pderiv_affineFactor_ne_zero (d : ℕ) (i : Fin k) (g : Fin k → Ri R)
    {n₀ : ℕ} (hn₀ : n₀ ∈ Finset.Icc 1 d) (hgi : g i = (n₀ : Ri R)) :
    aeval g (pderiv i (affineFactor (R := R) d i)) ≠ 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.affineSystem_common_zero_eq_piFinset
statement:
theorem affineSystem_common_zero_eq_piFinset (d : Fin k → ℕ) :
    {g : Fin k → Ri R | ∀ i, aeval g (affineSystem (R := R) d i) = 0}
      = ↑(Fintype.piFinset
          (fun i => (Finset.Icc 1 (d i)).image (fun n : ℕ => (n : Ri R))))

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.affineSystem_common_zero_of_projective
statement:
theorem affineSystem_common_zero_of_projective (d : Fin k → ℕ)
    (x : complexProjectiveSpace R k) (hx0 : x.rep 0 ≠ 0)
    (hx : ∀ i, aeval x.rep (diagSystem (R := R) d i) = 0) :
    ∀ i, aeval (chartInv 0 x) (affineSystem (R := R) d i) = 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.diagSystem_common_zero_isNonsingular
statement:
theorem diagSystem_common_zero_isNonsingular (d : Fin k → ℕ) (hd : ∀ i, 1 ≤ d i)
    (x : complexProjectiveSpace R k)
    (hx : ∀ i, MvPolynomial.aeval x.rep (diagSystem (R := R) d i) = 0) :
    IsNonsingularProjectiveZero (diagSystem d) x

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.diagSystem_nonsingularZero_ncard
statement:
theorem diagSystem_nonsingularZero_ncard (d : Fin k → ℕ) (hd : ∀ i, 1 ≤ d i) :
    {x : complexProjectiveSpace R k | IsNonsingularProjectiveZero (diagSystem d) x}.ncard
      = ∏ i, d i

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.diagSystem_rep_zero_ne_zero
statement:
theorem diagSystem_rep_zero_ne_zero (d : Fin k → ℕ) (hd : ∀ i, 1 ≤ d i)
    (x : complexProjectiveSpace R k)
    (hx : ∀ i, aeval x.rep (diagSystem (R := R) d i) = 0) : x.rep 0 ≠ 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.insertNth_zero_eq_cons
statement:
theorem insertNth_zero_eq_cons (g : Fin k → Ri R) :
    Fin.insertNth 0 (1 : Ri R) g = (Fin.cons (1 : Ri R) g : Fin (k + 1) → Ri R)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.isNonsingularProjectiveZero_diagSystem_iff
statement:
theorem isNonsingularProjectiveZero_diagSystem_iff (d : Fin k → ℕ) (hd : ∀ i, 1 ≤ d i)
    (x : complexProjectiveSpace R k) :
    IsNonsingularProjectiveZero (diagSystem (R := R) d) x
      ↔ ∃ g : Fin k → Ri R, (∀ i, aeval g (affineSystem (R := R) d i) = 0) ∧
          mkLine (Fin.cons (1 : Ri R) g) (cons_one_ne_zero g) = x

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.isNonsingularZero_affineSystem
statement:
theorem isNonsingularZero_affineSystem (d : Fin k → ℕ) (g : Fin k → Ri R)
    (hg : ∀ i, aeval g (affineSystem (R := R) d i) = 0) :
    IsNonsingularZero (affineSystem d) g

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.mkLine_cons_one_injective
statement:
theorem mkLine_cons_one_injective :
    Function.Injective (fun g : Fin k → Ri R => mkLine (Fin.cons (1 : Ri R) g) (cons_one_ne_zero g))

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.pderiv_affineFactor_of_ne
statement:
theorem pderiv_affineFactor_of_ne (d : ℕ) (i j : Fin k) (hij : j ≠ i) :
    pderiv j (affineFactor (R := R) d i) = 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.pderiv_prod_eq_zero
statement:
theorem pderiv_prod_eq_zero {ι : Type*} {C : Type*} [CommRing C] {m : ℕ} (j : Fin m)
    (s : Finset ι) (p : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin m) C) (hp : ∀ a ∈ s, pderiv j (p a) = 0) :
    pderiv j (∏ a ∈ s, p a) = 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.IsMultihomogeneous.add
Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.IsMultihomogeneous.eval_blockScale
statement:
theorem IsMultihomogeneous.eval_blockScale {P : MvPolynomial ((i : Fin m) × Fin (k i + 1)) A}
    {d : Fin m → ℕ} (hP : IsMultihomogeneous P d) (c : Fin m → A)
    (v : (i : Fin m) × Fin (k i + 1) → A) :
    MvPolynomial.eval (fun s => c s.1 * v s) P
      = (∏ i, c i ^ d i) * MvPolynomial.eval v P

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.IsMultihomogeneous.mul
Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.isMultihomogeneous_X
statement:
theorem isMultihomogeneous_X [Nontrivial A] (s : (i : Fin m) × Fin (k i + 1)) :
    IsMultihomogeneous (X s : MvPolynomial ((i : Fin m) × Fin (k i + 1)) A)
      (fun i => if i = s.1 then 1 else 0)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.evalCoords_eq_zero_iff_of_mkLine_eq
Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.dehomPoly_eq_sum
statement:
theorem dehomPoly_eq_sum (P : MvPolynomial LineVar (Ri R)) :
    dehomPoly P = ∑ u ∈ P.support, Polynomial.C (P.coeff u) * Polynomial.X ^ (u ⟨0, 1⟩)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.evalCoords_eq_eval_dehomPoly
statement:
theorem evalCoords_eq_eval_dehomPoly
    (P : MvPolynomial LineVar (Ri R)) (t : Ri R) :
    evalCoords (m := 1) (k := fun _ => 1) P (fun _ => ![1, t])
      = Polynomial.eval t (dehomPoly P)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.proj_line_chart
statement:
theorem proj_line_chart (p : Projectivization (Ri R) (Fin 2 → Ri R)) :
    p = mkLine ![0, 1] vec01_ne_zero
    ∨ ∃ t : Ri R, p = mkLine ![1, t] (vec1t_ne_zero t)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.support_eq_lineMonom
Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.vec01_ne_zero
statement: theorem vec01_ne_zero : (![0, 1] : Fin 2 → Ri R) ≠ 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.vec1t_ne_zero
statement: theorem vec1t_ne_zero (t : Ri R) : (![1, t] : Fin 2 → Ri R) ≠ 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.projJacobian_col_mem_span_of_common_zero
Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.projJacobian_rank_lt_iff_forall_det_eq_zero
Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.rank_eq_iff_det_submatrix_succAbove_ne_zero
statement:
theorem rank_eq_iff_det_submatrix_succAbove_ne_zero {F : Type*} [Field F]
    (M : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin (k + 1)) F) (c : Fin (k + 1))
    (hcol : M.col c ∈ Submodule.span F (Set.range (M.submatrix id c.succAbove).col)) :
    M.rank = k ↔ (M.submatrix id c.succAbove).det ≠ 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Elimination.bigDeg_pos
statement: theorem bigDeg_pos : 0 < bigDeg k₁ d

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Elimination.bound_le_bigDeg
statement: theorem bound_le_bigDeg : bound k₁ d ≤ bigDeg k₁ d

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Elimination.bound_pos
statement: theorem bound_pos : 0 < bound k₁ d

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Elimination.coeff_polyOfVec
statement:
theorem coeff_polyOfVec {N : ℕ} (t : Mon k₁ N → C) (β : Mon k₁ N) :
    (polyOfVec t).coeff β.val = t β

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Elimination.d_le_bigDeg
statement: theorem d_le_bigDeg (i : Fin s) : d i ≤ bigDeg k₁ d

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Elimination.d_le_bound
statement: theorem d_le_bound (i : Fin s) : d i ≤ bound k₁ d

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Elimination.elimMatrixAt_apply
statement:
theorem elimMatrixAt_apply (y : Fin (k₂ + 1) → C) (α : Mon k₁ (bigDeg k₁ d))
    (cc : Σ i : Fin s, Mon k₁ (bigDeg k₁ d - d i)) :
    elimMatrixAt d p y α cc = (gen d p y cc).coeff α.val

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Elimination.elimMatrix_isHomogeneous
statement:
theorem elimMatrix_isHomogeneous (e : Fin s → ℕ)
    (he : ∀ i γ, ((p i).coeff γ).IsHomogeneous (e i))
    (α : Mon k₁ (bigDeg k₁ d)) (c : Σ i : Fin s, Mon k₁ (bigDeg k₁ d - d i)) :
    (elimMatrix d p α c).IsHomogeneous (e c.1)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Elimination.eval_minor
statement:
theorem eval_minor (y : Fin (k₂ + 1) → C)
    (f : Mon k₁ (bigDeg k₁ d) ↪ (Σ i : Fin s, Mon k₁ (bigDeg k₁ d - d i))) :
    eval y (Minor d p f) = ((elimMatrixAt d p y).submatrix id f).det

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Elimination.forall_mem_minors_iff
statement:
theorem forall_mem_minors_iff (y : Fin (k₂ + 1) → C) :
    (∀ Q ∈ minors d p, eval y Q = 0) ↔ ∀ f, eval y (Minor d p f) = 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Elimination.gen_isHomogeneous
statement:
theorem gen_isHomogeneous (hd : ∀ i, (p i).IsHomogeneous (d i)) (y : Fin (k₂ + 1) → C)
    (cc : Σ i : Fin s, Mon k₁ (bigDeg k₁ d - d i)) :
    (gen d p y cc).IsHomogeneous (bigDeg k₁ d)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Elimination.homog_coeff_ext
Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Elimination.map_eval_isHomogeneous
statement:
theorem map_eval_isHomogeneous (hd : ∀ i, (p i).IsHomogeneous (d i)) (y : Fin (k₂ + 1) → C)
    (i : Fin s) : (map (eval y) (p i)).IsHomogeneous (d i)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Elimination.minors_homogeneous
statement:
theorem minors_homogeneous (e : Fin s → ℕ)
    (he : ∀ i γ, ((p i).coeff γ).IsHomogeneous (e i)) :
    ∀ Q ∈ minors d p, ∃ m, Q.IsHomogeneous m

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Elimination.mulVecLin_eq
statement:
theorem mulVecLin_eq (y : Fin (k₂ + 1) → C)
    (c : (Σ i : Fin s, Mon k₁ (bigDeg k₁ d - d i)) → C) (α : Mon k₁ (bigDeg k₁ d)) :
    (elimMatrixAt d p y).mulVecLin c α = (∑ cc, c cc • gen d p y cc).coeff α.val

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Elimination.not_surjAt_iff_forall_minor
statement:
theorem not_surjAt_iff_forall_minor (y : Fin (k₂ + 1) → C) :
    ¬ SurjAt d p y ↔ ∀ f, eval y (Minor d p f) = 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Elimination.only_zero_of_homog_le
statement:
theorem only_zero_of_homog_le (y : Fin (k₂ + 1) → C)
    (hle : homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (k₁ + 1)) C (bigDeg k₁ d) ≤
        Submodule.span C (Set.range (gen d p y)))
    (x : Fin (k₁ + 1) → C) (hx : ∀ i, eval x (map (eval y) (p i)) = 0) : x = 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Elimination.polyOfVec_isHomogeneous
statement:
theorem polyOfVec_isHomogeneous {N : ℕ} (t : Mon k₁ N → C) :
    (polyOfVec t).IsHomogeneous N

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Elimination.poly_mul_Pval_mem
statement:
theorem poly_mul_Pval_mem (y : Fin (k₂ + 1) → C) (Q : MvPolynomial (Fin (k₁ + 1)) C) (j : Fin s)
    (hQ : Q.IsHomogeneous (bigDeg k₁ d - d j)) :
    Q * map (eval y) (p j) ∈ Submodule.span C (Set.range (gen d p y))

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Elimination.sum_gen_isHomogeneous
statement:
theorem sum_gen_isHomogeneous (hd : ∀ i, (p i).IsHomogeneous (d i)) (y : Fin (k₂ + 1) → C)
    (c : (Σ i : Fin s, Mon k₁ (bigDeg k₁ d - d i)) → C) :
    (∑ cc, c cc • gen d p y cc).IsHomogeneous (bigDeg k₁ d)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Elimination.surjAt_iff_homog_le
statement:
theorem surjAt_iff_homog_le (hd : ∀ i, (p i).IsHomogeneous (d i)) (y : Fin (k₂ + 1) → C) :
    SurjAt d p y ↔
      homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (k₁ + 1)) C (bigDeg k₁ d) ≤
        Submodule.span C (Set.range (gen d p y))

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Theorem_4_103.blockVecPt_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem blockVecPt_one (k : Fin 2 → ℕ) (x₀ : complexProjectiveSpace R (k 0))
    (y₁ : complexProjectiveSpace R (k 1)) : blockVecPt k x₀ y₁ 1 = y₁

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Theorem_4_103.blockVecPt_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem blockVecPt_zero (k : Fin 2 → ℕ) (x₀ : complexProjectiveSpace R (k 0))
    (y₁ : complexProjectiveSpace R (k 1)) : blockVecPt k x₀ y₁ 0 = x₀

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Theorem_4_103.blockVec_ne_zero

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Theorem_4_103.blockVec_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem blockVec_one (k : Fin 2 → ℕ) (a : Fin (k 0 + 1) → Ri R)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Theorem_4_103.blockVec_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem blockVec_zero (k : Fin 2 → ℕ) (a : Fin (k 0 + 1) → Ri R)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Theorem_4_103.e1_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem e1_apply (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 1)) : e1 n j = ⟨0, j⟩

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Theorem_4_103.eval_split
statement:
theorem eval_split (k : Fin 2 → ℕ) (P : MvPolynomial ((i : Fin 2) × Fin (k i + 1)) (Ri R))
    (v : (i : Fin 2) → (Fin (k i + 1) → Ri R)) :
    eval (v 0) (map (eval (v 1)) (split k P)) = evalCoords P v

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Theorem_4_103.eval_split_blockVec
statement:
theorem eval_split_blockVec {k : Fin 2 → ℕ}
    (P : MvPolynomial ((i : Fin 2) × Fin (k i + 1)) (Ri R)) (a : Fin (k 0 + 1) → Ri R)
    (b : Fin (k 1 + 1) → Ri R) :
    eval a (map (eval b) (split k P)) = evalCoords P (blockVec k a b)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Theorem_4_103.eval_sumToIter
statement:
theorem eval_sumToIter {S₁ S₂ : Type*} (a : S₁ → C) (b : S₂ → C)
    (P : MvPolynomial (S₁ ⊕ S₂) C) :
    eval a (map (eval b) (sumRingEquiv C S₁ S₂ P)) = eval (Sum.elim a b) P

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Theorem_4_103.exists_line_iff_exists_nonzero
statement:
theorem exists_line_iff_exists_nonzero {k : Fin 2 → ℕ}
    (Ps : Finset (MvPolynomial ((i : Fin 2) × Fin (k i + 1)) (Ri R)))
    (hPs : ∀ P ∈ Ps, ∃ dd : Fin 2 → ℕ, IsMultihomogeneous P dd)
    (y₁ : complexProjectiveSpace R (k 1)) :
    (∃ x₀ : complexProjectiveSpace R (k 0),
        ∀ P ∈ Ps, eval (x₀).rep (map (eval y₁.rep) (split k P)) = 0)
      ↔ (∃ z : Fin (k 0 + 1) → Ri R, z ≠ 0 ∧
          ∀ P ∈ Ps, eval z (map (eval y₁.rep) (split k P)) = 0)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Theorem_4_103.projVanishes_iff_eval_split
statement:
theorem projVanishes_iff_eval_split {k : Fin 2 → ℕ}
    (P : MvPolynomial ((i : Fin 2) × Fin (k i + 1)) (Ri R))
    (x : (i : Fin 2) → complexProjectiveSpace R (k i)) :
    ProjVanishes P x ↔
      eval (x 0).rep (map (eval (x 1).rep) (split k P)) = 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Theorem_4_103.projVanishes_rename_e1
statement:
theorem projVanishes_rename_e1 {n : ℕ} (Q : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) (Ri R))
    (y : (i : Fin 1) → complexProjectiveSpace R n) :
    ProjVanishes (k := fun _ : Fin 1 => n) (rename (e1 n) Q) y ↔ eval (y 0).rep Q = 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Theorem_4_103.sumElim_σequiv
statement:
theorem sumElim_σequiv (k : Fin 2 → ℕ) (a : Fin (k 0 + 1) → Ri R) (b : Fin (k 1 + 1) → Ri R)
    (v : (i : Fin 2) → (Fin (k i + 1) → Ri R)) (ha : v 0 = a) (hb : v 1 = b) :
    (fun s : (i : Fin 2) × Fin (k i + 1) => (Sum.elim a b) (σequiv k s)) = fun s => v s.1 s.2

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Theorem_4_103.σequiv_apply_one
statement:
theorem σequiv_apply_one (k : Fin 2 → ℕ) (j : Fin (k 1 + 1)) :

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Theorem_4_103.σequiv_symm_inr

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.SingularLocus.aeval_eq_eval

theorem aeval_eq_eval (x : Fin (k + 1) → Ri R) (Q : MvPolynomial (Fin (k + 1)) (Ri R)) :

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.SingularLocus.evalCoords_Hpoly
statement:
theorem evalCoords_Hpoly (P : Fin k → MvPolynomial (Fin (k + 1)) (Ri R)) (d : Fin k → ℕ)
    (xp : (i : Fin 2) → complexProjectiveSpace R (kk k i)) (i : Fin k) :
    evalCoords (Hpoly P d i) (fun i => (xp i).rep)
      = aeval (xp 0).rep (homotopyPoly P d ((xp 1).rep 0) ((xp 1).rep 1) i)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.SingularLocus.evalCoords_entryPoly
statement:
theorem evalCoords_entryPoly (P : Fin k → MvPolynomial (Fin (k + 1)) (Ri R)) (d : Fin k → ℕ)
    (xp : (i : Fin 2) → complexProjectiveSpace R (kk k i)) (i : Fin k) (j : Fin (k + 1)) :
    evalCoords (entryPoly P d i j) (fun i => (xp i).rep)
      = (projJacobian (homotopyPoly P d ((xp 1).rep 0) ((xp 1).rep 1)) (xp 0)) i j

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.SingularLocus.evalCoords_minorPoly
statement:
theorem evalCoords_minorPoly (P : Fin k → MvPolynomial (Fin (k + 1)) (Ri R)) (d : Fin k → ℕ)
    (xp : (i : Fin 2) → complexProjectiveSpace R (kk k i)) (c : Fin (k + 1)) :
    evalCoords (minorPoly P d c) (fun i => (xp i).rep)
      = ((projJacobian (homotopyPoly P d ((xp 1).rep 0) ((xp 1).rep 1)) (xp 0)).submatrix
          id c.succAbove).det

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.SingularLocus.eval_rename_emb0
statement:
theorem eval_rename_emb0 (xp : (i : Fin 2) → complexProjectiveSpace R (kk k i))
    (Q : MvPolynomial (Fin (k + 1)) (Ri R)) :
    eval (fun s : Sig k => (xp s.1).rep s.2) (rename (emb0 k) Q)
      = eval (xp 0).rep Q

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.SingularLocus.isMultihomogeneous_det

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.realEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
theorem realEquiv_symm_apply (w : Fin (k + k) → R) (j : Fin k) :

      AdjoinRoot.of (X ^ 2 + 1 : R[X]) (w (Fin.castAdd k j))
        + AdjoinRoot.of (X ^ 2 + 1 : R[X]) (w (Fin.natAdd k j)) * Ri.i R

name: Azurite.BPR.MvPolynomial.bitsize_coeff_mul_le
statement:
theorem MvPolynomial.bitsize_coeff_mul_le :
    ∀ (k : ℕ) (P Q : MvPolynomial (Fin k) ℤ) (τ σ q : ℕ),

    (∀ m, (Q.coeff m).natAbs.size ≤ σ) →
    MvPolynomial.totalDegree Q ≤ q →
    ∀ m, ((P * Q).coeff m).natAbs.size ≤ τ + σ + k * Nat.size (q + 1)

name: Polynomial.horSpecial_natDegree_eq_eval
statement:
theorem Polynomial.horSpecial_natDegree_eq_eval {K : Type*} [Field K]
    (P : K[X]) (b c : K) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    P.horSpecial b c P.natDegree = c ^ P.natDegree * P.eval (b * c⁻¹)

name: Polynomial.horSpecial_zero
statement:
theorem Polynomial.horSpecial_zero (P : R[X]) (b c : R) :
    P.horSpecial b c 0 = P.leadingCoeff

name: Polynomial.horner_natDegree

theorem Polynomial.horner_natDegree (P : R[X]) :

name: Polynomial.horner_zero
statement:
theorem Polynomial.horner_zero (P : R[X]) :

name: Polynomial.specialTrans_eq_horner_comp
statement:
theorem Polynomial.specialTrans_eq_horner_comp {K : Type*} [Field K]
    (P : K[X]) (b c : K) (hc : c ≠ 0) (i : ℕ) :
    P.specialTrans b c i =
      C (c ^ i) * (P.horner i).comp (X - C (b * c⁻¹))

name: Polynomial.specialTrans_zero
statement:
theorem Polynomial.specialTrans_zero (P : R[X]) (b c : R) :

name: Azurite.BPR.Matrix.totalDegree_mvList_prod_le_per_matrix
statement:
theorem Matrix.totalDegree_mvList_prod_le_per_matrix
    {k : ℕ} {ν : Type _} [Fintype ν] [DecidableEq ν] :

name: Azurite.BPR.MvPolynomial.bitsize_coeff_list_prod_le_bpr_8_2
statement:
theorem MvPolynomial.bitsize_coeff_list_prod_le_bpr_8_2 :
    ∀ (ℓ k : ℕ) (Ps : List (MvPolynomial (Fin ℓ) (MvPolynomial (Fin k) ℤ)))
      (τ p q : ℕ),
    Ps ≠ [] →
    (∀ P ∈ Ps, ∀ y x, ((P.coeff y).coeff x).natAbs.size ≤ τ) →
    (∀ P ∈ Ps, P.totalDegree ≤ q) →
    (∀ P ∈ Ps, ∀ y, (P.coeff y).totalDegree ≤ p) →
    ∀ y x, (((Ps.prod).coeff y).coeff x).natAbs.size ≤
      Ps.length * (τ + k * Nat.size p + ℓ * Nat.size q)

name: Azurite.BPR.MvPolynomial.bitsize_coeff_list_prod_le_bpr_exact
statement:
theorem MvPolynomial.bitsize_coeff_list_prod_le_bpr_exact :
    ∀ (k : ℕ) (Ps : List (MvPolynomial (Fin k) ℤ)) (τs ps : List ℕ),
    Ps ≠ [] →
    List.Forall₂ (fun P τ => ∀ r, (P.coeff r).natAbs.size ≤ τ) Ps τs →
    List.Forall₂ (fun P p => P.totalDegree ≤ p) Ps ps →
    ∀ r, ((Ps.prod).coeff r).natAbs.size ≤
      τs.sum + k * (ps.map fun p => Nat.size p).sum

Azurite.BPR.substitute_eq_sum
statement:
theorem substitute_eq_sum
    (P : MvPolynomial (Fin k) (MvPolynomial (Fin ℓ) ℤ))
    (Q : Fin k → MvPolynomial (Fin ℓ) (MvPolynomial (Fin m) ℤ)) :
    substitute P Q =
      ∑ α ∈ P.support,
        (MvPolynomial.map MvPolynomial.C (P.coeff α)) * ∏ i, (Q i) ^ (α i)

name: Azurite.BPR.proposition_8_14
Azurite.BPR.proposition_8_15
statement:
theorem proposition_8_15 (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) (MvPolynomial (Fin k) ℤ)) {d τ : ℕ}
    (hn : 0 < n)
    (hd : ∀ i j, (M i j).totalDegree ≤ d)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.isNonDefective_iff_sRes_ne_zero
statement:
theorem isNonDefective_iff_sRes_ne_zero (P Q : D[X]) (hpq : Q.natDegree < P.natDegree)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.leadingCoeff_sResP_eq_sRes
Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.pdetRing_Q_shifts
statement:
theorem pdetRing_Q_shifts {m n : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hmn : m ≤ n) (Q : D[X]) (hQ0 : Q ≠ 0)
    (hq : Q.natDegree + m = n) :

theorem pdetRing_single {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (R : D[X]) (hR : R.natDegree < n) :

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.pdetRing_single_of_eq
statement:
theorem pdetRing_single_of_eq {m n : ℕ} (hm : m = 1) (hn : 0 < n) (R : Fin m → D[X])
    (hR : (R ⟨0, by omega⟩).natDegree < n) : pdetRing n R = R ⟨0, by omega⟩

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.sResP_degree_le
statement:
theorem sResP_degree_le (P Q : D[X]) (hpq : Q.natDegree < P.natDegree)
    {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ Q.natDegree) :
    (sResP P Q j).degree ≤ (j : WithBot ℕ)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.sResP_eq_of_natDegree
statement:
theorem sResP_eq_of_natDegree (P Q : D[X]) (hpq : Q.natDegree < P.natDegree) (hQ0 : Q ≠ 0) :
    sResP P Q Q.natDegree
      = (ε (P.natDegree - Q.natDegree) : ℤ)
        • (C (Q.leadingCoeff ^ (P.natDegree - Q.natDegree - 1)) * Q)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.sResP_eq_self
statement:
theorem sResP_eq_self (P Q : D[X]) (hpq : Q.natDegree < P.natDegree) :
    sResP P Q P.natDegree = P

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.sResP_eq_self_Q
statement:
theorem sResP_eq_self_Q (P Q : D[X]) (hpq : Q.natDegree + 1 < P.natDegree) :
    sResP P Q (P.natDegree - 1) = Q

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.sResP_eq_zero
statement:
theorem sResP_eq_zero (P Q : D[X]) {j : ℕ} (h1 : Q.natDegree < j)
    (h2 : j ≠ P.natDegree) (h3 : j ≠ P.natDegree - 1) :
    sResP P Q j = 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.sRes_natDegree
statement:
theorem sRes_natDegree (P Q : D[X]) (hpq : Q.natDegree < P.natDegree) (hQ0 : Q ≠ 0) :
    Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sRes P Q Q.natDegree
      = (ε (P.natDegree - Q.natDegree) : ℤ) • Q.leadingCoeff ^ (P.natDegree - Q.natDegree)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.pdetRing_congr_cast
statement:
theorem pdetRing_congr_cast {m m' n : ℕ} (hm : m = m') (f : Fin m → D[X]) (g : Fin m' → D[X])
    (h : ∀ i : Fin m, f i = g (Fin.cast hm i)) : pdetRing n f = pdetRing n g

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.pdetRing_eq_zero_of_degree_lt
statement:
theorem pdetRing_eq_zero_of_degree_lt {m n : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) (P : Fin m → D[X])
    (hdeg : ∀ r, (P r).degree < (↑(n - 1) : WithBot ℕ)) : pdetRing n P = 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.pdetRing_neg_rows
statement:
theorem pdetRing_neg_rows {m n : ℕ} (P : Fin m → D[X]) (s : Finset (Fin m)) :
    pdetRing n (fun r => if r ∈ s then -(P r) else P r) = (-1 : ℤ) ^ s.card • pdetRing n P

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.pdetRing_update_add_combination
statement:
theorem pdetRing_update_add_combination {m n : ℕ} (P : Fin m → D[X]) (j : Fin m)
    (s : Finset (Fin m)) (lam : Fin m → D) :
    j ∉ s → pdetRing n (Function.update P j (P j + ∑ i ∈ s, lam i • P i)) = pdetRing n P

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.pdetRing_update_add_combination'
statement:
theorem pdetRing_update_add_combination' {m n : ℕ} {ι : Type*} (P : Fin m → D[X]) (j : Fin m)
    (t : Finset ι) (idx : ι → Fin m) (lam : ι → D) :
    (∀ a ∈ t, idx a ≠ j) →
      pdetRing n (Function.update P j (P j + ∑ a ∈ t, lam a • P (idx a))) = pdetRing n P

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.pdetRing_update_add_smul
statement:
theorem pdetRing_update_add_smul {m n : ℕ} (P : Fin m → D[X]) {i j : Fin m} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (c : D) : pdetRing n (Function.update P i (P i + c • P j)) = pdetRing n P

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.pdetRing_update_neg
statement:
theorem pdetRing_update_neg {m n : ℕ} (P : Fin m → D[X]) (j : Fin m) :
    pdetRing n (Function.update P j (-P j)) = -pdetRing n P

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.pdetRing_update_smul
statement:
theorem pdetRing_update_smul {m n : ℕ} (P : Fin m → D[X]) (j : Fin m) (s : D) :
    pdetRing n (Function.update P j (s • P j)) = s • pdetRing n P

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.Aseq_qm1
statement:
theorem Aseq_qm1 (P Q : K[X]) (hQ : Q ≠ 0) (hR0 : P % Q ≠ 0)
    (hpq : Q.natDegree < P.natDegree) (hq1 : 1 ≤ Q.natDegree) :
    pdetRing (P.natDegree + Q.natDegree - (Q.natDegree - 1)) (Aseq P Q (Q.natDegree - 1))
      = -(Q.leadingCoeff ^ (P.natDegree - Q.natDegree + 1) • (P % Q))

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.Aseq_triangular
statement:
theorem Aseq_triangular (P Q : K[X]) (hQ : Q ≠ 0) (hR0 : P % Q ≠ 0)
    (hpq : Q.natDegree < P.natDegree) (j : ℕ) (_hj : j < Q.natDegree - 1)
    (hjr : j ≤ (P % Q).natDegree) :
    pdetRing (P.natDegree + Q.natDegree - j) (Aseq P Q j)
      = Q.leadingCoeff ^ (P.natDegree - (P % Q).natDegree) • sResP Q (-(P % Q)) j

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.Aseq_zero
statement:
theorem Aseq_zero (P Q : K[X]) (hQ : Q ≠ 0) (hR0 : P % Q ≠ 0)
    (hpq : Q.natDegree < P.natDegree) (j : ℕ) (hj : j < Q.natDegree - 1)
    (hjr : (P % Q).natDegree < j) :
    pdetRing (P.natDegree + Q.natDegree - j) (Aseq P Q j) = 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.pdetRing_replaceUpTo_eq
statement:
theorem pdetRing_replaceUpTo_eq (P Q : K[X]) (hQ : Q ≠ 0) (hpq : Q.natDegree < P.natDegree)
    (j : ℕ) (hj : j < Q.natDegree) :
    pdetRing (P.natDegree + Q.natDegree - j) (replaceUpTo P Q j (Q.natDegree - j))
      = pdetRing (P.natDegree + Q.natDegree - j) (replaceUpTo P Q j 0)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.proposition_8_39
statement:
theorem proposition_8_39 (P Q : K[X]) (hQ : Q ≠ 0) (hR0 : P % Q ≠ 0)
    (hpq : Q.natDegree < P.natDegree) (j : ℕ) (hj : j < Q.natDegree - 1) :
    sResP P Q j = (ε (P.natDegree - Q.natDegree) : ℤ)
      • (Q.leadingCoeff ^ (P.natDegree - (P % Q).natDegree) • sResP Q (-(P % Q)) j)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.quotient_natDegree_le
statement:
theorem quotient_natDegree_le (P Q : K[X]) (hQ : Q ≠ 0) (hpq : Q.natDegree < P.natDegree) :
    (P / Q).natDegree ≤ P.natDegree - Q.natDegree

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.rem_C_mul
statement: theorem rem_C_mul (c : K) (P Q : K[X]) : (C c * P) % Q = C c * (P % Q)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.sResP_eq_eps_smul_Aseq
statement:
theorem sResP_eq_eps_smul_Aseq (P Q : K[X]) (hQ : Q ≠ 0) (hpq : Q.natDegree < P.natDegree)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.sResP_natDegree_sub_one
statement:
theorem sResP_natDegree_sub_one (P Q : K[X]) (hQ : Q ≠ 0) (hR0 : P % Q ≠ 0)
    (hpq : Q.natDegree < P.natDegree) (hq1 : 1 ≤ Q.natDegree) :
    sResP P Q (Q.natDegree - 1)
      = -((ε (P.natDegree - Q.natDegree) : ℤ)
          • (Q.leadingCoeff ^ (P.natDegree - Q.natDegree + 1) • (P % Q)))

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.sResP_natDegree_sub_one_rem
statement:
theorem sResP_natDegree_sub_one_rem (P Q : K[X]) (hQ : Q ≠ 0) (hR0 : P % Q ≠ 0)
    (hpq : Q.natDegree + 1 < P.natDegree) (hq1 : 1 ≤ Q.natDegree) :
    sResP P Q (Q.natDegree - 1)
      = -((C (Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sRes P Q Q.natDegree)
            * C (sResP P Q (P.natDegree - 1)).leadingCoeff
            * sResP P Q P.natDegree) % sResP P Q (P.natDegree - 1))

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.general_lhs_transport
statement:
theorem general_lhs_transport (P Q : K[X]) (hQ : Q ≠ 0) (hR0 : P % Q ≠ 0)
    (hpq : Q.natDegree < P.natDegree) {i j k : ℕ} (hjr : j ≤ (P % Q).natDegree)
    (hi1 : i - 1 < Q.natDegree - 1) (hk1 : k - 1 < Q.natDegree - 1) :
    C (Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sRes P Q j) * C (sResP P Q (i - 1)).leadingCoeff * sResP P Q (k - 1)
      = (((ε (P.natDegree - Q.natDegree) : ℤ) : K)
          * Q.leadingCoeff ^ (3 * (P.natDegree - (P % Q).natDegree)))
        • (C (Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sRes Q (-(P % Q)) j)
            * C (sResP Q (-(P % Q)) (i - 1)).leadingCoeff * sResP Q (-(P % Q)) (k - 1))

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.general_recurrence_transport
statement:
theorem general_recurrence_transport (P Q : K[X]) (hQ : Q ≠ 0) (hR0 : P % Q ≠ 0)
    (hpq : Q.natDegree < P.natDegree) {i j k : ℕ}
    (hjr : j ≤ (P % Q).natDegree) (hkr : k ≤ (P % Q).natDegree)
    (hi1 : i - 1 < Q.natDegree - 1) (hj1 : j - 1 < Q.natDegree - 1) (hk1 : k - 1 < Q.natDegree - 1)
    (hrec : C (Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sRes Q (-(P % Q)) j)
          * C (sResP Q (-(P % Q)) (i - 1)).leadingCoeff * sResP Q (-(P % Q)) (k - 1)
        = -((C (Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sRes Q (-(P % Q)) k)
            * C (sResP Q (-(P % Q)) (j - 1)).leadingCoeff
            * sResP Q (-(P % Q)) (i - 1)) % sResP Q (-(P % Q)) (j - 1))) :
    C (Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sRes P Q j) * C (sResP P Q (i - 1)).leadingCoeff * sResP P Q (k - 1)
      = -((C (Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sRes P Q k) * C (sResP P Q (j - 1)).leadingCoeff
          * sResP P Q (i - 1)) % sResP P Q (j - 1))

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.general_rhs_transport
statement:
theorem general_rhs_transport (P Q : K[X]) (hQ : Q ≠ 0) (hR0 : P % Q ≠ 0)
    (hpq : Q.natDegree < P.natDegree) {i j k : ℕ} (hkr : k ≤ (P % Q).natDegree)
    (hj1 : j - 1 < Q.natDegree - 1) (hi1 : i - 1 < Q.natDegree - 1) :
    -((C (Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sRes P Q k) * C (sResP P Q (j - 1)).leadingCoeff
          * sResP P Q (i - 1)) % sResP P Q (j - 1))
      = (((ε (P.natDegree - Q.natDegree) : ℤ) : K)
          * Q.leadingCoeff ^ (3 * (P.natDegree - (P % Q).natDegree)))
        • (-((C (Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sRes Q (-(P % Q)) k)
            * C (sResP Q (-(P % Q)) (j - 1)).leadingCoeff
            * sResP Q (-(P % Q)) (i - 1)) % sResP Q (-(P % Q)) (j - 1)))

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.leadingCoeff_sResP_natDegree_sub_one_swap
statement:
theorem leadingCoeff_sResP_natDegree_sub_one_swap (P Q : K[X]) (hQ : Q ≠ 0) (hR0 : P % Q ≠ 0)
    (hpq : Q.natDegree < P.natDegree) (hq1 : 1 ≤ Q.natDegree) :

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.leadingCoeff_sResP_swap
statement:
theorem leadingCoeff_sResP_swap (P Q : K[X]) (hQ : Q ≠ 0) (hR0 : P % Q ≠ 0)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.recurrence_lhs_transport
statement:
theorem recurrence_lhs_transport (P Q : K[X]) (hQ : Q ≠ 0) (hR0 : P % Q ≠ 0)
    (hpq : Q.natDegree < P.natDegree) (hq1 : 1 ≤ Q.natDegree)
    (hr'lt : (Q % (-(P % Q))).natDegree - 1 < Q.natDegree - 1) :
    C (Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sRes P Q (P % Q).natDegree)
        * C (sResP P Q (Q.natDegree - 1)).leadingCoeff
        * sResP P Q ((Q % (-(P % Q))).natDegree - 1)
      = (((ε (P.natDegree - Q.natDegree) : ℤ) : K)
          * Q.leadingCoeff ^ (2 * (P.natDegree - (P % Q).natDegree)
              + (P.natDegree - Q.natDegree + 1)))
        • (C (Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sRes Q (-(P % Q)) (P % Q).natDegree)
            * C (sResP Q (-(P % Q)) (Q.natDegree - 1)).leadingCoeff
            * sResP Q (-(P % Q)) ((Q % (-(P % Q))).natDegree - 1))

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.recurrence_rhs_transport
statement:
theorem recurrence_rhs_transport (P Q : K[X]) (hQ : Q ≠ 0) (hR0 : P % Q ≠ 0)
    (hpq : Q.natDegree < P.natDegree) (hq1 : 1 ≤ Q.natDegree)
    (hr'r : (Q % (-(P % Q))).natDegree ≤ (P % Q).natDegree)
    (hr1lt : (P % Q).natDegree - 1 < Q.natDegree - 1) :
    -((C (Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sRes P Q (Q % (-(P % Q))).natDegree)
          * C (sResP P Q ((P % Q).natDegree - 1)).leadingCoeff
          * sResP P Q (Q.natDegree - 1)) % sResP P Q ((P % Q).natDegree - 1))
      = (((ε (P.natDegree - Q.natDegree) : ℤ) : K)
          * Q.leadingCoeff ^ (2 * (P.natDegree - (P % Q).natDegree)
              + (P.natDegree - Q.natDegree + 1)))
        • (-((C (Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sRes Q (-(P % Q)) (Q % (-(P % Q))).natDegree)
            * C (sResP Q (-(P % Q)) ((P % Q).natDegree - 1)).leadingCoeff
            * sResP Q (-(P % Q)) (Q.natDegree - 1)) % sResP Q (-(P % Q)) ((P % Q).natDegree - 1)))

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.recurrence_transport
statement:
theorem recurrence_transport (P Q : K[X]) (hQ : Q ≠ 0) (hR0 : P % Q ≠ 0)
    (hpq : Q.natDegree < P.natDegree) (hq1 : 1 ≤ Q.natDegree)
    (hr'r : (Q % (-(P % Q))).natDegree ≤ (P % Q).natDegree)
    (hr'lt : (Q % (-(P % Q))).natDegree - 1 < Q.natDegree - 1)
    (hr1lt : (P % Q).natDegree - 1 < Q.natDegree - 1)
    (hrec : C (Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sRes Q (-(P % Q)) (P % Q).natDegree)
          * C (sResP Q (-(P % Q)) (Q.natDegree - 1)).leadingCoeff
          * sResP Q (-(P % Q)) ((Q % (-(P % Q))).natDegree - 1)
        = -((C (Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sRes Q (-(P % Q)) (Q % (-(P % Q))).natDegree)
            * C (sResP Q (-(P % Q)) ((P % Q).natDegree - 1)).leadingCoeff
            * sResP Q (-(P % Q)) (Q.natDegree - 1)) % sResP Q (-(P % Q)) ((P % Q).natDegree - 1))) :
    C (Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sRes P Q (P % Q).natDegree)
        * C (sResP P Q (Q.natDegree - 1)).leadingCoeff

Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.sResP_inductive_step_identity
statement:
theorem sResP_inductive_step_identity (P Q : K[X]) (hQ : Q ≠ 0) (hR0 : P % Q ≠ 0)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.sResP_natDegree_gcd_ne_zero
statement:
theorem sResP_natDegree_gcd_ne_zero (P Q : K[X]) (hP : P ≠ 0) (hQ : Q ≠ 0)
    (hpq : Q.natDegree < P.natDegree) : sResP P Q (gcd P Q).natDegree ≠ 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.sResP_natDegree_sub_one_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem sResP_natDegree_sub_one_eq_zero_iff (P Q : K[X]) (hP : P ≠ 0) (hQ : Q ≠ 0)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.sResP_natDegree_sub_one_propto
statement:
theorem sResP_natDegree_sub_one_propto (P Q : K[X]) (hQ : Q ≠ 0) (hR0 : P % Q ≠ 0)
    (hpq : Q.natDegree < P.natDegree) (hq1 : 1 ≤ Q.natDegree) :
    sResP P Q (Q.natDegree - 1)
      = (ε (P.natDegree - Q.natDegree) : ℤ)
        • (Q.leadingCoeff ^ (P.natDegree - Q.natDegree + 1)
            • sResP Q (-(P % Q)) (Q.natDegree - 1))

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.sResP_natDegree_sub_one_rem'
statement:
theorem sResP_natDegree_sub_one_rem' (P Q : K[X]) (hQ : Q ≠ 0) (hR0 : P % Q ≠ 0)
    (hpq : Q.natDegree < P.natDegree) (hq1 : 1 ≤ Q.natDegree) :

            * C (sResP P Q (P.natDegree - 1)).leadingCoeff
            * sResP P Q P.natDegree) % sResP P Q (P.natDegree - 1))

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.sResP_pred_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem sResP_pred_eq_zero_iff (P Q : K[X]) (hP : P ≠ 0) (hQ : Q ≠ 0)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.sResP_propto_le_r
statement:
theorem sResP_propto_le_r (P Q : K[X]) (hQ : Q ≠ 0) (hR0 : P % Q ≠ 0)
    (hpq : Q.natDegree < P.natDegree) {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ (P % Q).natDegree) :

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.sResP_recurrence_step
statement:
theorem sResP_recurrence_step (P Q : K[X]) (hQ : Q ≠ 0) (hR0 : P % Q ≠ 0)
    (hpq : Q.natDegree < P.natDegree) (hq1 : 1 ≤ Q.natDegree)
    (hR'0 : Q % (-(P % Q)) ≠ 0) (hr1 : 1 ≤ (P % Q).natDegree)
    (hrq1 : (P % Q).natDegree + 1 < Q.natDegree) (hr'1 : 1 ≤ (Q % (-(P % Q))).natDegree)
    (hr'r1 : (Q % (-(P % Q))).natDegree + 1 < (P % Q).natDegree)
    (hR''0 : (-(P % Q)) % (-(Q % (-(P % Q)))) ≠ 0) :
    C (Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sRes P Q (P % Q).natDegree)
        * C (sResP P Q (Q.natDegree - 1)).leadingCoeff
        * sResP P Q ((Q % (-(P % Q))).natDegree - 1)
      = -((C (Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sRes P Q (Q % (-(P % Q))).natDegree)
          * C (sResP P Q ((P % Q).natDegree - 1)).leadingCoeff
          * sResP P Q (Q.natDegree - 1)) % sResP P Q ((P % Q).natDegree - 1))

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.sResP_step_proportional
statement:
theorem sResP_step_proportional (P Q : K[X]) (hQ : Q ≠ 0) (hR0 : P % Q ≠ 0)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.theorem_8_34
statement:
theorem theorem_8_34 (P Q : K[X]) (hP : P ≠ 0) (hQ : Q ≠ 0)
    (hpq : Q.natDegree < P.natDegree) :
    -- gcd branch (unconditional):
    ((∀ ℓ, ℓ < (gcd P Q).natDegree → sResP P Q ℓ = 0)
        ∧ Associated (sResP P Q (gcd P Q).natDegree) (gcd P Q))
    ∧ -- recurrence branch (any Euclidean step with nonzero remainder):
    (P % Q ≠ 0 →
      (C (Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sRes P Q Q.natDegree)
            * C (sResP P Q (P.natDegree - 1)).leadingCoeff
            * (if (P % Q).natDegree = 0 then 0 else sResP P Q ((P % Q).natDegree - 1))
          = -((C (Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sRes P Q (P % Q).natDegree)
              * C (sResP P Q (Q.natDegree - 1)).leadingCoeff
              * sResP P Q (P.natDegree - 1)) % sResP P Q (Q.natDegree - 1)))
      ∧ (∀ ℓ, (P % Q).natDegree < ℓ → ℓ < Q.natDegree - 1 → sResP P Q ℓ = 0)
      ∧ Associated (sResP P Q (P % Q).natDegree) (sResP P Q (Q.natDegree - 1)))

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.theorem_8_34_gcd_branch
statement:
theorem theorem_8_34_gcd_branch (P Q : K[X]) (hP : P ≠ 0) (hQ : Q ≠ 0)
    (hpq : Q.natDegree < P.natDegree) {j : ℕ} (hj1 : 1 ≤ j) (hjq : j ≤ Q.natDegree)
    (hsRes : Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sRes P Q j ≠ 0) (hzero : sResP P Q (j - 1) = 0) :
    Associated (sResP P Q j) (gcd P Q) ∧ ∀ ℓ, ℓ < j → sResP P Q ℓ = 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.theorem_8_34_gcd_branch_general
statement:
theorem theorem_8_34_gcd_branch_general (P Q : K[X]) (hP : P ≠ 0) (hQ : Q ≠ 0)
    (hpq : Q.natDegree < P.natDegree) {m j : ℕ} (hmq : m ≤ Q.natDegree) (hm : sResP P Q m ≠ 0)
    (hdeg : (sResP P Q m).natDegree = j) (hj1 : 1 ≤ j) (hzero : sResP P Q (j - 1) = 0) :
    Associated (sResP P Q m) (gcd P Q) ∧ ∀ ℓ, ℓ < j → sResP P Q ℓ = 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.sResP_natDegree_realized
statement:
theorem sResP_natDegree_realized (P Q : K[X]) (hP : P ≠ 0) (hQ : Q ≠ 0)
    (hpq : Q.natDegree < P.natDegree) (hq1 : 1 ≤ Q.natDegree) {n : ℕ}

    (sResP P Q (sResP P Q n).natDegree).natDegree = (sResP P Q n).natDegree

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.corollary_8_36
statement:
theorem corollary_8_36 (P Q : K[X]) (hP : P ≠ 0) (hQ : Q ≠ 0)
    (hpq : Q.natDegree < P.natDegree)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.corollary_8_37
statement:
theorem corollary_8_37 (P Q : K[X]) (hP : P ≠ 0) (hQ : Q ≠ 0)
    (hpq : Q.natDegree < P.natDegree)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.corollary_8_38
statement:
theorem corollary_8_38 (P Q : K[X]) (hP : P ≠ 0) (hQ : Q ≠ 0)
    (hpq : Q.natDegree < P.natDegree) (hq1 : 1 ≤ Q.natDegree)
    {ℓ : ℕ} (hℓ1 : 1 ≤ ℓ) (hℓne : SRemS P Q ℓ ≠ 0) :
