name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.cofactorMat_mulVec
statement:
theorem cofactorMat_mulVec (P Q : D[X]) (hQ : Q ≠ 0) (hpq : Q.natDegree < P.natDegree)
    {i j : ℕ} (hiq : i - 1 ≤ Q.natDegree) (hjq : j - 1 ≤ Q.natDegree) :
    (cofactorMat P Q i j).mulVec ![P, Q] = ![sResP P Q (i - 1), sResP P Q (j - 1)]

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.cofactor_unique
statement:
theorem cofactor_unique {K : Type*} [Field K] (P Q : K[X]) (hP : P ≠ 0) (hQ : Q ≠ 0)
    (hpq : Q.natDegree < P.natDegree) {j : ℕ} (hjq : j < Q.natDegree) (hsj : sResP P Q j ≠ 0)
    {U V : K[X]} (hUV : U * P + V * Q = sResP P Q j)
    (hU : U.natDegree ≤ Q.natDegree - j - 1) (_hV : V.natDegree ≤ P.natDegree - j - 1) :
    U = sResU P Q j ∧ V = sResV P Q j

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.det_lastCol_expand
statement:
theorem det_lastCol_expand {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (A : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) D)
    (V : Fin N → D[X]) (M : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) D[X])
    (hM : ∀ r c, M r c = if (c : ℕ) + 1 < N then C (A r c) else V r) :
    M.det = ∑ r₀ : Fin N, V r₀ * C ((A.updateCol ⟨N - 1, by omega⟩ (Pi.single r₀ 1)).det)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.natDegree_det_le_col
statement:
theorem natDegree_det_le_col {N : ℕ} (M : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) D[X]) (c₀ : Fin N) (d : ℕ)

statement:
theorem sResP_eq_cofactor (P Q : D[X]) (_hQ : Q ≠ 0) (hpq : Q.natDegree < P.natDegree)
    {j : ℕ} (hjq : j ≤ Q.natDegree) :
    sResP P Q j = sResU P Q j * P + sResV P Q j * Q

statement:
theorem sResU_sub_one_natDegree {K : Type*} [Field K] (P Q : K[X]) (hP : P ≠ 0) (hQ : Q ≠ 0)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.sResV_sub_one_natDegree
statement:
theorem sResV_sub_one_natDegree {K : Type*} [CommRing K] [IsDomain K] (P Q : K[X]) (hP : P ≠ 0)
    (hpq : Q.natDegree < P.natDegree) {j : ℕ} (hj1 : 1 ≤ j) (hjq : j ≤ Q.natDegree)
    (hsRes : Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sRes P Q j ≠ 0) :
    (sResV P Q (j - 1)).natDegree = P.natDegree - j
    ∧ (sResV P Q (j - 1)).leadingCoeff = P.leadingCoeff * Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sRes P Q j

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.boundary_recurrence
statement:
theorem boundary_recurrence {D : Type*} [CommRing D] [IsDomain D] (P Q : D[X]) (hP : P ≠ 0)
    (hQ : Q ≠ 0) (hpq : Q.natDegree < P.natDegree) {q k : ℕ} (hq : q = Q.natDegree)
    (hk1 : 1 ≤ k) (hkq : k < q) (hne : sResP P Q (q - 1) ≠ 0)
    (hdeg : (sResP P Q (q - 1)).natDegree = k)
    (hsResk : Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sRes P Q k ≠ 0) :
    C (Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sRes P Q k * (sResP P Q (q - 1)).leadingCoeff) * Q
      = (- sResU P Q (k - 1)) * sResP P Q (q - 1) + sResU P Q (q - 1) * sResP P Q (k - 1)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.det_cofactorMat_domain
statement:
theorem det_cofactorMat_domain {D : Type*} [CommRing D] [IsDomain D] (P Q : D[X])
    (hP : P ≠ 0) (hpq : Q.natDegree < P.natDegree) {i j : ℕ}
    (hj1 : 1 ≤ j) (hji : j < i) (hiq : i ≤ Q.natDegree + 1)
    (hQ : Q ≠ 0) (hne : sResP P Q (i - 1) ≠ 0) (hdeg : (sResP P Q (i - 1)).natDegree = j)
    (hsRes : Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sRes P Q j ≠ 0) :
    (cofactorMat P Q i j).det
      = C (Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sRes P Q j * (sResP P Q (i - 1)).leadingCoeff)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.sResP_cofactor_recurrence
statement:
theorem sResP_cofactor_recurrence {D : Type*} [CommRing D] (P Q : D[X]) (hQ : Q ≠ 0)
    (hpq : Q.natDegree < P.natDegree) {i j k : ℕ} (hi1 : i - 1 ≤ Q.natDegree)
    (hj1 : j - 1 ≤ Q.natDegree) (hk1 : k - 1 ≤ Q.natDegree) :
    (cofactorMat P Q j k).det * sResP P Q (i - 1)
      = (sResU P Q (i - 1) * sResV P Q (k - 1) - sResV P Q (i - 1) * sResU P Q (k - 1))
          * sResP P Q (j - 1)
        - (cofactorMat P Q i j).det * sResP P Q (k - 1)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.sResU_cofactor_recurrence
statement:
theorem sResU_cofactor_recurrence {D : Type*} [CommRing D] (P Q : D[X]) (i j k : ℕ) :
    (cofactorMat P Q j k).det * sResU P Q (i - 1)
      = (sResU P Q (i - 1) * sResV P Q (k - 1) - sResV P Q (i - 1) * sResU P Q (k - 1))
          * sResU P Q (j - 1)
        - (cofactorMat P Q i j).det * sResU P Q (k - 1)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.sResU_sub_one_eq
statement:
theorem sResU_sub_one_eq {D : Type*} [CommRing D] [IsDomain D] (P Q : D[X]) (hP : P ≠ 0)
    (hQ : Q ≠ 0) (hpq : Q.natDegree < P.natDegree) (hq1 : 1 ≤ Q.natDegree)
    (hsRes : Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sRes P Q Q.natDegree ≠ 0) :
    sResU P Q (Q.natDegree - 1)
      = - C (Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sRes P Q Q.natDegree * Q.leadingCoeff)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.sResV_cofactor_recurrence
statement:
theorem sResV_cofactor_recurrence {D : Type*} [CommRing D] (P Q : D[X]) (i j k : ℕ) :
    (cofactorMat P Q j k).det * sResV P Q (i - 1)
      = (sResU P Q (i - 1) * sResV P Q (k - 1) - sResV P Q (i - 1) * sResU P Q (k - 1))
          * sResV P Q (j - 1)
        - (cofactorMat P Q i j).det * sResV P Q (k - 1)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.adjugate_cofactorMat
statement:
theorem adjugate_cofactorMat (P Q : K[X]) (i j : ℕ) :
    Matrix.adjugate (cofactorMat P Q i j)
      = !![sResV P Q (j - 1), -sResV P Q (i - 1); -sResU P Q (j - 1), sResU P Q (i - 1)]

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.proposition_8_27_existence
statement:
theorem proposition_8_27_existence (hmn : m ≤ n) :
    ∃ Φ : (Fin m → degreeLT K n) → degreeLT K (n - m + 1),
      IsMultilinear Φ ∧ IsAlternating Φ ∧
      (∀ (e : Fin m → ℕ) (he : ∀ r, e r < n) (last : Fin m), (last : ℕ) + 1 = m →
        (∀ r : Fin m, (r : ℕ) + 1 < m → e r = n - 1 - (r : ℕ)) → ∀ (hi : e last ≤ n - m),
        Φ (monoFamily e he) = pdetMono ⟨e last, by omega⟩) ∧
      (∀ (e : Fin m → ℕ) (he : ∀ r, e r < n), StrictAnti e →
        (∃ r₀ : Fin m, (r₀ : ℕ) + 1 < m ∧ e r₀ ≠ n - 1 - (r₀ : ℕ)) →
        Φ (monoFamily e he) = 0)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.eq_of_multilinear_alternating
statement:
theorem eq_of_multilinear_alternating
    {Φ Ψ : (Fin m → degreeLT K n) → degreeLT K (n - m + 1)}
    (hΦm : IsMultilinear Φ) (hΦa : IsAlternating Φ)
    (hΨm : IsMultilinear Ψ) (hΨa : IsAlternating Ψ)
    (hagree : ∀ c : Fin m → Fin n, StrictAnti (fun r => (c r : ℕ)) →
      Φ (fun r => monoElt (c r)) = Ψ (fun r => monoElt (c r))) :
    Φ = Ψ

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.proposition_8_27
statement:
theorem proposition_8_27 (hm : 0 < m) (hmn : m ≤ n) :

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.proposition_8_27_uniqueness
statement:
theorem proposition_8_27_uniqueness (hm : 0 < m)
    {Φ Ψ : (Fin m → degreeLT K n) → degreeLT K (n - m + 1)}
    (hΦm : IsMultilinear Φ) (hΦa : IsAlternating Φ) (hΦn : Normalized Φ)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.proposition_8_46
statement:
theorem proposition_8_46 (P Q : K[X]) (hP : P ≠ 0) (hQ : Q ≠ 0)
    (hpq : Q.natDegree < P.natDegree) (hq1 : 1 ≤ Q.natDegree) {j k : ℕ}
    (hjq : j ≤ Q.natDegree) (hj1 : 1 ≤ j) (hjnd : (sResP P Q j).natDegree = j)
    (hk0 : sResP P Q (j - 1) ≠ 0) (hkdeg : (sResP P Q (j - 1)).natDegree = k) :
    sResP P Q k
      = C ((-1 : K) ^ ((j - k - 1) * (j - k) / 2)
          * ((sResP P Q (j - 1)).leadingCoeff / Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sRes P Q j) ^ (j - k - 1))
        * sResP P Q (j - 1)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.sResP_realized_eq
statement:
theorem sResP_realized_eq (P Q : K[X]) (hP : P ≠ 0) (hQ : Q ≠ 0)
    (hpq : Q.natDegree < P.natDegree) (hq1 : 1 ≤ Q.natDegree) {j k : ℕ}
    (hjq : j ≤ Q.natDegree) (hj1 : 1 ≤ j)
    (hk0 : sResP P Q (j - 1) ≠ 0) (hkdeg : (sResP P Q (j - 1)).natDegree = k) :
    sResP P Q k
      = C (Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sRes P Q k / (sResP P Q (j - 1)).leadingCoeff)
          * sResP P Q (j - 1)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.sRes_block_identity
statement:
theorem sRes_block_identity (P Q : K[X]) (hP : P ≠ 0) (hQ : Q ≠ 0)
    (hpq : Q.natDegree < P.natDegree) {j k : ℕ} (hjq : j ≤ Q.natDegree) (hj1 : 1 ≤ j)
    (hjnd : (sResP P Q j).natDegree = j) (hk0 : sResP P Q (j - 1) ≠ 0)
    (hkdeg : (sResP P Q (j - 1)).natDegree = k) :
    Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sRes P Q k * Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sRes P Q j ^ (j - k - 1)
      = (-1 : K) ^ ((j - k - 1) * (j - k) / 2) * (sResP P Q (j - 1)).leadingCoeff ^ (j - k)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.proposition_8_52
statement:
theorem proposition_8_52 (f : D →+* E) (P Q : D[X])
    (hP : (P.map f).natDegree = P.natDegree) (hQ : (Q.map f).natDegree = Q.natDegree) (j : ℕ) :
    sResP (P.map f) (Q.map f) j = (sResP P Q j).map f

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter8.proposition_8_52_degenerate
statement:
theorem proposition_8_52_degenerate (f : D →+* E) (P Q : D[X])
    (hpq : Q.natDegree < P.natDegree) (hP : (P.map f).natDegree = P.natDegree)
    (hQ : (Q.map f).natDegree < Q.natDegree) {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ (Q.map f).natDegree) :
    (sResP P Q j).map f
      = C ((P.map f).leadingCoeff ^ (Q.natDegree - (Q.map f).natDegree))
        * sResP (P.map f) (Q.map f) j

name: Azurite.BZ.continuousOn_expTail_integrand
statement:
theorem continuousOn_expTail_integrand {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (k : ℕ) :

name: Azurite.BZ.factorial_le_stirling_upper

name: Azurite.BZ.integrableOn_expTail

name: Azurite.BZ.sign_asymptoticRemainder

statement:
theorem harmonic_sub_log_diff_ge {N : ℕ} (hN : 3 ≤ N) (M : ℕ) :
    1 / 8 * (1 / ((N : ℝ) + 1) - 1 / (((N + M : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1))
      ≤ ((harmonic N : ℝ) - Real.log N) - ((harmonic (N + M) : ℝ) - Real.log (N + M))

name: Azurite.BZ.harmonic_sub_log_sub_gamma_bounds
statement:
theorem harmonic_sub_log_sub_gamma_bounds {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) :

      (harmonic N : ℝ) - Real.log N - eulerMascheroniConstant ≤ 1 / N

name: Azurite.BZ.harmonic_sub_log_sub_gamma_ge
statement:
theorem harmonic_sub_log_sub_gamma_ge {N : ℕ} (hN : 3 ≤ N) :

name: Azurite.BZ.integral_Ioi_rpow_neg

theorem log_sub_log_sub_inv_ge {m : ℕ} (hm : 4 ≤ m) :

name: Azurite.BZ.summable_zetaTail

name: Azurite.BZ.zetaEMTerm_one

statement:
theorem zetaReal_eq_sum_add_tail {s : ℝ} (hs : 1 < s) (p : ℕ) :

statement:
theorem zetaTail_bounds {s : ℝ} (hs : 1 < s) {p : ℕ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_stirlingTerm_eq
statement:
theorem abs_stirlingTerm_eq {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    |stirlingTerm k x|
      = 2 * (2 * k - 2).factorial * zetaReal (2 * k) / ((2 * π) ^ (2 * k) * x ^ (2 * k - 1))

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_stirlingTerm_ge
statement:
theorem abs_stirlingTerm_ge {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :

statement:
theorem log_Gamma_eq_stirlingApprox_add (m : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :

theorem sign_bernoulli_two_mul {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) :

name: Azurite.BZ.stirlingTerm_ratio_bounds
statement:
theorem stirlingTerm_ratio_bounds {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    (2 * k) * (2 * k - 1) / (2 * (2 * π * x) ^ 2) * |stirlingTerm k x| ≤ |stirlingTerm (k + 1) x| ∧
      |stirlingTerm (k + 1) x|

name: Azurite.BZ.zetaReal_two_mul_le

name: Azurite.BZ.approximant_eq_backR
statement:
theorem approximant_eq_backR {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (hpos : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → 0 < a j ∧ 0 < b j) {k : ℕ}
    (hk : 1 ≤ k) : approximant a b k = b 0 + a 1 * backR a b k 1 / backR a b k 0

name: Azurite.BZ.approximant_eq_tailFrac
statement:
theorem approximant_eq_tailFrac (a b : ℕ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    approximant a b k = b 0 + tailFrac a b k 1

name: Azurite.BZ.approximant_even_lt
statement:
theorem approximant_even_lt {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (hpos : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → 0 < a j ∧ 0 < b j) {f : ℝ}
    (hf : HasContFracValue a b f) (k : ℕ) : approximant a b (2 * k) < f

name: Azurite.BZ.approximant_even_lt_odd
statement:
theorem approximant_even_lt_odd {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (hpos : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → 0 < a j ∧ 0 < b j) (k m : ℕ) :
    approximant a b (2 * k) < approximant a b (2 * m + 1)

name: Azurite.BZ.approximant_even_lt_succ
statement:
theorem approximant_even_lt_succ {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (hpos : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → 0 < a j ∧ 0 < b j) (k : ℕ) :
    approximant a b (2 * k) < approximant a b (2 * k + 2)

name: Azurite.BZ.approximant_even_strictMono
statement:
theorem approximant_even_strictMono {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (hpos : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → 0 < a j ∧ 0 < b j) :
    StrictMono (fun k => approximant a b (2 * k))

name: Azurite.BZ.approximant_odd_strictAnti
statement:
theorem approximant_odd_strictAnti {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (hpos : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → 0 < a j ∧ 0 < b j) :
    StrictAnti (fun k => approximant a b (2 * k + 1))

name: Azurite.BZ.approximant_odd_succ_lt
statement:
theorem approximant_odd_succ_lt {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (hpos : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → 0 < a j ∧ 0 < b j) (k : ℕ) :
    approximant a b (2 * k + 3) < approximant a b (2 * k + 1)

name: Azurite.BZ.backR_div
statement:
theorem backR_div {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (hpos : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → 0 < a j ∧ 0 < b j) {k j : ℕ} (hj : 1 ≤ j)
    (hjk : j ≤ k) :
    backR a b k j / backR a b k (j - 1) = 1 / (b j + tailFrac a b k (j + 1))

name: Azurite.BZ.backR_of_lt
statement:
theorem backR_of_lt (a b : ℕ → ℝ) {k j : ℕ} (h : j + 2 ≤ k) :
    backR a b k j = b (j + 1) * backR a b k (j + 1) + a (j + 2) * backR a b k (j + 2)

name: Azurite.BZ.backR_pos
statement:
theorem backR_pos {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (hpos : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → 0 < a j ∧ 0 < b j) (k : ℕ) (j : ℕ) :
    0 < backR a b k j

name: Azurite.BZ.backR_pred
statement:
theorem backR_pred {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (hpos : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → 0 < a j ∧ 0 < b j) {k j : ℕ} (hj : 1 ≤ j)
    (hjk : j ≤ k) :
    backR a b k (j - 1) = (b j + tailFrac a b k (j + 1)) * backR a b k j

name: Azurite.BZ.backR_pred_self
statement: theorem backR_pred_self (a b : ℕ → ℝ) {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) : backR a b k (k - 1) = b k

name: Azurite.BZ.backR_self
statement: theorem backR_self (a b : ℕ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) : backR a b k k = 1

name: Azurite.BZ.dens_pos
statement:
theorem dens_pos {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (hpos : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → 0 < a j ∧ 0 < b j) (n : ℕ) :
    0 < (contFrac a b).dens n

name: Azurite.BZ.det_succ
statement:
theorem det_succ (a b : ℕ → ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    (contFrac a b).nums (j + 2) * (contFrac a b).dens (j + 1)
        - (contFrac a b).nums (j + 1) * (contFrac a b).dens (j + 2)
      = -a (j + 2) * ((contFrac a b).nums (j + 1) * (contFrac a b).dens j
        - (contFrac a b).nums j * (contFrac a b).dens (j + 1))

name: Azurite.BZ.diff_eq_det_div
statement:
theorem diff_eq_det_div {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (hpos : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → 0 < a j ∧ 0 < b j) (j : ℕ) :
    diff a b (j + 1) = ((contFrac a b).nums (j + 1) * (contFrac a b).dens j
      - (contFrac a b).nums j * (contFrac a b).dens (j + 1))
        / ((contFrac a b).dens (j + 1) * (contFrac a b).dens j)

name: Azurite.BZ.diff_even_neg
statement:
theorem diff_even_neg {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (hpos : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → 0 < a j ∧ 0 < b j) (k : ℕ) :
    diff a b (2 * k + 2) < 0

name: Azurite.BZ.diff_odd_pos
statement:
theorem diff_odd_pos {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (hpos : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → 0 < a j ∧ 0 < b j) (k : ℕ) :
    0 < diff a b (2 * k + 1)

name: Azurite.BZ.diff_one
statement: theorem diff_one (a b : ℕ → ℝ) : diff a b 1 = a 1 / b 1

name: Azurite.BZ.diff_succ
statement:
theorem diff_succ {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (hpos : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → 0 < a j ∧ 0 < b j) (j : ℕ) :
    diff a b (j + 2)
      = -a (j + 2) * (contFrac a b).dens j * diff a b (j + 1) / (contFrac a b).dens (j + 2)

name: Azurite.BZ.lt_approximant_odd
statement:
theorem lt_approximant_odd {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (hpos : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → 0 < a j ∧ 0 < b j) {f : ℝ}
    (hf : HasContFracValue a b f) (k : ℕ) : f < approximant a b (2 * k + 1)

name: Azurite.BZ.sign_diff
statement:
theorem sign_diff {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (hpos : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → 0 < a j ∧ 0 < b j) (j : ℕ) :
    0 < (-1) ^ j * diff a b (j + 1)

name: Azurite.BZ.tailFrac_nonneg
statement:
theorem tailFrac_nonneg {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (hpos : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → 0 < a j ∧ 0 < b j) (k : ℕ) {j : ℕ}
    (hj : 1 ≤ j) : 0 ≤ tailFrac a b k j

name: Azurite.BZ.tailFrac_of_le
statement:
theorem tailFrac_of_le (a b : ℕ → ℝ) {k j : ℕ} (h : j ≤ k) :
    tailFrac a b k j = a j / (b j + tailFrac a b k (j + 1))

name: Azurite.BZ.tailFrac_of_lt
statement: theorem tailFrac_of_lt (a b : ℕ → ℝ) {k j : ℕ} (h : k < j) : tailFrac a b k j = 0

name: Azurite.BZ.tailFrac_shift
statement:
theorem tailFrac_shift (a b : ℕ → ℝ) (k j : ℕ) :
    tailFrac a b (k + 1) (j + 1) = tailFrac (fun i => a (i + 1)) (fun i => b (i + 1)) k j

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_besselCoeff_eq
statement:
theorem abs_besselCoeff_eq (n j : ℕ) :
    |besselCoeff n j| = 1 / (j.factorial * (n + j).factorial)

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_besselCoeff_mul_le
statement:
theorem abs_besselCoeff_mul_le {R x : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hx : |x| ≤ R) (n j k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ 2) :
    |besselCoeff n j| * ((2 * j + n : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ k * |x / 2| ^ (2 * j + n - k)
      ≤ besselBound R n j

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_besselJTerm_le
statement:
theorem abs_besselJTerm_le (ν : ℤ) (x : ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    |besselJTerm ν x j| ≤ (x ^ 2 / 4) ^ j / j.factorial

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_inv_Gamma_int_le_one
statement: theorem abs_inv_Gamma_int_le_one (k : ℤ) : |(Real.Gamma k)⁻¹| ≤ 1

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_le_of_mem_ball
statement: theorem abs_le_of_mem_ball {x y : ℝ} (hy : y ∈ ball (0 : ℝ) (|x| + 1)) : |y| ≤ |x| + 1

name: Azurite.BZ.besselCoeff_succ
statement:
theorem besselCoeff_succ (n j : ℕ) :
    besselCoeff n (j + 1) = -besselCoeff n j / ((j + 1) * (n + j + 1))

name: Azurite.BZ.besselJNat_ode
statement:
theorem besselJNat_ode (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    x ^ 2 * deriv (deriv (besselJNat n)) x + x * deriv (besselJNat n) x
      + (x ^ 2 - (n : ℝ) ^ 2) * besselJNat n x = 0

name: Azurite.BZ.besselJReal_intCast
statement: theorem besselJReal_intCast (ν : ℤ) (x : ℝ) : besselJReal ν x = besselJ ν x

name: Azurite.BZ.besselJTerm_natCast
statement:
theorem besselJTerm_natCast (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    (x / 2) ^ n * besselJTerm n x j = besselCoeff n j * (x / 2) ^ (2 * j + n)

name: Azurite.BZ.besselJTerm_neg_add
statement:
theorem besselJTerm_neg_add (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) (i : ℕ) :
    besselJTerm (-n) x (i + n) = (-x ^ 2 / 4) ^ n * besselJTerm n x i

name: Azurite.BZ.besselJTerm_neg_of_lt
statement:
theorem besselJTerm_neg_of_lt (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) {j : ℕ} (hj : j < n) :
    besselJTerm (-n) x j = 0

name: Azurite.BZ.besselJ_natCast
statement: theorem besselJ_natCast (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) : besselJ n x = besselJNat n x

name: Azurite.BZ.besselJ_neg
statement: theorem besselJ_neg (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) : besselJ (-n) x = (-1) ^ n * besselJ n x

name: Azurite.BZ.besselJ_ode
statement:
theorem besselJ_ode (ν : ℤ) (x : ℝ) :
    x ^ 2 * deriv (deriv (besselJ ν)) x + x * deriv (besselJ ν) x
      + (x ^ 2 - (ν : ℝ) ^ 2) * besselJ ν x = 0

name: Azurite.BZ.besselJ_zero_left
statement: theorem besselJ_zero_left : besselJ 0 0 = 1

name: Azurite.BZ.besselJ_zero_of_ne
statement: theorem besselJ_zero_of_ne {ν : ℤ} (hν : ν ≠ 0) : besselJ ν 0 = 0

name: Azurite.BZ.bessel_ode_series
statement:
theorem bessel_ode_series (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    x ^ 2 * besselJNat'' n x + x * besselJNat' n x - (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * besselJNat n x
      = -(x ^ 2 * besselJNat n x)

name: Azurite.BZ.bessel_ode_term
statement:
theorem bessel_ode_term (n j : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    x ^ 2 * (besselCoeff n j * (((2 * j + n : ℕ) : ℝ) *
        (((2 * j + n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (x / 2) ^ (2 * j + n - 1 - 1) * (1 / 2)) * (1 / 2)))
      + x * (besselCoeff n j * (((2 * j + n : ℕ) : ℝ) * (x / 2) ^ (2 * j + n - 1) * (1 / 2)))
      - (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * (besselCoeff n j * (x / 2) ^ (2 * j + n))
      = 4 * j * (j + n) * besselCoeff n j * (x / 2) ^ (2 * j + n)

name: Azurite.BZ.hasDerivAt_besselJNat
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_besselJNat (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (besselJNat n) (besselJNat' n x) x

name: Azurite.BZ.hasDerivAt_besselJNat'
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_besselJNat' (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (besselJNat' n) (besselJNat'' n x) x

name: Azurite.BZ.hasDerivAt_half_pow
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_half_pow (m : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => (y / 2) ^ m) (((m : ℕ) : ℝ) * (x / 2) ^ (m - 1) * (1 / 2)) x

name: Azurite.BZ.hasSum_fiber_neg
statement:
theorem hasSum_fiber_neg {t : ℝ} (ht : t ≠ 0) (u : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    HasSum (fun i : ℕ => (u * t) ^ i / i.factorial *
      ((-u / t) ^ (i + (n + 1)) / (i + (n + 1)).factorial))
      ((t ^ (n + 1))⁻¹ * (-1) ^ (n + 1) * ∑' j, besselCoeff (n + 1) j * u ^ (2 * j + (n + 1)))

name: Azurite.BZ.hasSum_fiber_nonneg
statement:
theorem hasSum_fiber_nonneg {t : ℝ} (ht : t ≠ 0) (u : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    HasSum (fun i : ℕ => (u * t) ^ (i + n) / (i + n).factorial * ((-u / t) ^ i / i.factorial))
      (t ^ n * ∑' j, besselCoeff n j * u ^ (2 * j + n))

name: Azurite.BZ.mem_ball_abs_add_one
statement: theorem mem_ball_abs_add_one (x : ℝ) : x ∈ ball (0 : ℝ) (|x| + 1)

name: Azurite.BZ.norm_besselCoeff_mul_deriv2_le
statement:
theorem norm_besselCoeff_mul_deriv2_le {R x : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hx : |x| ≤ R) (n j : ℕ) :
    ‖besselCoeff n j * (((2 * j + n : ℕ) : ℝ) *
      (((2 * j + n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (x / 2) ^ (2 * j + n - 1 - 1) * (1 / 2)) * (1 / 2))‖
      ≤ besselBound R n j

name: Azurite.BZ.norm_besselCoeff_mul_deriv_le
statement:
theorem norm_besselCoeff_mul_deriv_le {R x : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hx : |x| ≤ R) (n j : ℕ) :
    ‖besselCoeff n j * (((2 * j + n : ℕ) : ℝ) * (x / 2) ^ (2 * j + n - 1) * (1 / 2))‖
      ≤ besselBound R n j

name: Azurite.BZ.norm_besselCoeff_mul_pow_le
statement:
theorem norm_besselCoeff_mul_pow_le {R x : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hx : |x| ≤ R) (n j : ℕ) :
    ‖besselCoeff n j * (x / 2) ^ (2 * j + n)‖ ≤ besselBound R n j

name: Azurite.BZ.pairEquiv_symm_natCast
statement: theorem pairEquiv_symm_natCast (n i : ℕ) : pairEquiv.symm ((n : ℤ), i) = (i + n, i)

name: Azurite.BZ.pairEquiv_symm_negSucc
statement:
theorem pairEquiv_symm_negSucc (n i : ℕ) :
    pairEquiv.symm (Int.negSucc n, i) = (i, i + (n + 1))

name: Azurite.BZ.pow_le_four_pow
statement: theorem pow_le_four_pow (m k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ 2) : m ^ k ≤ 4 ^ m

name: Azurite.BZ.summable_besselBound
statement: theorem summable_besselBound (R : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : Summable (besselBound R n)

name: Azurite.BZ.summable_besselJNat_term
statement:
theorem summable_besselJNat_term (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    Summable fun j => besselCoeff n j * (x / 2) ^ (2 * j + n)

name: Azurite.BZ.summable_besselJTerm
statement: theorem summable_besselJTerm (ν : ℤ) (x : ℝ) : Summable (besselJTerm ν x)

name: Azurite.BZ.IsBesselRecSol.add
statement:
theorem IsBesselRecSol.add {x : ℝ} {f g : ℕ → ℝ} (hf : IsBesselRecSol x f)
    (hg : IsBesselRecSol x g) : IsBesselRecSol x (f + g)

name: Azurite.BZ.IsBesselRecSol.casoratian
statement:
theorem IsBesselRecSol.casoratian {x : ℝ} {f g : ℕ → ℝ} (hf : IsBesselRecSol x f)
    (hg : IsBesselRecSol x g) (n : ℕ) :
    f n * g (n + 1) - f (n + 1) * g n = f 0 * g 1 - f 1 * g 0

name: Azurite.BZ.IsBesselRecSol.eq_of_init
statement:
theorem IsBesselRecSol.eq_of_init {x : ℝ} {f g : ℕ → ℝ} (hf : IsBesselRecSol x f)
    (hg : IsBesselRecSol x g) (h0 : f 0 = g 0) (h1 : f 1 = g 1) : f = g

name: Azurite.BZ.IsBesselRecSol.exists_eq_comb
statement:
theorem IsBesselRecSol.exists_eq_comb {x : ℝ} {f g h : ℕ → ℝ} (hg : IsBesselRecSol x g)
    (hh : IsBesselRecSol x h) (hW : g 0 * h 1 - g 1 * h 0 ≠ 0) (hf : IsBesselRecSol x f) :
    ∃ a b : ℝ, f = fun n => a * g n + b * h n

name: Azurite.BZ.IsBesselRecSol.smul
statement:
theorem IsBesselRecSol.smul {x : ℝ} {f : ℕ → ℝ} (hf : IsBesselRecSol x f) (c : ℝ) :
    IsBesselRecSol x (c • f)

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_besselJNat_le
statement:
theorem abs_besselJNat_le (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    |besselJNat n x| ≤ (|x| / 2) ^ n / n.factorial * Real.exp (x ^ 2 / 4)

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_besselJNat_le_stirling
statement:
theorem abs_besselJNat_le_stirling {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (x : ℝ) :
    |besselJNat n x|
      ≤ Real.exp (x ^ 2 / 4) / Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi * n) * (Real.exp 1 * |x| / (2 * n)) ^ n

name: Azurite.BZ.approximant_besselCF
statement:
theorem approximant_besselCF (x : ℝ) (ν : ℤ) (k : ℕ) :
    approximant besselCFNum (besselCFDen x ν) k = besselRatioCF x ν k 0

name: Azurite.BZ.approximant_besselCF_inner
statement:
theorem approximant_besselCF_inner {a : ℕ → ℝ} (ha : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → a j = -1) (x : ℝ) (ν : ℤ)
    (k : ℕ) :
    approximant a (fun j : ℕ => 2 * ((ν : ℝ) + j) / x) k
      = 2 * ν / x - besselRatioCF x (ν + 1) k 0

name: Azurite.BZ.besselJNat_recurrence
statement:
theorem besselJNat_recurrence (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    x / 2 * (besselJNat n x + besselJNat (n + 2) x) = (n + 1) * besselJNat (n + 1) x

name: Azurite.BZ.besselJ_ratio_eq_cf
statement:
theorem besselJ_ratio_eq_cf {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0) (ν : ℤ) (k : ℕ)
    (hJ : ∀ i : ℕ, i < k → besselJ (ν + i) x ≠ 0) :
    besselJ ν x / besselJ (ν - 1) x
      = besselRatioCF x ν k (besselJ (ν + k) x / besselJ (ν + k - 1) x)

name: Azurite.BZ.besselJ_ratio_step
statement:
theorem besselJ_ratio_step {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0) {ν : ℤ} (h1 : besselJ ν x ≠ 0) :
    besselJ ν x / besselJ (ν - 1) x = 1 / (2 * ν / x - besselJ (ν + 1) x / besselJ ν x)

name: Azurite.BZ.besselJ_recurrence
statement:
theorem besselJ_recurrence (ν : ℤ) (x : ℝ) :
    x * (besselJ (ν - 1) x + besselJ (ν + 1) x) = 2 * ν * besselJ ν x

name: Azurite.BZ.besselJ_recurrence'
statement:
theorem besselJ_recurrence' {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0) (ν : ℤ) :
    besselJ (ν - 1) x + besselJ (ν + 1) x = 2 * ν / x * besselJ ν x

name: Azurite.BZ.bessel_rec_term
statement:
theorem bessel_rec_term (n j : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    x / 2 * (besselCoeff n (j + 1) * (x / 2) ^ (2 * (j + 1) + n))
      + x / 2 * (besselCoeff (n + 2) j * (x / 2) ^ (2 * j + (n + 2)))
      = (n + 1) * (besselCoeff (n + 1) (j + 1) * (x / 2) ^ (2 * (j + 1) + (n + 1)))

name: Azurite.BZ.bessel_rec_term_zero
statement:
theorem bessel_rec_term_zero (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    x / 2 * (besselCoeff n 0 * (x / 2) ^ (2 * 0 + n))
      = (n + 1) * (besselCoeff (n + 1) 0 * (x / 2) ^ (2 * 0 + (n + 1)))

name: Azurite.BZ.isBesselRecSol_besselJ
statement:
theorem isBesselRecSol_besselJ {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    IsBesselRecSol x fun n : ℕ => besselJ n x

name: Azurite.BZ.millerSeq_casoratian
statement:
theorem millerSeq_casoratian {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0) (N : ℕ) :
    ∀ ν, ν ≤ N →
      millerSeq x N ν * besselJ (ν + 1) x - millerSeq x N (ν + 1) * besselJ ν x
        = besselJ (N + 1) x

name: Azurite.BZ.millerSeq_div_sub
statement:
theorem millerSeq_div_sub {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0) {N ν : ℕ} (hν : ν ≤ N)
    (h0 : besselJ ν x ≠ 0) (h1 : besselJ (ν + 1) x ≠ 0) :
    millerSeq x N ν / besselJ ν x - millerSeq x N (ν + 1) / besselJ (ν + 1) x
      = besselJ (N + 1) x / (besselJ ν x * besselJ (ν + 1) x)

name: Azurite.BZ.millerSeq_of_le
statement: theorem millerSeq_of_le (x : ℝ) {N ν : ℕ} (h : N + 1 ≤ ν) : millerSeq x N ν = 0

name: Azurite.BZ.millerSeq_of_lt
statement:
theorem millerSeq_of_lt (x : ℝ) {N ν : ℕ} (h : ν < N) :
    millerSeq x N ν = 2 * (ν + 1) / x * millerSeq x N (ν + 1) - millerSeq x N (ν + 2)

name: Azurite.BZ.millerSeq_rec
statement:
theorem millerSeq_rec (x : ℝ) {N μ : ℕ} (hμ : 1 ≤ μ) (hμN : μ ≤ N) :
    millerSeq x N (μ - 1) + millerSeq x N (μ + 1) = 2 * μ / x * millerSeq x N μ

name: Azurite.BZ.millerSeq_self
statement: theorem millerSeq_self (x : ℝ) (N : ℕ) : millerSeq x N N = 1

name: Azurite.BZ.tendsto_besselJNat_atTop

name: Azurite.BZ.pascal_sum
statement:
theorem pascal_sum {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] (q : ℕ → ℕ → R) (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ a ∈ range (n + 1), (n.choose a : R) * (q (a + 1) (n - a) + q a (n - a + 1))
      = ∑ a ∈ range (n + 2), ((n + 1).choose a : R) * q a (n + 1 - a)

theorem tan_kernel {k : ℝ} {θ : ℝ} (hθ : θ ∈ Ioo 0 (π / 2)) :

statement:

statement:
theorem integral_agmKernel_Ioc (hk : 0 < k) (hk1 : k ≤ 1) :

      ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, agmKernel 1 k t

name: Azurite.BZ.theta2Int_eq_two_mul_tsum
statement:
theorem theta2Int_eq_two_mul_tsum (hq0 : 0 < q) (hq1 : q < 1) :

name: Azurite.BZ.theta2Int_trunc
statement:
theorem theta2Int_trunc (hq0 : 0 < q) (hq1 : q < 1) (N : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ theta2Int q - 2 * ∑ n ∈ range N, q ^ (n * (n + 1))
      ∧ theta2Int q - 2 * ∑ n ∈ range N, q ^ (n * (n + 1)) ≤ 2 * q ^ (N * (N + 1)) / (1 - q)

name: Azurite.BZ.theta2_pow_four

statement:
theorem theta2_pow_four_trunc (hq0 : 0 < q) (hq1 : q < 1) :

      ∧ theta2 (q ^ 4) - (2 * q + 2 * q ^ 9 + 2 * q ^ 25) ≤ 2 * q ^ 49 / (1 - q ^ 4)

name: Azurite.BZ.theta3_trunc
statement:
theorem theta3_trunc (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q < 1) (N : ℕ) :

      ∧ theta3 q - (1 + 2 * ∑ n ∈ range N, q ^ ((n + 1) ^ 2))
        ≤ 2 * q ^ ((N + 1) ^ 2) / (1 - q)

name: Azurite.BZ.tsum_pow_le_of_le

name: Azurite.BZ.two_mul_mul_eq_half_sub

name: Azurite.BZ.arccos_eq_arctan
statement:
theorem arccos_eq_arctan {x : ℝ} (hx : |x| < 1) :

name: Azurite.BZ.arcsin_eq_arctan'

theorem arcsin_eq_arctan' {x : ℝ} (hx : |x| < 1) :

name: Azurite.BZ.arctan_eq_im_log

name: Azurite.BZ.complex_mul_three_products

    ((a : ℂ) + b * I) * (c + d * I)
      = ((a * c - b * d : ℝ) : ℂ) + (((a + b) * (c + d) - a * c - b * d : ℝ) : ℂ) * I

name: Azurite.BZ.complex_sq_two_products
statement:
theorem complex_sq_two_products (a b : ℝ) :
    ((a : ℂ) + b * I) ^ 2 = (((a + b) * (a - b) : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((2 * a * b : ℝ) : ℂ) * I

theorem abs_arctan_sub_sum_le (hx : |x| < 1) (N : ℕ) :

    (num den : ι → K) (hden : ∀ i ∈ s, den i ≠ 0) :
    ∑ i ∈ s, num i / den i = (∑ i ∈ s, num i * ∏ j ∈ s.erase i, den j) / ∏ j ∈ s, den j

name: Azurite.BZ.delta_lt_inv

name: Azurite.BZ.sinCosProd_exact_im
statement:
theorem sinCosProd_exact_im (y : ℕ → ℝ) (k j : ℕ) :

theorem sinCosProd_exact_re (y : ℕ → ℝ) (k j : ℕ) :

name: Azurite.BZ.sinCosProd_im
statement:
theorem sinCosProd_im (c s : ℕ → ℝ) {k j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ k) :
    (sinCosProd c s k j).im
      = s j * (sinCosProd c s k (j + 1)).re + c j * (sinCosProd c s k (j + 1)).im

name: Azurite.BZ.sinCosProd_re
statement:
theorem sinCosProd_re (c s : ℕ → ℝ) {k j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ k) :
    (sinCosProd c s k j).re
      = c j * (sinCosProd c s k (j + 1)).re - s j * (sinCosProd c s k (j + 1)).im

name: Azurite.BZ.sinCosProd_succ
statement:
theorem sinCosProd_succ (c s : ℕ → ℝ) {k j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ k) :

name: Azurite.BZ.sinCosProd_top

name: Azurite.BZ.sinCos_error
statement:
theorem sinCos_error (y c s : ℕ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hc : ∀ i, |c i - Real.cos (y i)| ≤ ε) (hs : ∀ i, |s i - Real.sin (y i)| ≤ ε) :
    |(sinCosProd c s k 0).im - Real.sin (tailSum y k 0)|
        ≤ (k + 1) * (2 * ε) * (1 + 2 * ε) ^ (k + 1)
      ∧ |(sinCosProd c s k 0).re - Real.cos (tailSum y k 0)|
        ≤ (k + 1) * (2 * ε) * (1 + 2 * ε) ^ (k + 1)

theorem sin_cos_add_step (a b : ℝ) :

      ∧ Real.cos (a + b) = Real.cos a * Real.cos b - Real.sin a * Real.sin b

name: Azurite.BZ.norm_aliasSum_sub_le

name: Azurite.BZ.norm_bernoulliCoeff_le

name: Azurite.BZ.norm_bernoulli_aliasSum_sub_le

    ‖aliasSum bernoulliCoeff (2 * j) k - (scaledBernoulli j : ℂ)‖

name: Azurite.BZ.sum_zpow_primitiveRoot

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_newtonSeq_sub_root_le
statement:
theorem abs_newtonSeq_sub_root_le {f f' f'' : ℝ → ℝ} {ζ r M m : ℝ} (hm : 0 < m) (hζ : f ζ = 0)
    (hf : ∀ t ∈ Icc (ζ - r) (ζ + r), HasDerivAt f (f' t) t)
    (hf' : ∀ t ∈ Icc (ζ - r) (ζ + r), HasDerivAt f' (f'' t) t)
    (hM : ∀ t ∈ Icc (ζ - r) (ζ + r), |f'' t| ≤ M)
    (hm' : ∀ t ∈ Icc (ζ - r) (ζ + r), m ≤ |f' t|) {x₀ : ℝ} (hx₀ : |x₀ - ζ| ≤ r)
    (hK : M / (2 * m) * |x₀ - ζ| ≤ 1 / 2) (n : ℕ) :
    |newtonSeq f f' x₀ n - ζ| ≤ |x₀ - ζ| / 2 ^ n

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_newtonStep_sub_root_le
statement:
theorem abs_newtonStep_sub_root_le {f f' f'' : ℝ → ℝ} {ζ r M m : ℝ} (hm : 0 < m) (hζ : f ζ = 0)
    (hf : ∀ t ∈ Icc (ζ - r) (ζ + r), HasDerivAt f (f' t) t)
    (hf' : ∀ t ∈ Icc (ζ - r) (ζ + r), HasDerivAt f' (f'' t) t)
    (hM : ∀ t ∈ Icc (ζ - r) (ζ + r), |f'' t| ≤ M)
    (hm' : ∀ t ∈ Icc (ζ - r) (ζ + r), m ≤ |f' t|) {x₀ : ℝ} (hx₀ : |x₀ - ζ| ≤ r) :
    |newtonStep f f' x₀ - ζ| ≤ M / (2 * m) * (x₀ - ζ) ^ 2

name: Azurite.BZ.exists_uIoo_ratio_eq
statement:
theorem exists_uIoo_ratio_eq {g g' h h' : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≠ b)
    (hg : ∀ t ∈ uIcc a b, HasDerivAt g (g' t) t) (hh : ∀ t ∈ uIcc a b, HasDerivAt h (h' t) t) :
    ∃ c ∈ uIoo a b, (h b - h a) * g' c = (g b - g a) * h' c

name: Azurite.BZ.newtonSeq_bounds
statement:
theorem newtonSeq_bounds {f f' f'' : ℝ → ℝ} {ζ r M m : ℝ} (hm : 0 < m) (hζ : f ζ = 0)
    (hf : ∀ t ∈ Icc (ζ - r) (ζ + r), HasDerivAt f (f' t) t)
    (hf' : ∀ t ∈ Icc (ζ - r) (ζ + r), HasDerivAt f' (f'' t) t)
    (hM : ∀ t ∈ Icc (ζ - r) (ζ + r), |f'' t| ≤ M)
    (hm' : ∀ t ∈ Icc (ζ - r) (ζ + r), m ≤ |f' t|) {x₀ : ℝ} (hx₀ : |x₀ - ζ| ≤ r)
    (hK : M / (2 * m) * |x₀ - ζ| ≤ 1 / 2) (n : ℕ) :
    |newtonSeq f f' x₀ n - ζ| ≤ r ∧
      |newtonSeq f f' x₀ (n + 1) - ζ| ≤ |newtonSeq f f' x₀ n - ζ| / 2 ∧
      M / (2 * m) * |newtonSeq f f' x₀ n - ζ| ≤ (M / (2 * m) * |x₀ - ζ|) ^ (2 ^ n)

name: Azurite.BZ.newtonSeq_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem newtonSeq_succ (f f' : ℝ → ℝ) (x₀ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    newtonSeq f f' x₀ (n + 1) = newtonStep f f' (newtonSeq f f' x₀ n)

name: Azurite.BZ.newtonSeq_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem newtonSeq_zero (f f' : ℝ → ℝ) (x₀ : ℝ) : newtonSeq f f' x₀ 0 = x₀

name: Azurite.BZ.newtonStep_root
statement: theorem newtonStep_root {f f' : ℝ → ℝ} {ζ : ℝ} (hζ : f ζ = 0) : newtonStep f f' ζ = ζ

name: Azurite.BZ.newtonStep_sub_root
statement:
theorem newtonStep_sub_root {f f' f'' : ℝ → ℝ} {x₀ ζ : ℝ} (hne : x₀ ≠ ζ) (hζ : f ζ = 0)
    (hd : f' x₀ ≠ 0) (hf : ∀ t ∈ uIcc x₀ ζ, HasDerivAt f (f' t) t)
    (hf' : ∀ t ∈ uIcc x₀ ζ, HasDerivAt f' (f'' t) t) :
    ∃ ξ ∈ uIoo x₀ ζ, newtonStep f f' x₀ - ζ = (x₀ - ζ) ^ 2 * f'' ξ / (2 * f' x₀)

name: Azurite.BZ.newtonStep_sub_root_cubic
statement:
theorem newtonStep_sub_root_cubic {f f' f'' f''' : ℝ → ℝ} {x₀ ζ M₂ M₃ m : ℝ} (hne : x₀ ≠ ζ)
    (hm : 0 < m) (hζ : f ζ = 0)
    (hf : ∀ t ∈ uIcc x₀ ζ, HasDerivAt f (f' t) t)
    (hf' : ∀ t ∈ uIcc x₀ ζ, HasDerivAt f' (f'' t) t)
    (hf'' : ∀ t ∈ uIcc x₀ ζ, HasDerivAt f'' (f''' t) t)
    (hM₂ : ∀ t ∈ uIcc x₀ ζ, |f'' t| ≤ M₂) (hM₃ : ∀ t ∈ uIcc x₀ ζ, |f''' t| ≤ M₃)
    (hm' : ∀ t ∈ uIcc x₀ ζ, m ≤ |f' t|) :
    |newtonStep f f' x₀ - ζ - f'' ζ / (2 * f' ζ) * (x₀ - ζ) ^ 2|
      ≤ (7 * M₃ / (6 * m) + M₂ ^ 2 / (2 * m ^ 2)) * |x₀ - ζ| ^ 3

name: Azurite.BZ.taylor_one
statement:
theorem taylor_one {f f' : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≠ b)
    (hf : ∀ t ∈ uIcc a b, HasDerivAt f (f' t) t) :
    ∃ ξ ∈ uIoo a b, f b = f a + (b - a) * f' ξ

name: Azurite.BZ.taylor_three
statement:
theorem taylor_three {f f' f'' f''' : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≠ b)
    (hf : ∀ t ∈ uIcc a b, HasDerivAt f (f' t) t)
    (hf' : ∀ t ∈ uIcc a b, HasDerivAt f' (f'' t) t)
    (hf'' : ∀ t ∈ uIcc a b, HasDerivAt f'' (f''' t) t) :
    ∃ ξ ∈ uIoo a b,
      f b = f a + (b - a) * f' a + (b - a) ^ 2 / 2 * f'' a + (b - a) ^ 3 / 6 * f''' ξ

name: Azurite.BZ.taylor_two
statement:
theorem taylor_two {f f' f'' : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≠ b)
    (hf : ∀ t ∈ uIcc a b, HasDerivAt f (f' t) t)
    (hf' : ∀ t ∈ uIcc a b, HasDerivAt f' (f'' t) t) :
    ∃ ξ ∈ uIoo a b, f b = f a + (b - a) * f' a + (b - a) ^ 2 / 2 * f'' ξ

name: Azurite.BZ.tendsto_newtonSeq
statement:
theorem tendsto_newtonSeq {f f' f'' : ℝ → ℝ} {ζ r M m : ℝ} (hm : 0 < m) (hζ : f ζ = 0)
    (hf : ∀ t ∈ Icc (ζ - r) (ζ + r), HasDerivAt f (f' t) t)
    (hf' : ∀ t ∈ Icc (ζ - r) (ζ + r), HasDerivAt f' (f'' t) t)
    (hM : ∀ t ∈ Icc (ζ - r) (ζ + r), |f'' t| ≤ M)
    (hm' : ∀ t ∈ Icc (ζ - r) (ζ + r), m ≤ |f' t|) {x₀ : ℝ} (hx₀ : |x₀ - ζ| ≤ r)
    (hK : M / (2 * m) * |x₀ - ζ| ≤ 1 / 2) :
    Tendsto (newtonSeq f f' x₀) atTop (𝓝 ζ)

name: Azurite.BZ.exists_tendsto_inverseRootSeq
statement:
theorem exists_tendsto_inverseRootSeq {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) :
    ∃ δ > 0, ∀ x₀, |x₀ - y ^ (-(1 / (m : ℝ)))| ≤ δ →
      (∀ n, |inverseRootSeq m y x₀ n - y ^ (-(1 / (m : ℝ)))| ≤ y ^ (-(1 / (m : ℝ))) / 2) ∧
      (∀ n, inverseRootSeq m y x₀ n
        = newtonSeq (inverseRootFun m y) (inverseRootFun' m) x₀ n) ∧
      Tendsto (inverseRootSeq m y x₀) atTop (𝓝 (y ^ (-(1 / (m : ℝ)))))

name: Azurite.BZ.inverseRootFun_root
statement:
theorem inverseRootFun_root {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) :
    inverseRootFun m y (y ^ (-(1 / (m : ℝ)))) = 0

name: Azurite.BZ.inverseRootSeq_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem inverseRootSeq_succ (m : ℕ) (y x₀ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    inverseRootSeq m y x₀ (n + 1) = inverseRootStep m y (inverseRootSeq m y x₀ n)

name: Azurite.BZ.inverseRootSeq_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem inverseRootSeq_zero (m : ℕ) (y x₀ : ℝ) : inverseRootSeq m y x₀ 0 = x₀

name: Azurite.BZ.inverseRootStep_rel
statement:
theorem inverseRootStep_rel (m : ℕ) {y ζ : ℝ} (hζ : ζ ^ m * y = 1) (ε : ℝ) :
    inverseRootStep m y (ζ * (1 + ε)) = ζ * ((1 + ε) * (1 + (1 - (1 + ε) ^ m) / m))

name: Azurite.BZ.inverseRoot_pos

name: Azurite.BZ.newtonStep_inverseRootFun
statement:
theorem newtonStep_inverseRootFun {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (y : ℝ) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    newtonStep (inverseRootFun m y) (inverseRootFun' m) x = inverseRootStep m y x

name: Azurite.BZ.rpow_neg_inv_pow_mul
statement:
theorem rpow_neg_inv_pow_mul {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) :

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_recipError_lt_one_iff

statement:
theorem abs_recipError_reciprocalStep_perturbed_le {y x θ ε : ℝ} (hε : ε ≤ 1)
    (hu : |recipError y x| ≤ ε) (hθ : |θ| ≤ ε) :
    |recipError y (x + x * (1 - x * y) * (1 + θ))| ≤ 3 * ε ^ 2

name: Azurite.BZ.eq_of_recipError
statement: theorem eq_of_recipError {y : ℝ} (hy : y ≠ 0) (x : ℝ) : x = (1 - recipError y x) / y

name: Azurite.BZ.recipError_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem recipError_eq_zero_iff {y : ℝ} (hy : y ≠ 0) (x : ℝ) : recipError y x = 0 ↔ x = y⁻¹

name: Azurite.BZ.recipError_one_le_half
statement:
theorem recipError_one_le_half {y : ℝ} (hy : y ∈ Ico (1 / 2 : ℝ) 1) :
    0 < recipError y 1 ∧ recipError y 1 ≤ 1 / 2

name: Azurite.BZ.recipError_reciprocalSeq
statement:
theorem recipError_reciprocalSeq (y x₀ : ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    recipError y (reciprocalSeq y x₀ j) = recipError y x₀ ^ (2 ^ j)

name: Azurite.BZ.recipError_reciprocalStep
statement:
theorem recipError_reciprocalStep (y x : ℝ) :
    recipError y (reciprocalStep y x) = recipError y x ^ 2

name: Azurite.BZ.recipError_reciprocalStep'_perturbed
statement:
theorem recipError_reciprocalStep'_perturbed (y x θ : ℝ) :
    recipError y (x * (2 - x * y) * (1 + θ))
      = recipError y x ^ 2 - θ * (1 - recipError y x ^ 2)

name: Azurite.BZ.recipError_reciprocalStep_perturbed
statement:
theorem recipError_reciprocalStep_perturbed (y x θ : ℝ) :
    recipError y (x + x * (1 - x * y) * (1 + θ))
      = recipError y x ^ 2 - θ * recipError y x * (x * y)

name: Azurite.BZ.reciprocalSeq_sub_inv
statement:
theorem reciprocalSeq_sub_inv {y : ℝ} (hy : y ≠ 0) (x₀ : ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    reciprocalSeq y x₀ j - y⁻¹ = -(recipError y x₀ ^ (2 ^ j)) / y

name: Azurite.BZ.reciprocalSeq_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem reciprocalSeq_succ (y x₀ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    reciprocalSeq y x₀ (n + 1) = reciprocalStep y (reciprocalSeq y x₀ n)

name: Azurite.BZ.reciprocalSeq_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem reciprocalSeq_zero (y x₀ : ℝ) : reciprocalSeq y x₀ 0 = x₀

name: Azurite.BZ.reciprocalStep'_eq
statement: theorem reciprocalStep'_eq (y x : ℝ) : reciprocalStep' y x = reciprocalStep y x

name: Azurite.BZ.reciprocalStep_eq_inverseRootStep
statement:
theorem reciprocalStep_eq_inverseRootStep (y x : ℝ) :
    reciprocalStep y x = inverseRootStep 1 y x

name: Azurite.BZ.tendsto_recipError_iff
statement:
theorem tendsto_recipError_iff {y : ℝ} (hy : y ≠ 0) (x : ℕ → ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun j => recipError y (x j)) atTop (𝓝 0) ↔ Tendsto x atTop (𝓝 y⁻¹)

name: Azurite.BZ.tendsto_reciprocalSeq_iff
statement:
theorem tendsto_reciprocalSeq_iff {y : ℝ} (hy : y ≠ 0) (x₀ : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (reciprocalSeq y x₀) atTop (𝓝 y⁻¹) ↔ |recipError y x₀| < 1

name: Azurite.BZ.coeff_integral_succ
statement:
theorem coeff_integral_succ (A : K⟦X⟧) (j : ℕ) :
    coeff (j + 1) (integral A) = coeff j A / (j + 1)

name: Azurite.BZ.coeff_integral_zero
statement: theorem coeff_integral_zero (A : K⟦X⟧) : coeff 0 (integral A) = 0

name: Azurite.BZ.constantCoeff_integral
statement: theorem constantCoeff_integral (A : K⟦X⟧) : constantCoeff (integral A) = 0

name: Azurite.BZ.order_powerSeriesReciprocalSeq_sub_inv
statement:
theorem order_powerSeriesReciprocalSeq_sub_inv [Nontrivial R] (j : ℕ) :
    order (ringReciprocalSeq (1 - X : R⟦X⟧) 1 j - mk 1) = ((2 ^ j : ℕ) : ℕ∞)

name: Azurite.BZ.powerSeriesReciprocalSeq_sub_inv
statement:
theorem powerSeriesReciprocalSeq_sub_inv (j : ℕ) :
    ringReciprocalSeq (1 - X : R⟦X⟧) 1 j - mk 1 = -(X ^ (2 ^ j) * mk 1)

name: Azurite.BZ.reciprocalStep_eq_ringReciprocalStep
statement:
theorem reciprocalStep_eq_ringReciprocalStep (y x : ℝ) :
    reciprocalStep y x = ringReciprocalStep y x

name: Azurite.BZ.ringRecipError_seq
statement:
theorem ringRecipError_seq (y x₀ : α) (j : ℕ) :
    ringRecipError y (ringReciprocalSeq y x₀ j) = ringRecipError y x₀ ^ (2 ^ j)

name: Azurite.BZ.ringRecipError_step
statement:
theorem ringRecipError_step (y x : α) :
    ringRecipError y (ringReciprocalStep y x) = ringRecipError y x ^ 2

name: Azurite.BZ.ringReciprocalSeq_one_sub
statement:
theorem ringReciprocalSeq_one_sub (z : α) (j : ℕ) :
    ringReciprocalSeq (1 - z) 1 j = ∑ n ∈ range (2 ^ j), z ^ n ∧
      (1 - z) * ringReciprocalSeq (1 - z) 1 j = 1 - z ^ (2 ^ j)

name: Azurite.BZ.ringReciprocalSeq_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem ringReciprocalSeq_succ (y x₀ : α) (n : ℕ) :
    ringReciprocalSeq y x₀ (n + 1) = ringReciprocalStep y (ringReciprocalSeq y x₀ n)

name: Azurite.BZ.ringReciprocalSeq_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem ringReciprocalSeq_zero (y x₀ : α) : ringReciprocalSeq y x₀ 0 = x₀

name: Azurite.BZ.Counted.mul_nsMul
statement: @[simp] theorem mul_nsMul [Mul α] (a b : α) : (nsMul a b).mul = 1

name: Azurite.BZ.Counted.mul_nsSq

name: Azurite.BZ.Counted.mul_pure

name: Azurite.BZ.Counted.sq_bind
statement:
@[simp] theorem sq_bind (m : Counted α) (f : α → Counted β) :

name: Azurite.BZ.Counted.sq_nsMul
statement: @[simp] theorem sq_nsMul [Mul α] (a b : α) : (nsMul a b).sq = 0

name: Azurite.BZ.Counted.sq_nsSq

statement: @[simp] theorem val_pure (a : α) : (pure a : Counted α).val = a

name: Azurite.BZ.Gamma_I_mul_mul_Gamma_neg
statement:
theorem Gamma_I_mul_mul_Gamma_neg {y : ℝ} (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    Complex.Gamma (y * Complex.I) * Complex.Gamma (-(y * Complex.I))
      = Real.pi / (y * Real.sinh (Real.pi * y))

name: Azurite.BZ.Gamma_eq_exp_stirling_div
statement:
theorem Gamma_eq_exp_stirling_div {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (m δ : ℕ) :
    Real.Gamma x = Real.exp (stirlingApprox m (x + δ) + stirlingRem m (x + δ))
      / ∏ i ∈ range δ, (x + i)

name: Azurite.BZ.Gamma_stirling_relError
statement:
theorem Gamma_stirling_relError {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (m δ : ℕ) {ε : ℝ}
    (hR : |stirlingRem m (x + δ)| ≤ ε) (hε : ε ≤ 1) :
    |Real.exp (stirlingApprox m (x + δ)) / (∏ i ∈ range δ, (x + i)) - Real.Gamma x|
      ≤ 2 * ε * Real.Gamma x

name: Azurite.BZ.IsConstRecSol.add
statement:
theorem IsConstRecSol.add {K : ℂ} {f g : ℕ → ℂ} (hf : IsConstRecSol K f) (hg : IsConstRecSol K g) :
    IsConstRecSol K (fun ν => f ν + g ν)

name: Azurite.BZ.IsConstRecSol.eq_of_init
statement:
theorem IsConstRecSol.eq_of_init {K : ℂ} {f g : ℕ → ℂ} (hf : IsConstRecSol K f)
    (hg : IsConstRecSol K g) (h0 : f 0 = g 0) (h1 : f 1 = g 1) : ∀ ν, f ν = g ν

name: Azurite.BZ.IsConstRecSol.exists_eq_comb
statement:
theorem IsConstRecSol.exists_eq_comb {K lam mu : ℂ} (hl : lam ^ 2 - 2 * K * lam + 1 = 0)
    (hm : mu ^ 2 - 2 * K * mu + 1 = 0) (hne : lam ≠ mu) {f : ℕ → ℂ} (hf : IsConstRecSol K f) :
    ∃ A B : ℂ, ∀ ν, f ν = A * lam ^ ν + B * mu ^ ν

name: Azurite.BZ.IsConstRecSol.smul
statement:
theorem IsConstRecSol.smul {K : ℂ} {f : ℕ → ℂ} (hf : IsConstRecSol K f) (c : ℂ) :
    IsConstRecSol K (fun ν => c * f ν)

Azurite.BZ.abs_agmLog2_sub_log_le
statement:
theorem abs_agmLog2_sub_log_le {c₁ c₂ : ℝ}
    (hE : ∀ k : ℝ, 0 < k → k ≤ 1 / 2 →
      |Real.log (4 / k) - ((1 - k ^ 2 / 4) * (Real.pi / 2 / AGM 1 k) + k ^ 2 / 4)|
        ≤ k ^ 4 * (c₁ * Real.log (4 / k) + c₂))
    {x : ℝ} (hx : 8 ≤ x) :
    |agmLog2 x - Real.log x| ≤ (4 / x) ^ 4 * (c₁ * Real.log x + c₂)

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_asymptoticRemainder_lt
statement:
theorem abs_asymptoticRemainder_lt {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (k : ℕ) :
    |asymptoticRemainder k x| < k.factorial / x ^ (k + 1)

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_bernoulliKernel_eq
statement:
theorem abs_bernoulliKernel_eq {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    |(bernoulliKernel k : ℝ)| = (4 ^ k - 2) * |(scaledBernoulli k : ℝ)|

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_bernoulliKernel_le
statement:
theorem abs_bernoulliKernel_le (m : ℕ) :
    |(bernoulliKernel m : ℝ)| ≤ 4 ^ m * |(scaledBernoulli m : ℝ)|

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_bernoulli_two_mul_eq
statement:
theorem abs_bernoulli_two_mul_eq {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    |(bernoulli (2 * k) : ℝ)|
      = 2 * (2 * k).factorial * zetaReal (2 * k) / (2 * Real.pi) ^ (2 * k)

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_expm1_relError_step_le
statement:
theorem abs_expm1_relError_step_le {x ε : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hε : |ε| ≤ 1) :
    |ε * (2 * (expm1 x + 1) + expm1 x * ε) / (expm1 x + 2)| ≤ |ε| * (1 + expm1 x)

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_log_sub_log_le
statement:
theorem abs_log_sub_log_le {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) :
    |Real.log a - Real.log b| ≤ |a - b| / min a b

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_log_two_approx
statement:
theorem abs_log_two_approx {m : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) :
    |Real.pi / 2 / AGM 1 (4 / 2 ^ m) / m - Real.log 2|
      ≤ (4 / 2 ^ m) ^ 2 / 4 * (2 + (m - 2) * Real.log 2) / m

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_log_two_approx_of_pi
statement:
theorem abs_log_two_approx_of_pi {m : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) {p δ : ℝ} (hp : |p - Real.pi| ≤ δ) :
    |p / 2 / AGM 1 (4 / 2 ^ m) / m - Real.log 2|
      ≤ δ / (2 * AGM 1 (4 / 2 ^ m) * m)
        + (4 / 2 ^ m) ^ 2 / 4 * (2 + (m - 2) * Real.log 2) / m

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_one_sub_exp_neg_div_le
statement: theorem abs_one_sub_exp_neg_div_le {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) : |(1 - Real.exp (-t)) / t| ≤ 1

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_pi_approx_exp
statement:
theorem abs_pi_approx_exp {j : ℝ} (hj : Real.log 4 ≤ j) :
    |2 * j * AGM 1 (4 * Real.exp (-j)) - Real.pi|
      ≤ 8 * Real.exp (-(2 * j)) * (j + 2 - Real.log 4)

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_scaledBernoulli_ge
statement:
theorem abs_scaledBernoulli_ge {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    2 / (2 * Real.pi) ^ (2 * k) ≤ |(scaledBernoulli k : ℝ)|

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_sub_taylorInverseStep_le
statement:
theorem abs_sub_taylorInverseStep_le {g h : ℝ → ℝ} {y xj M : ℝ} {k : ℕ} (hg : ContDiff ℝ k g)
    (hgh : g (h xj) = xj) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (hM : ∀ ξ ∈ uIcc (h xj) y, |iteratedDeriv k g ξ| ≤ M) :
    |g y - taylorInverseStep g h y k xj| ≤ M * |y - h xj| ^ k / k.factorial

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_sum_perturbed_sub_le
Azurite.BZ.abs_sum_sq_perturbed_sub_le
statement:
theorem abs_sum_sq_perturbed_sub_le {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (t e : ι → ℝ)
    (ht : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ t i) {ε : ℝ} (he : ∀ i ∈ s, |e i| ≤ ε) :
    |∑ i ∈ s, t i * (1 + e i) ^ 2 - ∑ i ∈ s, t i| ≤ (2 * ε + ε ^ 2) * ∑ i ∈ s, t i

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_tsum_sub_forwardHorner_le
statement:
theorem abs_tsum_sub_forwardHorner_le {a : ℕ → ℝ} {x ε : ℝ} (hx0 : x ≠ 0) (hx : |x| < 1 / 2)
    (ha : Antitone fun i => |a i|) {j : ℕ} (hstop : |a j * x ^ j| ≤ ε) :
    |∑' i, a i * x ^ i - x ^ j * forwardHorner a x⁻¹ j| ≤ ε

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_tsum_sub_sum_le_term
statement:
theorem abs_tsum_sub_sum_le_term {a : ℕ → ℝ} {x : ℝ} (hx : |x| < 1 / 2)
    (ha : Antitone fun i => |a i|) (j : ℕ) :
    |∑' i, a i * x ^ i - ∑ i ∈ range (j + 1), a i * x ^ i| ≤ |a j * x ^ j|

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_tsum_sub_sum_le_two_mul
statement:
theorem abs_tsum_sub_sum_le_two_mul {a : ℕ → ℝ} {x : ℝ} (hx : |x| < 1 / 2)
    (ha : Antitone fun i => |a i|) (j : ℕ) :
    |∑' i, a i * x ^ i - ∑ i ∈ range (j + 1), a i * x ^ i| ≤ 2 * |a (j + 1)| * |x| ^ (j + 1)

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_two_mul_log_mul_AGM_sub_pi
statement:
theorem abs_two_mul_log_mul_AGM_sub_pi {k : ℝ} (hk : 0 < k) (hk1 : k ≤ 1) :
    |2 * Real.log (4 / k) * AGM 1 k - Real.pi| ≤ k ^ 2 / 2 * (2 - Real.log k)

name: Azurite.BZ.agmLog2_precision
statement:
theorem agmLog2_precision {c₁ c₂ x : ℝ} {n : ℕ} (hx : 8 ≤ x)
    (hbound : |agmLog2 x - Real.log x| ≤ (4 / x) ^ 4 * (c₁ * Real.log x + c₂))
    (hn : 256 * (c₁ * Real.log x + c₂) * 2 ^ n ≤ x ^ 4) :
    |agmLog2 x - Real.log x| ≤ (1 / 2) ^ n

name: Azurite.BZ.algebraMap_inv_factorial_mul_choose
statement:
theorem algebraMap_inv_factorial_mul_choose {n j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ n) :
    algebraMap ℚ A (1 / n.factorial) * (n.choose j : A)
      = algebraMap ℚ A (1 / j.factorial) * algebraMap ℚ A (1 / (n - j).factorial)

name: Azurite.BZ.aliasSumFun_eq_circleIntegral
statement:
theorem aliasSumFun_eq_circleIntegral {f : ℂ → ℂ} {R : ℝ} (hR : 1 < R)
    (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f (Metric.closedBall 0 R)) {j k : ℕ} (hjk : j < k) :
    aliasSumFun f j k
      = (2 * Real.pi * I)⁻¹ * ∮ z in C(0, R), z ^ (k - j - 1) / (z ^ k - 1) * f z

name: Azurite.BZ.aliasSumFun_sub_cauchyCoeff
statement:
theorem aliasSumFun_sub_cauchyCoeff {f : ℂ → ℂ} {R : ℝ} (hR : 1 < R)
    (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f (Metric.closedBall 0 R)) {j k : ℕ} (hjk : j < k) :
    aliasSumFun f j k - cauchyCoeff f R j
      = (2 * Real.pi * I)⁻¹ * ∮ z in C(0, R), f z / (z ^ (j + 1) * (z ^ k - 1))

name: Azurite.BZ.aliasSum_eq_aliasSumFun
statement:
theorem aliasSum_eq_aliasSumFun (a : ℕ → ℂ) (j k : ℕ) :
    aliasSum a j k = aliasSumFun (fun z => ∑' l : ℕ, a l * z ^ l) j k

name: Azurite.BZ.altOddSum_eq
statement:
theorem altOddSum_eq (n : ℕ) {s : ℚ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    altOddSum n s = 2 ^ n * n.factorial / ∏ i ∈ range (n + 1), (s + 2 * i)

name: Azurite.BZ.altOddSum_one
statement:
theorem altOddSum_one (n : ℕ) :
    altOddSum n 1 = 2 ^ n * n.factorial / ((2 * n + 1).doubleFactorial : ℚ)

name: Azurite.BZ.altOddSum_succ
statement:
theorem altOddSum_succ (n : ℕ) (s : ℚ) :
    altOddSum (n + 1) s = altOddSum n s - altOddSum n (s + 2)

name: Azurite.BZ.altOddSum_zero
statement: theorem altOddSum_zero (s : ℚ) : altOddSum 0 s = 1 / s

name: Azurite.BZ.approximant_between_consecutive
statement:
theorem approximant_between_consecutive {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (hpos : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → 0 < a j ∧ 0 < b j)
    {f : ℝ} (hf : HasContFracValue a b f) (m : ℕ) :
    min (approximant a b m) (approximant a b (m + 1)) < f ∧
      f < max (approximant a b m) (approximant a b (m + 1))

name: Azurite.BZ.approximant_eq_cfProd
statement:
theorem approximant_eq_cfProd {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (hpos : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → 0 < a j ∧ 0 < b j)
    (hb0 : b 0 = 0) (k : ℕ) :
    approximant a b (k + 1) = cfProd a b (k + 1) 1 0 / cfProd a b (k + 1) 0 0

name: Azurite.BZ.approximant_eq_nums_div_dens
statement:
theorem approximant_eq_nums_div_dens {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (hpos : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → 0 < a j ∧ 0 < b j)
    (k : ℕ) : approximant a b k = (contFrac a b).nums k / (contFrac a b).dens k

name: Azurite.BZ.backR_sub_two
statement:
theorem backR_sub_two (a b : ℕ → ℝ) {k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) :
    backR a b k (k - 2) = b (k - 1) * b k + a k

name: Azurite.BZ.bernoulliCoeff_conj
statement: theorem bernoulliCoeff_conj (l : ℕ) : conj (bernoulliCoeff l) = bernoulliCoeff l

name: Azurite.BZ.bernoulli_four'

name: Azurite.BZ.binary_splitting_cost_pow

      ≤ Real.logb 2 n ^ c * n ^ c * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (1 - c) / (1 - 2 ^ (1 - c)))

name: Azurite.BZ.binary_splitting_levels_le

name: Azurite.BZ.circleIntegral_sum

name: Azurite.BZ.classicalEvalC_mul

name: Azurite.BZ.classicalEvalC_sq

theorem classicalEvalC_sq (a : ℕ → α) (j k : ℕ) (x : α) :

name: Azurite.BZ.coeff_egf

name: Azurite.BZ.logb_one_add_pow_sub_one_ge

name: Azurite.BZ.logb_two_mul

name: Azurite.BZ.methodA_eq
statement:
theorem methodA_eq (a b : ℝ) :
    2 * a * b = 2 * (a * b) ∧ a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 = (a + b) ^ 2 - 2 * (a * b)

name: Azurite.BZ.methodA_relError_le
statement:
theorem methodA_relError_le {a b ε ε₁ ε₂ : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (h₁ : |ε₁| ≤ ε)
    (h₂ : |ε₂| ≤ ε) :
    |(a + b) ^ 2 * (1 + ε₁) - 2 * (a * b) * (1 + ε₂) - (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2)|
      ≤ 3 * ε * (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2)

name: Azurite.BZ.methodB_amplification
statement:
theorem methodB_amplification {a b ε : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hε : 0 ≤ ε) :
    |((a + b) ^ 2 * (1 + ε) - (a - b) ^ 2 * (1 - ε)) / 2 - 2 * a * b| = ε * (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) ∧
      ε * (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) / (2 * a * b) ≥ ε * b / (2 * a)

name: Azurite.BZ.methodB_eq
statement:
theorem methodB_eq (a b : ℝ) :
    a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 = ((a + b) ^ 2 + (a - b) ^ 2) / 2 ∧
      2 * a * b = ((a + b) ^ 2 - (a - b) ^ 2) / 2

name: Azurite.BZ.modularEvalC_mul
statement:
theorem modularEvalC_mul (a : ℕ → α) {j : ℕ} (hj : 0 < j) (k : ℕ) (x : α) :
    (modularEvalC a j k x).mul + 1 = (Nat.digits 2 j).sum + (k / 2 - 1) + (j - 1)

name: Azurite.BZ.modularEvalC_sq
statement:
theorem modularEvalC_sq (a : ℕ → α) (j k : ℕ) (x : α) :

name: Azurite.BZ.modularEvalC_total
statement:
theorem modularEvalC_total (a : ℕ → α) {j k : ℕ} (hj : 0 < j) (hk : 2 ≤ k) (x : α) :
    (modularEvalC a j k x).mul + (modularEvalC a j k x).sq
      = (Nat.log 2 j + (Nat.digits 2 j).sum - 1) + (k - 2) + (j - 1)

name: Azurite.BZ.modularEvalC_total_le
statement:
theorem modularEvalC_total_le (a : ℕ → α) {j k : ℕ} (hj : 0 < j) (hk : 2 ≤ k) (x : α) :
    (modularEvalC a j k x).mul + (modularEvalC a j k x).sq ≤ modularNonscalar j k

name: Azurite.BZ.modularEvalC_val

name: Azurite.BZ.roots_of_lt_one
statement:
theorem roots_of_lt_one {K : ℝ} (hK0 : 0 < K) (hK : K < 1) :
    let lam : ℂ := K + Real.sqrt (1 - K ^ 2) * Complex.I
    lam ^ 2 - 2 * (K : ℂ) * lam + 1 = 0 ∧
      (starRingEnd ℂ) lam ^ 2 - 2 * (K : ℂ) * (starRingEnd ℂ) lam + 1 = 0 ∧
      lam * (starRingEnd ℂ) lam = 1 ∧ ‖lam‖ = 1 ∧ lam ≠ (starRingEnd ℂ) lam

name: Azurite.BZ.roots_of_one_lt
statement:
theorem roots_of_one_lt {K : ℝ} (hK : 1 < K) :
    let s := Real.sqrt (K ^ 2 - 1)
    (K + s) ^ 2 - 2 * K * (K + s) + 1 = 0 ∧ (K - s) ^ 2 - 2 * K * (K - s) + 1 = 0 ∧
      (K + s) * (K - s) = 1 ∧ 1 < K + s ∧ 0 < K - s ∧ K - s < 1

name: Azurite.BZ.rpow_logb_le_sq

      - 2 * x * (2 + x ^ 2 + 3 * x ^ 4 - 2 * x ^ 6) * salvyFun' x
      + 2 * (2 * x ^ 6 + 3 * x ^ 4 + 4 * x ^ 2 - 1) * salvyFun x = 0

name: Azurite.BZ.sample_reduce_conj
statement:

      ∨ g (exp (2 * Real.pi * I / k) ^ m) = conj (g (exp (2 * Real.pi * I / k) ^ r))

name: Azurite.BZ.scaledBernoulliPowerSeries_eq

theorem scaledBernoulliPowerSeries_eq :

name: Azurite.BZ.second_order_deduction
statement:
theorem second_order_deduction {k K K' A B : ℝ} (hk : 0 < k) (hk1 : k ≤ 1)
    (h69 : |K - Real.pi / 2 * (1 + k ^ 2 / 4)| ≤ A * k ^ 4)
    (h70 : |K' - (2 / Real.pi * Real.log (4 / k) * K - k ^ 2 / 4)| ≤ B * k ^ 4) :
    |Real.log (4 / k) - ((1 - k ^ 2 / 4) * K' + k ^ 2 / 4)|
      ≤ k ^ 4 * ((1 / 16 + 2 * A / Real.pi) * Real.log (4 / k) + 1 / 16 + B)

name: Azurite.BZ.second_order_expansion
statement:
theorem second_order_expansion {k B : ℝ} (hk : 0 < k) (hk2 : k ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 2)
    (h70 : |Real.pi / 2 / AGM 1 k
      - (2 / Real.pi * Real.log (4 / k) * ellipticK k - k ^ 2 / 4)| ≤ B * k ^ 4) :
    |Real.log (4 / k) - ((1 - k ^ 2 / 4) * (Real.pi / 2 / AGM 1 k) + k ^ 2 / 4)|
      ≤ k ^ 4 * (7 / 16 * Real.log (4 / k) + 1 / 16 + B)

name: Azurite.BZ.seriesExp_succ
statement:
theorem seriesExp_succ (a : ℕ → ℚ) (k : ℕ) :
    seriesExp a (k + 1)
      = (∑ i ∈ range (k + 1), ((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) * a (i + 1) * seriesExp a (k - i)) / (k + 1)

name: Azurite.BZ.seriesExp_zero
statement: theorem seriesExp_zero (a : ℕ → ℚ) : seriesExp a 0 = 1

name: Azurite.BZ.sinhExpm1_mono

name: Azurite.BZ.sinhExpm1_nonneg

name: Azurite.BZ.sinh_add_sqrt_relError_le

name: Azurite.BZ.sinh_eq_sign_mul_sinh_abs

theorem sinh_eq_sign_mul_sinh_abs (x : ℝ) :

name: Azurite.BZ.sinh_eq_sinhExpm1

theorem sqrt_sub_eq_inv (s : ℝ) :

name: Azurite.BZ.sqrt_sub_one_le_half

name: Azurite.BZ.stirling1_eq_zero_of_lt
statement:
theorem stirling1_eq_zero_of_lt : ∀ {n j : ℕ}, n < j → stirling1 n j = 0
  | 0, 0, h => absurd h (lt_irrefl 0)
  | 0, _ + 1, _ => rfl
  | _ + 1, 0, h => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | n + 1, j + 1, h => by
    rw [stirling1, stirling1_eq_zero_of_lt (by omega : n < j),
      stirling1_eq_zero_of_lt (by omega : n < j + 1)]
    simp

name: Azurite.BZ.stirling1_zero_right
statement:
theorem stirling1_zero_right : ∀ {n : ℕ}, 1 ≤ n → stirling1 n 0 = 0
  | 0, h => absurd h (by norm_num)
  | 1, _ => rfl
  | n + 2, _ => by rw [stirling1, stirling1_zero_right (by omega : 1 ≤ n + 1), mul_zero]

name: Azurite.BZ.sum_abs_le_sqrt_card_mul_sum_sq

name: Azurite.BZ.sum_choose_alt_div_eq_harmonic

theorem sum_choose_alt_div_eq_harmonic (m : ℕ) :

name: Azurite.BZ.sum_choose_alt_div_succ
statement:
theorem sum_choose_alt_div_succ (m : ℕ) :

name: Azurite.BZ.sum_cost_le
statement:
theorem sum_cost_le (M : ℕ → ℝ) (hM0 : ∀ m, 0 ≤ M m) (hM : ∀ m, 2 * M m ≤ M (2 * m)) (L : ℕ) :

name: Azurite.BZ.sum_eq_pow_mul_forwardHorner
statement:
theorem sum_eq_pow_mul_forwardHorner (a : ℕ → K) {x : K} (hx : x ≠ 0) (j : ℕ) :

name: Azurite.BZ.sum_expm1_two_pow_le
statement:
theorem sum_expm1_two_pow_le {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (k : ℕ) :
    ∑ i ∈ range k, expm1 (r * 2 ^ i) ≤ r * 2 ^ k * Real.exp (r * 2 ^ k)

name: Azurite.BZ.sum_primitiveRoot_div_eq

theorem sum_primitiveRoot_div_eq {ζ : ℂ} {k : ℕ} (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ k) (hk : 0 < k) {z : ℂ}
    (hz : z ^ k ≠ 1) : ∑ m ∈ range k, ζ ^ m / (z - ζ ^ m) = k / (z ^ k - 1)

name: Azurite.BZ.sum_quasiLinearCost_burstStepSize_le

theorem sum_quasiLinearCost_burstStepSize_le {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) {L : ℕ}

    ∑ i ∈ range (L + 1), quasiLinearCost (burstStepSize n i)

name: Azurite.BZ.sum_stirling1

theorem sum_stirling1_mul_pow {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] (n : ℕ) (x : R) :

name: Azurite.BZ.tailFracX_eq_nums_dens
statement:
theorem tailFracX_eq_nums_dens {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (hpos : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → 0 < a j ∧ 0 < b j) (k : ℕ)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    b 0 + tailFracX a b (k + 1) x 1
      = ((contFrac a b).nums (k + 1) + (contFrac a b).nums k * x)
        / ((contFrac a b).dens (k + 1) + (contFrac a b).dens k * x)

name: Azurite.BZ.tailFracX_nonneg
statement:
theorem tailFracX_nonneg {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (hpos : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → 0 < a j ∧ 0 < b j) (k : ℕ) {x : ℝ}
    (hx : 0 ≤ x) {j : ℕ} (hj : 1 ≤ j) : 0 ≤ tailFracX a b k x j

name: Azurite.BZ.tailFracX_of_le
statement:
theorem tailFracX_of_le (a b : ℕ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) (x : ℝ) {j : ℕ} (h : j ≤ k) :
    tailFracX a b k x j = a j / (b j + tailFracX a b k x (j + 1))

name: Azurite.BZ.tailFracX_of_lt
statement:
theorem tailFracX_of_lt (a b : ℕ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) (x : ℝ) {j : ℕ} (h : k < j) :

name: Azurite.BZ.tailFracX_succ

    tailFracX a b (k + 1) x j = tailFracX a b k (a (k + 1) / (b (k + 1) + x)) j

name: Azurite.BZ.tailFracX_zero
statement: theorem tailFracX_zero (a b : ℕ → ℝ) (k j : ℕ) : tailFracX a b k 0 j = tailFrac a b k j

name: Azurite.BZ.taylorInverseStep_eq_taylor
statement:
theorem taylorInverseStep_eq_taylor {g h : ℝ → ℝ} {y xj : ℝ} {k : ℕ} (hg : ContDiff ℝ k g)
    (hgh : g (h xj) = xj) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hne : h xj ≠ y) :
    taylorInverseStep g h y k xj = taylorWithinEval g (k - 1) (uIcc (h xj) y) (h xj) y

name: Azurite.BZ.taylorInverseStep_order
statement:
theorem taylorInverseStep_order {g h : ℝ → ℝ} {x xj M L : ℝ} {k : ℕ} (hg : ContDiff ℝ k g)
    (hgx : g (h x) = x) (hgh : g (h xj) = xj) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (hLip : |h x - h xj| ≤ L * |x - xj|)
    (hM : ∀ ξ ∈ uIcc (h xj) (h x), |iteratedDeriv k g ξ| ≤ M) :
    |x - taylorInverseStep g h (h x) k xj| ≤ M * L ^ k / k.factorial * |x - xj| ^ k

name: Azurite.BZ.taylorInverseStep_sub
statement:
theorem taylorInverseStep_sub {g h : ℝ → ℝ} {y xj : ℝ} {k : ℕ} (hg : ContDiff ℝ k g)
    (hgh : g (h xj) = xj) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hne : h xj ≠ y) :
    ∃ ξ ∈ uIoo (h xj) y,
      g y - taylorInverseStep g h y k xj = iteratedDeriv k g ξ * (y - h xj) ^ k / k.factorial

name: Azurite.BZ.theorem_4_1
statement:
theorem theorem_4_1 {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (hpos : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → 0 < a j ∧ 0 < b j) {f : ℝ}
    (hf : HasContFracValue a b f) :
    StrictMono (fun k => approximant a b (2 * k)) ∧
      StrictAnti (fun k => approximant a b (2 * k + 1)) ∧
      (∀ k, approximant a b (2 * k) < f) ∧
      (∀ k, f < approximant a b (2 * k + 1)) ∧
      ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → |f - (approximant a b (m - 1) + approximant a b m) / 2|
        < |approximant a b m - approximant a b (m - 1)| / 2

name: Azurite.BZ.theta2_le_two_rpow_div
statement:
theorem theta2_le_two_rpow_div {q : ℝ} (hq0 : 0 < q) (hq1 : q < 1) :
    theta2 q ≤ 2 * q ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) / (1 - q)

name: Azurite.BZ.two_pow_mul_div_rpow
statement:
theorem two_pow_mul_div_rpow {N c : ℝ} (hN : 0 ≤ N) (k : ℕ) :
    (2 : ℝ) ^ k * (N / 2 ^ k) ^ c = N ^ c * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (1 - c)) ^ k

name: Azurite.BZ.two_pow_mul_le_one_add_pow_sub_one
statement:
theorem two_pow_mul_le_one_add_pow_sub_one {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (k : ℕ) :
    2 ^ k * ε ≤ (1 + ε) ^ 2 ^ k - 1

name: Azurite.BZ.wordsOf_eq_one
statement: theorem wordsOf_eq_one {w b : ℕ} (hw : 0 < w) (hb : 0 < b) (h : b ≤ w) : wordsOf w b = 1

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_expStep_relError_le
statement:
theorem abs_expStep_relError_le {ε : ℝ} (hε : |ε| ≤ 1 / 2) :
    |(1 + ε) * (1 - log (1 + ε)) - 1| ≤ 9 / 4 * ε ^ 2

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_liftExp_relError_le
statement:
theorem abs_liftExp_relError_le {ε δ θ η : ℝ} (hη : η ≤ 1 / 2) (hε : |ε| ≤ η) (hδ : |δ| ≤ η ^ 2)
    (hθ : |θ| ≤ η) :
    |ε - (1 + ε) * (1 + θ) * (log (1 + ε) + δ)| ≤ 9 * η ^ 2

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_log_one_add_sub_le
statement:
theorem abs_log_one_add_sub_le {ε : ℝ} (hε : |ε| ≤ 1 / 2) :
    |log (1 + ε) - (ε - ε ^ 2 / 2)| ≤ 2 * |ε| ^ 3

name: Azurite.BZ.expSeq_succ
statement: @[simp] theorem expSeq_succ (y x₀ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : expSeq y x₀ (n + 1) = expStep y (expSeq y x₀ n)

name: Azurite.BZ.expSeq_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem expSeq_zero (y x₀ : ℝ) : expSeq y x₀ 0 = x₀

name: Azurite.BZ.expStep_rel
statement:
theorem expStep_rel (y : ℝ) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < 1 + ε) :
    expStep y (exp y * (1 + ε)) = exp y * ((1 + ε) * (1 - log (1 + ε)))

name: Azurite.BZ.inverseSeq_eq_newtonSeq
statement:
theorem inverseSeq_eq_newtonSeq (g g' : ℝ → ℝ) (y x₀ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    inverseSeq g g' y x₀ n = newtonSeq (fun x => y - g x) (fun x => -g' x) x₀ n

name: Azurite.BZ.inverseSeq_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem inverseSeq_succ (g g' : ℝ → ℝ) (y x₀ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :

name: Azurite.BZ.inverseSeq_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem inverseSeq_zero (g g' : ℝ → ℝ) (y x₀ : ℝ) : inverseSeq g g' y x₀ 0 = x₀

name: Azurite.BZ.inverseStep_eq_newtonStep
statement:
theorem inverseStep_eq_newtonStep (g g' : ℝ → ℝ) (y x : ℝ) :
    inverseStep g g' y x = newtonStep (fun x => y - g x) (fun x => -g' x) x

name: Azurite.BZ.inverseStep_log
statement: theorem inverseStep_log (y x : ℝ) : inverseStep log (fun x => x⁻¹) y x = expStep y x

name: Azurite.BZ.inverseStep_root
statement: theorem inverseStep_root {g g' : ℝ → ℝ} {y ζ : ℝ} (hζ : g ζ = y) : inverseStep g g' y ζ = ζ

name: Azurite.BZ.liftExp_rel
statement:
theorem liftExp_rel (y δ θ : ℝ) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < 1 + ε) :
    exp y * (1 + ε) + exp y * (1 + ε) * (y - (log (exp y * (1 + ε)) + δ)) * (1 + θ)
      = exp y * (1 + (ε - (1 + ε) * (1 + θ) * (log (1 + ε) + δ)))

name: Azurite.BZ.tendsto_inverseSeq
statement:
theorem tendsto_inverseSeq {g g' g'' : ℝ → ℝ} {y ζ r M m : ℝ} (hm : 0 < m) (hζ : g ζ = y)
    (hg : ∀ t ∈ Icc (ζ - r) (ζ + r), HasDerivAt g (g' t) t)
    (hg' : ∀ t ∈ Icc (ζ - r) (ζ + r), HasDerivAt g' (g'' t) t)
    (hM : ∀ t ∈ Icc (ζ - r) (ζ + r), |g'' t| ≤ M)
    (hm' : ∀ t ∈ Icc (ζ - r) (ζ + r), m ≤ |g' t|) {x₀ : ℝ} (hx₀ : |x₀ - ζ| ≤ r)
    (hK : M / (2 * m) * |x₀ - ζ| ≤ 1 / 2) :
    (∀ n, |inverseSeq g g' y x₀ n - ζ| ≤ r ∧
      |inverseSeq g g' y x₀ (n + 1) - ζ| ≤ |inverseSeq g g' y x₀ n - ζ| / 2) ∧
    Tendsto (inverseSeq g g' y x₀) atTop (𝓝 ζ)

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_expOrderStep_sub_exp_le
statement:
theorem abs_expOrderStep_sub_exp_le {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) (y : ℝ) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x)
    (hε : |y - log x| ≤ 1) :
    |expOrderStep k y x - exp y|
      ≤ x * (|y - log x| ^ k * ((k + 1 : ℕ) / (k.factorial * k : ℝ)))

name: Azurite.BZ.cubicStep_inverseRootFun_one
statement:
theorem cubicStep_inverseRootFun_one (y : ℝ) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    cubicStep (inverseRootFun 1 y) (inverseRootFun' 1) (inverseRootFun'' 1) x
      = x + x * (1 - x * y) + x * (1 - x * y) ^ 2

name: Azurite.BZ.cubicStep_log
statement:
theorem cubicStep_log (y : ℝ) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    cubicStep (fun x => y - log x) (fun x => -x⁻¹) (fun x => (x ^ 2)⁻¹) x
      = x + x * (y - log x) + x * (y - log x) ^ 2 / 2

name: Azurite.BZ.expOrderStep_three
statement:
theorem expOrderStep_three (y x : ℝ) :
    expOrderStep 3 y x = x + x * (y - log x) + x * (y - log x) ^ 2 / 2

name: Azurite.BZ.expOrderStep_two
statement: theorem expOrderStep_two (y x : ℝ) : expOrderStep 2 y x = expStep y x

name: Azurite.BZ.exp_eq_mul_exp_sub_log
statement: theorem exp_eq_mul_exp_sub_log (y : ℝ) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) : exp y = x * exp (y - log x)

name: Azurite.BZ.exp_eq_mul_tsum
statement:
theorem exp_eq_mul_tsum (y : ℝ) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :

name: Azurite.BZ.inv_eq_mul_tsum_geometric
statement:
theorem inv_eq_mul_tsum_geometric {y x : ℝ} (hy : y ≠ 0) (hε : |1 - x * y| < 1) :
    y⁻¹ = x * ∑' m : ℕ, (1 - x * y) ^ m

name: Azurite.BZ.recipOrderStep_three
statement:
theorem recipOrderStep_three (y x : α) :

name: Azurite.BZ.recipOrderStep_two
statement: theorem recipOrderStep_two (y x : α) : recipOrderStep 2 y x = ringReciprocalStep y x

name: Azurite.BZ.ringRecipError_recipOrderSeq
statement:
theorem ringRecipError_recipOrderSeq (k : ℕ) (y x₀ : α) (j : ℕ) :
    ringRecipError y (recipOrderSeq k y x₀ j) = ringRecipError y x₀ ^ (k ^ j)

name: Azurite.BZ.ringRecipError_recipOrderStep
statement:
theorem ringRecipError_recipOrderStep (k : ℕ) (y x : α) :
    ringRecipError y (recipOrderStep k y x) = ringRecipError y x ^ k

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_rsqrtError_lt_one_iff
statement:
theorem abs_rsqrtError_lt_one_iff (y x₀ : ℝ) :

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_rsqrtError_rsqrtSeq_le
statement:
theorem abs_rsqrtError_rsqrtSeq_le {y x₀ : ℝ} (h : |rsqrtError y x₀| ≤ 1) (j : ℕ) :
    |rsqrtError y (rsqrtSeq y x₀ j)| ≤ |rsqrtError y x₀| ^ (2 ^ j)

name: Azurite.BZ.log_two_bracket_width
statement:
theorem log_two_bracket_width (N₁ N₂ N₃ : ℕ) :
    (18 * (∑ k ∈ range N₁, atanhTerm 26 k + 4 / 3 * atanhTerm 26 N₁)
        - 2 * ∑ k ∈ range N₂, atanhTerm 4801 k
        + 8 * (∑ k ∈ range N₃, atanhTerm 8749 k + 4 / 3 * atanhTerm 8749 N₃))
      - (18 * ∑ k ∈ range N₁, atanhTerm 26 k
        - 2 * (∑ k ∈ range N₂, atanhTerm 4801 k + 4 / 3 * atanhTerm 4801 N₂)
        + 8 * ∑ k ∈ range N₃, atanhTerm 8749 k)
      = 4 / 3 * (18 * atanhTerm 26 N₁ + 2 * atanhTerm 4801 N₂ + 8 * atanhTerm 8749 N₃)

name: Azurite.BZ.log_two_mem_Icc

        - 2 * (∑ k ∈ range N₂, atanhTerm 4801 k + 4 / 3 * atanhTerm 4801 N₂)
        + 8 * ∑ k ∈ range N₃, atanhTerm 8749 k)
      (18 * (∑ k ∈ range N₁, atanhTerm 26 k + 4 / 3 * atanhTerm 26 N₁)
        - 2 * ∑ k ∈ range N₂, atanhTerm 4801 k
        + 8 * (∑ k ∈ range N₃, atanhTerm 8749 k + 4 / 3 * atanhTerm 8749 N₃))

name: Azurite.CP.gaussSum_eq_sum_range
statement:
theorem gaussSum_eq_sum_range {ζq : R} (hζq : ζq ^ q = 1)
    (χ : MulChar (ZMod q) R) {g : (ZMod q)ˣ}
    (hg : ∀ x, x ∈ Subgroup.zpowers g) :
    gaussSum χ (AddChar.zmodChar q hζq)
      = ∑ k ∈ range (q - 1),
          χ (g : ZMod q) ^ k * ζq ^ ((g ^ k : (ZMod q)ˣ) : ZMod q).val

name: Azurite.CP.lemma_4_4_1
statement:
theorem lemma_4_4_1 {q p : ℕ} [Fact q.Prime] (hp : 1 < p)
    {R : Type _} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
    {ζp : Rˣ} (hζp : IsPrimitiveRoot ζp p)
    (hζmem : ζp ∈ rootsOfUnity (Fintype.card (ZMod q)ˣ) R)
    {g : (ZMod q)ˣ} (hg : ∀ x, x ∈ Subgroup.zpowers g)
    {ζq : R} (hζq : IsPrimitiveRoot ζq q) :
    gaussSum (MulChar.ofRootOfUnity hζmem hg)
        (AddChar.zmodChar q hζq.pow_eq_one)
      * gaussSum (MulChar.ofRootOfUnity hζmem hg)⁻¹
        (AddChar.zmodChar q hζq.pow_eq_one)⁻¹
      = (q : R)

name: Azurite.CP.lemma_4_4_2
statement:
theorem lemma_4_4_2 {q p n : ℕ} [Fact q.Prime] (hp : p.Prime)
    (hn : n.Prime) (hgcd : Nat.Coprime (p * q) n)
    {R : Type _} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
    {ζp : Rˣ} (hζp : IsPrimitiveRoot ζp p)
    (hζmem : ζp ∈ rootsOfUnity (Fintype.card (ZMod q)ˣ) R)
    {g : (ZMod q)ˣ} (hg : ∀ x, x ∈ Subgroup.zpowers g)
    {ζq : R} (hζq : IsPrimitiveRoot ζq q) :
    (n : R) ∣ gaussSum (MulChar.ofRootOfUnity hζmem hg)
        (AddChar.zmodChar q hζq.pow_eq_one) ^ (n ^ (p - 1) - 1)
      - MulChar.ofRootOfUnity hζmem hg (n : ZMod q)

name: Azurite.CP.lemma_4_4_2_zeta_pow

theorem lemma_4_4_2_zeta_pow {p n : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime)

    {R : Type _} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
    {ζp : Rˣ} (hζp : IsPrimitiveRoot ζp p)
    (hζmem : ζp ∈ rootsOfUnity (Fintype.card (ZMod q)ˣ) R)
    {g : (ZMod q)ˣ} (hg : ∀ x, x ∈ Subgroup.zpowers g)
    {ζq : R} (hζq : IsPrimitiveRoot ζq q) :
    ∃ j₀, (n : R) ∣ gaussSum (MulChar.ofRootOfUnity hζmem hg)
        (AddChar.zmodChar q hζq.pow_eq_one) ^ (n ^ (p - 1) - 1)
      - (ζp : R) ^ j₀

    {f g : Polynomial (ZMod n)} (hf : f.Monic) (hfdeg : 0 < f.natDegree)
    (h1 : f ∣ g ^ (n ^ I - 1) - 1)
    (h2 : ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ F →
      IsCoprime (g ^ ((n ^ I - 1) / q) - 1) f)
    (h3 : ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ I → ∃ c : ZMod n,
      f ∣ ((Multiset.range I).map fun j => g ^ n ^ j).esymm k - C c)

    n.Prime

name: Azurite.CP.eq_4_23_char
statement:
theorem eq_4_23_char (hp : p.Prime) (hr : r.Prime)
    (hgcd : Nat.Coprime (p * q) r)
    {R : Type _} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
    {ζp : Rˣ} (hζp : IsPrimitiveRoot ζp p)
    (hζmem : ζp ∈ rootsOfUnity (Fintype.card (ZMod q)ˣ) R)
    {g : (ZMod q)ˣ} (hg : ∀ x, x ∈ Subgroup.zpowers g)
    {ζq : R} (hζq : IsPrimitiveRoot ζq q)
    (hrp : ¬(r : R) ∣ (p : R))
    {w u a b l : ℕ} (hexp : (r ^ (p - 1) - 1) * b = p ^ w * u * a)
    (hb : b ≡ 1 [MOD p])
    (hstep : (r : R) ∣ gaussSum (MulChar.ofRootOfUnity hζmem hg)
        (AddChar.zmodChar q hζq.pow_eq_one) ^ (p ^ w * u)
      - (ζp : R) ^ l) :
    MulChar.ofRootOfUnity hζmem hg ((r : ℕ) : ZMod q)

    (hζmem : ∀ p, ζ p ∈ rootsOfUnity (Fintype.card (ZMod q)ˣ) R)
    (hζord : ∀ p ∈ (q - 1).primeFactors, IsPrimitiveRoot (ζ p) p)
    {g : (ZMod q)ˣ} (hg : ∀ x, x ∈ Subgroup.zpowers g)
    {r l a lq : ℕ} {e : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hrval : ∀ p ∈ (q - 1).primeFactors,
      MulChar.ofRootOfUnity (hζmem p) hg ((r : ℕ) : ZMod q)
        = ((ζ p : Rˣ) : R) ^ e p)
    (hecong : ∀ p ∈ (q - 1).primeFactors, e p ≡ lq * a [MOD p])
    (hl : ((l : ℕ) : ZMod q) = ((g ^ lq : (ZMod q)ˣ) : ZMod q))
    (hr : IsUnit ((r : ℕ) : ZMod q)) :
    r ≡ l ^ a [MOD q]

name: Azurite.CP.theorem_4_4_6_composite
statement:
theorem theorem_4_4_6_composite
    {n I F : ℕ} (hn1 : 1 < n) (hncomp : ¬n.Prime)
    (hI : Squarefree I) (hF : Squarefree F)
    (hqI : ∀ q ∈ F.primeFactors, (q - 1) ∣ I)
    (hgcd : Nat.Coprime (I * F) n) (hnF : n < F ^ 2)
    {w u : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hw : ∀ p ∈ I.primeFactors, 0 < w p)
    (hu : ∀ p ∈ I.primeFactors, ¬p ∣ u p)
    {lTab : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ} {lq : ℕ → ℕ} {l : ℕ} {q₀ : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hq₀ : ∀ p ∈ I.primeFactors, q₀ p ∈ F.primeFactors ∧ p ∣ q₀ p - 1)
    {R : ℕ → Type _} [∀ q, CommRing (R q)]
    (hdom : ∀ q ∈ F.primeFactors, IsDomain (R q))
    {ζP : (q : ℕ) → ℕ → (R q)ˣ} {ζQ : (q : ℕ) → R q}
    {g : (q : ℕ) → (ZMod q)ˣ}
    (hdata : ∀ q, q ∈ F.primeFactors → ∀ [Fact q.Prime],
      ∃ (hζq : IsPrimitiveRoot (ζQ q) q)
        (hmem : ∀ p, ζP q p ∈ rootsOfUnity (Fintype.card (ZMod q)ˣ) (R q))
        (hgen : ∀ x, x ∈ Subgroup.zpowers (g q)),
        (∀ p ∈ (q - 1).primeFactors, IsPrimitiveRoot (ζP q p) p) ∧
        (∀ x y : ℕ, ((x : R q) ∣ (y : R q)) ↔ x ∣ y) ∧
        (∀ p ∈ (q - 1).primeFactors,
          (n : R q) ∣ gaussSum (MulChar.ofRootOfUnity (hmem p) hgen)
              (AddChar.zmodChar q hζq.pow_eq_one) ^ (p ^ w p * u p)
            - (ζP q p : R q) ^ lTab p q) ∧
        (∀ p ∈ (q - 1).primeFactors, q₀ p = q →
          ∀ d, d ∣ n → 1 < d → ∀ j,
            ¬(d : R q) ∣ gaussSum (MulChar.ofRootOfUnity (hmem p) hgen)
                (AddChar.zmodChar q hζq.pow_eq_one) ^ (p ^ (w p - 1) * u p)
              - (ζP q p : R q) ^ j) ∧
        (∀ p ∈ (q - 1).primeFactors, lq q ≡ lTab p q [MOD p]) ∧
        ((l : ℕ) : ZMod q) = ((g q ^ lq q : (ZMod q)ˣ) : ZMod q)) :
    ∃ j, 0 < j ∧ j < I ∧ l ^ j % F ∣ n ∧ 1 < l ^ j % F ∧ l ^ j % F < n

statement:
theorem theorem_4_4_6_composite_cycM
    {n I F : ℕ} (hn1 : 1 < n) (hncomp : ¬n.Prime)
    (hI : Squarefree I) (hF : Squarefree F)
    (hqI : ∀ q ∈ F.primeFactors, (q - 1) ∣ I)
    (hgcd : Nat.Coprime (I * F) n) (hnF : n < F ^ 2)
    {w u : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hw : ∀ p ∈ I.primeFactors, 0 < w p)
    (hu : ∀ p ∈ I.primeFactors, ¬p ∣ u p)
    {lTab : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ} {lq : ℕ → ℕ} {l : ℕ} {q₀ : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hq₀ : ∀ p ∈ I.primeFactors, q₀ p ∈ F.primeFactors ∧ p ∣ q₀ p - 1)
    {g : (q : ℕ) → (ZMod q)ˣ}
    (hgen : ∀ q, q ∈ F.primeFactors → ∀ x, x ∈ Subgroup.zpowers (g q))
    (hstep : ∀ q (hq : q ∈ F.primeFactors) [Fact q.Prime],
      ∀ p ∈ (q - 1).primeFactors,
      (n : CycM ((q - 1) * q))
        ∣ gaussSum (MulChar.ofRootOfUnity (zetaPFam_mem p) (hgen q hq))
            (AddChar.zmodChar q isPrimitiveRoot_zetaQFam.pow_eq_one)
            ^ (p ^ w p * u p)
          - (zetaPFam q p : CycM ((q - 1) * q)) ^ lTab p q)
    (h5 : ∀ q (hq : q ∈ F.primeFactors) [Fact q.Prime],
      ∀ p ∈ (q - 1).primeFactors, q₀ p = q →
      ∀ d, d ∣ n → 1 < d → ∀ j,
      ¬(d : CycM ((q - 1) * q))
        ∣ gaussSum (MulChar.ofRootOfUnity (zetaPFam_mem p) (hgen q hq))
            (AddChar.zmodChar q isPrimitiveRoot_zetaQFam.pow_eq_one)
            ^ (p ^ (w p - 1) * u p)
          - (zetaPFam q p : CycM ((q - 1) * q)) ^ j)
    (hlq : ∀ q ∈ F.primeFactors, ∀ p ∈ (q - 1).primeFactors,
      lq q ≡ lTab p q [MOD p])
    (hl : ∀ q ∈ F.primeFactors,
      ((l : ℕ) : ZMod q) = ((g q ^ lq q : (ZMod q)ˣ) : ZMod q)) :
    ∃ j, 0 < j ∧ j < I ∧ l ^ j % F ∣ n ∧ 1 < l ^ j % F ∧ l ^ j % F < n

name: Azurite.CP.theorem_4_4_6_composite_tower
statement:
theorem theorem_4_4_6_composite_tower
    {n I F : ℕ} (hn1 : 1 < n) (hncomp : ¬n.Prime)
    (hI : Squarefree I) (hF : Squarefree F)
    (hqI : ∀ q ∈ F.primeFactors, (q - 1) ∣ I)
    (hgcd : Nat.Coprime (I * F) n) (hnF : n < F ^ 2)
    {w u : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hw : ∀ p ∈ I.primeFactors, 0 < w p)
    (hu : ∀ p ∈ I.primeFactors, ¬p ∣ u p)
    {lTab : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ} {lq : ℕ → ℕ} {l : ℕ} {q₀ : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hq₀ : ∀ p ∈ I.primeFactors, q₀ p ∈ F.primeFactors ∧ p ∣ q₀ p - 1)
    {g : (q : ℕ) → (ZMod q)ˣ}
    (hgen : ∀ q, q ∈ F.primeFactors → ∀ x, x ∈ Subgroup.zpowers (g q))
    (hstep : ∀ q (hq : q ∈ F.primeFactors) [Fact q.Prime],
      ∀ p (hp : p ∈ (q - 1).primeFactors),
      (n : CycPQ p q)
        ∣ gaussSum (MulChar.ofRootOfUnity (zetaPQUnit_mem hp) (hgen q hq))
            (AddChar.zmodChar q (isPrimitiveRoot_zetaQPQ hp).pow_eq_one)
            ^ (p ^ w p * u p)
          - ((zetaPQUnit p q : (CycPQ p q)ˣ) : CycPQ p q) ^ lTab p q)
    (h5 : ∀ q (hq : q ∈ F.primeFactors) [Fact q.Prime],
      ∀ p (hp : p ∈ (q - 1).primeFactors), q₀ p = q →
      ∀ d, d ∣ n → 1 < d → ∀ j,
      ¬(d : CycPQ p q)
        ∣ gaussSum (MulChar.ofRootOfUnity (zetaPQUnit_mem hp) (hgen q hq))
            (AddChar.zmodChar q (isPrimitiveRoot_zetaQPQ hp).pow_eq_one)
            ^ (p ^ (w p - 1) * u p)
          - ((zetaPQUnit p q : (CycPQ p q)ˣ) : CycPQ p q) ^ j)
    (hlq : ∀ q ∈ F.primeFactors, ∀ p ∈ (q - 1).primeFactors,
      lq q ≡ lTab p q [MOD p])
    (hl : ∀ q ∈ F.primeFactors,
      ((l : ℕ) : ZMod q) = ((g q ^ lq q : (ZMod q)ˣ) : ZMod q)) :
    ∃ j, 0 < j ∧ j < I ∧ l ^ j % F ∣ n ∧ 1 < l ^ j % F ∧ l ^ j % F < n

statement:
theorem theorem_4_1_5 {n F R c₁ c₂ : ℕ} (hn : 1 < n)

name: Azurite.CP.theorem_4_1_6
statement:
theorem theorem_4_1_6 {n F R c₁ c₄ u v d : ℕ} (hn : 214 ≤ n)
    (hsplit : n - 1 = F * R) (a : ZMod n) (ha : a ^ (n - 1) = 1)
    (hunit : ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ F → IsUnit (a ^ ((n - 1) / q) - 1))
    (hhi : F ^ 3 < n) (hlo : n ^ 3 ≤ F ^ 10)
    (hc1 : c₁ < F) (hrep : n = c₄ * F ^ 2 + c₁ * F + 1)
    (hv2 : v ^ 2 * n < F ^ 4)
    (happrox : ((u : ℤ) * F - c₁ * v) ^ 2 * F ^ 2 ≤ n)
    (hd : d = (2 * c₄ * v + F) / (2 * F)) :
    n.Prime ↔
      ((∀ t : ℕ, t ≤ 5 →
          ¬IsSquare (((c₁ : ℤ) + t * F) ^ 2 + 4 * t - 4 * c₄)) ∧
        ¬∃ x : ℤ, (v : ℤ) * x ^ 3 + ((u : ℤ) * F - c₁ * v) * x ^ 2
              + ((c₄ : ℤ) * v - d * F + u) * x - d = 0
            ∧ (x * F + 1) ∣ (n : ℤ) ∧ 1 < x * F + 1 ∧ x * F + 1 < n)

    (hunit : ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ F → IsUnit (a ^ ((n - 1) / q) - 1))
    (hhi : F ^ 3 < n) (hlo : n ^ 3 ≤ F ^ 10)
    (hc1 : c₁ < F) (hrep : n = c₄ * F ^ 2 + c₁ * F + 1) :
    n.Prime ↔
      ((∀ t : ℕ, t ≤ 5 →
          ¬IsSquare (((c₁ : ℤ) + t * F) ^ 2 + 4 * t - 4 * c₄)) ∧
        ¬∃ x : ℕ, 0 < x ∧ 3 * x * F ^ 3 < n ∧ (x * F + 1) ∣ n)

name: Azurite.CP.theorem_4_2_8
statement:
theorem theorem_4_2_8 {a b : ℤ} {n F r₁ r₀ : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (hcop : IsCoprime (n : ℤ) (2 * b))
    (hjac : jacobiSym (a ^ 2 - 4 * b) n = -1)
    (hdig : n + 1 = (r₁ * F + r₀) * F) (hr₀ : r₀ < F)
    (hcube : n < (F - 1) ^ 3)
    (hU : (n : ℤ) ∣ lucasU a b (n + 1))
    (hq : ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ F →
      IsCoprime (n : ℤ) (lucasU a b ((n + 1) / q))) :
    n.Prime ↔
      (¬∃ c : ℤ, 0 < c ∧ c ^ 2 + r₀ * c - r₁ = 0) ∧
      (¬∃ c : ℤ, 0 < c ∧ c ^ 2 + ((r₀ : ℤ) - F) * c - r₁ - 1 = 0)

name: Azurite.CP.theorem_4_2_9
statement:
theorem theorem_4_2_9 {a b : ℤ} {n F c₁ c₄ u v d : ℕ} (hn : 214 ≤ n)
    (hcop : IsCoprime (n : ℤ) (2 * b))
    (hjac : jacobiSym (a ^ 2 - 4 * b) n = -1)
    (hdig : n + 1 = c₄ * F ^ 2 + c₁ * F) (hc1 : c₁ < F) (hc4 : 6 ≤ c₄)
    (hlo : n ^ 3 ≤ F ^ 10)
    (hU : (n : ℤ) ∣ lucasU a b (n + 1))
    (hq : ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ F →
      IsCoprime (n : ℤ) (lucasU a b ((n + 1) / q)))
    (hv2 : v ^ 2 * n < F ^ 4)
    (happrox : ((u : ℤ) * F - c₁ * v) ^ 2 * F ^ 2 ≤ n)
    (hd : d = (2 * c₄ * v + F) / (2 * F)) :
    n.Prime ↔
      ((∀ t : ℤ, -5 ≤ t → t ≤ 5 →
          ¬IsSquare (((c₁ : ℤ) + t * F) ^ 2 - 4 * t + 4 * c₄)) ∧
        (¬∃ x : ℤ, (v : ℤ) * x ^ 3 - ((u : ℤ) * F - c₁ * v) * x ^ 2
              - ((c₄ : ℤ) * v - d * F + u) * x + d = 0
            ∧ (x * F + 1) ∣ (n : ℤ) ∧ 1 < x * F + 1 ∧ x * F + 1 < n) ∧
        (¬∃ x : ℤ, (v : ℤ) * x ^ 3 + ((u : ℤ) * F - c₁ * v) * x ^ 2
              + ((d : ℤ) * F - c₄ * v - u) * x - d = 0
            ∧ (x * F - 1) ∣ (n : ℤ) ∧ 1 < x * F - 1 ∧ x * F - 1 < n))

name: Azurite.GG.lemma_14_6
statement:
theorem lemma_14_6 [Fintype F] {k : ℕ} (hk0 : k ≠ 0)
    (hk : k ∣ Fintype.card F - 1) :
    Nat.card (kthPowers F k) = (Fintype.card F - 1) / k ∧

name: UInt64.divRound_fst
statement:
theorem divRound_fst (x y : UInt64) (mode : RoundingMode) :
    (x.divRound y mode).1 =
      if x % y == 0 then x / y
      else
        match mode with
        | .Floor | .Down => x / y
        | .Ceiling | .Up => x / y + 1
        | .Nearest =>
          match compare (y >>> 1) (x % y) with
          | .lt => x / y + 1
          | .gt => x / y
          | .eq =>
            if (y &&& 1 == 0) && ((x / y) &&& 1 == 1) then x / y + 1
            else x / y

name: UInt64.divRound_snd
statement:
theorem divRound_snd (x y : UInt64) (mode : RoundingMode) :
    (x.divRound y mode).2 =
      if x % y == 0 then .eq
      else
        match mode with
        | .Floor | .Down => .lt
        | .Ceiling | .Up => .gt
        | .Nearest =>
          match compare (y >>> 1) (x % y) with
          | .lt => .gt
          | .gt => .lt
          | .eq =>
            if (y &&& 1 == 0) && ((x / y) &&& 1 == 1) then .gt
            else .lt

name: UInt64.shiftRightRound_fst
statement:
theorem shiftRightRound_fst (u : UInt64) (mode : RoundingMode) (sh : Nat) :
    (u.shiftRightRound mode sh).1 =
      match mode with
      | .Floor | .Down => shiftRightSat u sh
      | .Ceiling | .Up =>
        if u.isMultipleOfPow2 sh then shiftRightSat u sh
        else shiftRightSat u sh + 1
      | .Nearest =>
        if sh = 0 then u
        else if u.testBit (sh - 1) then
          if u.isMultipleOfPow2 (sh - 1) then
            let shifted := shiftRightSat u sh
            if shifted &&& 1 == 1 then shifted + 1 else shifted
          else
            shiftRightSat u sh + 1
        else
          shiftRightSat u sh

name: UInt64.shiftRightRound_snd
statement:
theorem shiftRightRound_snd (u : UInt64) (mode : RoundingMode) (sh : Nat) :
    (u.shiftRightRound mode sh).2 =
      match mode with
      | .Floor | .Down => if u.isMultipleOfPow2 sh then .eq else .lt
      | .Ceiling | .Up => if u.isMultipleOfPow2 sh then .eq else .gt
      | .Nearest =>
        if sh = 0 then .eq
        else if u.testBit (sh - 1) then
          if u.isMultipleOfPow2 (sh - 1) then
            if shiftRightSat u sh &&& 1 == 1 then .gt else .lt
          else
            .gt
        else
          if u.isMultipleOfPow2 sh then .eq else .lt

name: UInt64.toNat_shiftRightRound
statement:
theorem toNat_shiftRightRound (u : UInt64) (mode : RoundingMode) (sh : Nat) :
    (((u.shiftRightRound mode sh).1).toNat : EReal) =
      (round natBotSet mode ((u.toNat : ℝ) / ((2 : ℝ) ^ sh))).val

name: UInt64.toNat_shiftRightSat
statement:
theorem toNat_shiftRightSat (u : UInt64) (sh : Nat) :
    (shiftRightSat u sh).toNat = u.toNat / 2 ^ sh

name: UInt64.toNat_shiftRightSat_add_one
statement:
theorem toNat_shiftRightSat_add_one (u : UInt64) (sh : Nat) (hsh : 0 < sh) :
    ((shiftRightSat u sh) + 1).toNat = u.toNat / 2 ^ sh + 1

name: UInt64.toNat_wideAdd
statement:
theorem toNat_wideAdd (x y : UInt64 × UInt64) :
    (wideAdd x y).1.toNat * 2 ^ 64 + (wideAdd x y).2.toNat
      = (x.1.toNat * 2 ^ 64 + x.2.toNat + (y.1.toNat * 2 ^ 64 + y.2.toNat)) % 2 ^ 128

name: UInt64.toNat_wideAdd3
statement:
theorem toNat_wideAdd3 (x y : UInt64 × UInt64 × UInt64) :
    (wideAdd3 x y).1.toNat * 2 ^ 128 + (wideAdd3 x y).2.1.toNat * 2 ^ 64
        + (wideAdd3 x y).2.2.toNat
      = (x.1.toNat * 2 ^ 128 + x.2.1.toNat * 2 ^ 64 + x.2.2.toNat
          + (y.1.toNat * 2 ^ 128 + y.2.1.toNat * 2 ^ 64 + y.2.2.toNat)) % 2 ^ 192

name: UInt64.toNat_wideSub
statement:
theorem toNat_wideSub (x y : UInt64 × UInt64) :
    (wideSub x y).1.toNat * 2 ^ 64 + (wideSub x y).2.toNat
      = (2 ^ 128 - (y.1.toNat * 2 ^ 64 + y.2.toNat) + (x.1.toNat * 2 ^ 64 + x.2.toNat))
          % 2 ^ 128

name: UInt64.toNat_wideSub3
statement:
theorem toNat_wideSub3 (x y : UInt64 × UInt64 × UInt64) :
    (wideSub3 x y).1.toNat * 2 ^ 128 + (wideSub3 x y).2.1.toNat * 2 ^ 64
        + (wideSub3 x y).2.2.toNat
      = (2 ^ 192 - (y.1.toNat * 2 ^ 128 + y.2.1.toNat * 2 ^ 64 + y.2.2.toNat)
          + (x.1.toNat * 2 ^ 128 + x.2.1.toNat * 2 ^ 64 + x.2.2.toNat)) % 2 ^ 192
